raw.description:
FleetPride is the largest after-market distributor of heavy-duty truck and trailer parts in the U.S. with some of the best and brightest people in the business! Partner with the best in the heavy-duty industry and apply today!

FleetPride is seeking a results-driven Virtual Branch Service Advisor to help support and grow our service business. This role is responsible for supporting service operations and service writing for multiple different business units within FleetPride. The ideal candidate will bring strong FleetPride branch knowledge, specifically mobile service writing experience, Karmak, iSeries, and customer service expertise. As a key member of the Virtual Branch team, this individual will play a pivotal role in enhancing customer experience, optimizing service processes, and strengthening collaboration between the field, service teams, and internal departments.

DUTIES & RESPONSIBILITIES

Customer Support

  • Assist customers in intaking, qualifying, scheduling, and following up with heavy-duty service via phone, email, or virtual channels.
  • Recommend related services, provide accurate estimates, coordinate service completion with technicians, and process service orders once completed.
  • Ensure professional, timely, and high-quality customer interactions both internally and externally that drive satisfaction and loyalty.

Service & Operations Coordination

  • Work with service technicians to estimate, schedule and complete repairs in a quick and efficient manner.
  • Coordinate service dispatch, purchase orders, and logistics to ensure timely service completion.
  • Track work progress, communicate updates internally and externally, and control related costs.
  • Process, and complete repair orders in a timely manner to ensure efficient and timely invoicing. Uphold accuracy and efficiency across all service and repair order documentation.

Parts Sourcing & Inventory Coordination

  • Assist locating and securing parts from warehouses, branches, or OEM dealers as needed.
  • Account for special order, returns, and warranty parts in compliance with company policy.
  • Maintain organized, accurate recording and ensure parts are billed out properly on service orders.

Continuous Improvement & Knowledge Development

  • Review customer requirements, rate sheets, and bulletins to stay current on service expectations and processes.
  • Participate in training, team meetings, and process improvement initiatives.
  • Proactively identify opportunities to improve efficiency and service quality.

Additional Responsibilities

•Perform other duties as assigned.

EDUCATION & TRAINING

  • Bachelor’s Degree or high school diploma or equivalent with an additional 3 years of relevant professional experience

KNOWLEDGE & EXPERIENCE

  • Education: High School Diploma, GED, or equivalent.
  • Technical Proficiency: Intermediate knowledge of Microsoft Excel, Word, and Outlook; experience using Karmak and iSeries systems.

SKILLS & ABILITIES

  • Active Listening: Fully attentive to others’ input; seeks understanding before responding.
  • Communication: Clearly and effectively convey information to customers and team members.
  • Time Management: Prioritizes tasks efficiently to meet deadlines and service expectations.
  • Persuasion: Influences and builds alignment toward shared goals and solutions.
  • Service Orientation: Proactively identifies and fulfills internal and external customer needs.

WORKING CONDITIONS

WORK ENVIRONMENT

  • Our corporate office follows a hybrid work structure.
  • The primary environment is characterized by ambient room temperatures, lighting, and traditional office equipment found in a typical office environment.

PHYSICAL DEMANDS The physical demands described here are representative of those that must be met by an employee to successfully perform the essential functions of the job. Reasonable accommodations may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions.

  • Reaching above shoulder heights, below the waist or lifting as required filing documents and storing materials.
  • Dexterity of hands and fingers to operate a computer keyboard or mouse, and to handle other computer components.
  • Occasional lifting of moderately heavy objects, such as computers and peripherals.

•Sitting for extended periods of time.

This job description in no way states or implies that these are the only duties to be performed by this employee. He or she will be required to follow any other instructions and to perform any other duties requested by his or her supervisor.

FleetPride is the leader in the industry comprised of retail, service, distribution and wholesale divisions.

All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, disability, or status as a protected veteran.

raw.description:
Vendor Analyst — Subcontractor & Staffing Partners
Reports to: Vendor Manager, Subcontractor & Staffing Partners
Department: [Vendor Management / Procurement]
Job type: Full-time, permanent
Travel: Minimal — occasional travel for partner reviews

Role purpose

The Vendor Analyst is the data and operations engine behind Astreya's subcontractor and staffing-partner programme. You maintain the vendor master data, compliance records and spend reporting that the Vendor Manager relies on to negotiate, govern and — where necessary — exit partner relationships. You will turn a fragmented picture of third-party labour spend, fill rates and compliance status into a clear, trusted monthly cadence, and flag the risks in it before they reach a client.

This is a hands-on analytical role with high visibility. You will not own commercial negotiations, but you will build the evidence base those negotiations are won with.

Key responsibilities

Reporting & analysis (approx. 40%)

  • Build and maintain vendor scorecards covering fill rate, time-to-fill, attrition, SLA attainment, no-show rates and CSAT on partner-delivered work
  • Produce the monthly and quarterly vendor reporting pack: spend by vendor, region, client and role type; subcontracted headcount; trend and variance commentary
  • Benchmark partner rate cards by role and geography — against market data and against each other — and surface where Astreya is paying above pattern
  • Track savings and consolidation targets against actuals; flag run-rate drift and out-of-pattern spend early
  • Prepare QBR packs, executive summaries and escalation briefs for the Vendor Manager

Vendor operations & data (approx. 30%)

  • Own the vendor master data: legal entities, contacts, contract dates, notice periods, renewal and expiry alerts
  • Run vendor onboarding administration — intake forms, due diligence packs, banking and tax documentation, system and portal setup
  • Maintain the contract repository and supporting document trail in an audit-ready state
  • Administer timesheets and purchase orders for subcontracted resource; support month-end accruals with Finance
  • Manage the vendor request and exception queue, and chase open actions arising from vendor reviews

Compliance & controls (approx. 20%)

  • Track and evidence compliance across the partner base: insurance certificates, background and right-to-work checks, security and privacy training, local licensing and labour requirements
  • Operate an expiry-tracking process so no resource works on a client site with lapsed documentation
  • Reconcile vendor invoices against SOWs, timesheets, rate cards and approved POs; investigate and clear disputes with Accounts Payable
  • Recommend invoices for approval; approval authority sits with the Vendor Manager

Sourcing support (approx. 10%)

  • Run the mechanics of RFPs and RFQs — distributing documents, collating responses, building comparison and scoring matrices
  • Support bid teams with sourcing data, historical rates and coverage information for new and expanding accounts

raw.title: Senior Applied Research Scientist – GPU Native Numerical Algorithms
raw.excerpt: NVIDIA pioneered accelerated computing.  Today, we are building software, systems, and research platforms that help scientists and engineers solve problems that were once out of reach.
raw.description:
NVIDIA pioneered accelerated computing. Today, we are building software, systems, and research platforms that help scientists and engineers solve problems that were once out of reach. We are looking for an Applied Research Scientist to join our computational engineering applied research team! In this role, we will work together to design GPU-native numerical methods that make engineering simulation faster, more reliable, and easier to use across NVIDIA platforms, while providing the numerical foundations for emerging AI-native engineering algorithms. You will explore solver algorithms, build research prototypes, compare approaches on representative workloads, and help move promising ideas into software used by researchers, engineers, and partners. The goal is not simply to port established CPU algorithms, but to rethink methods around massive parallelism, hierarchical memory, reduced synchronization, mixed precision, tensor-core computation, and multi-GPU systems.

This role connects numerical analysis, accelerated computing, production-minded software engineering, and the co-design of future AI-native engineering methods. We are interested in candidates who enjoy working across math, code, hardware, and real engineering applications. Come help us shape the future of simulation on GPUs!

What you'll be doing:

We work as a team, and you will help us:

  • Invent and reformulate numerical algorithms whose mathematical and computational structure is co-designed for modern NVIDIA GPU architectures, including implicit and explicit engineering simulation.

  • Develop linear and nonlinear solver approaches, including Newton-Krylov methods, multigrid and AMG, domain decomposition, matrix-free algorithms, mixed precision methods, sparse iterative and direct methods, and preconditioning strategies.

  • Investigate when established CPU-oriented numerical methods should be reformulated or replaced for GPU architectures, including new approaches to synchronization-avoiding Krylov methods, GPU-native multigrid and domain decomposition, matrix-free implicit methods, mixed-precision algorithms, and sparse direct/iterative hybrids.

  • Evaluate algorithms on workloads in mechanics, contact, thermal-fluid systems, electromagnetics, semiconductor process and device simulation, EDA, multiphysics, and related CAE domains.

  • Collaborate with CUDA-X, Warp, solver engineering, NVIDIA Research, universities, and industry partners to move useful research from prototype to NVIDIA software capabilities.

  • Help shape the long-term applied research roadmap for GPU-native numerical methods and their evolution toward AI-native computational engineering.

What we need to see:

  • PhD or equivalent experience in computational mechanics, applied mathematics, scientific computing, computer science, aerospace, mechanical, civil engineering, or a related technical field.

  • 5+ years of relevant work/research experience.

  • Research or engineering experience with PDE discretization, finite element, finite volume, discontinuous Galerkin methods, nonlinear solvers, sparse linear algebra, preconditioning, or high-performance computing.

  • Experience writing numerical software in C++ and Python, plus experience developing or optimizing CUDA or GPU code.

  • Experience using profiling, benchmarking, numerical validation, or performance analysis to improve algorithms on GPU or multi-GPU systems.

  • Ability to communicate technical tradeoffs clearly and collaborate across research, engineering, product, and partner teams.

Ways to stand out from the crowd:

  • Experience with implicit structural dynamics, nonlinear mechanics, contact, CFD, electromagnetics, multiphysics, semiconductor simulation, EDA, CAE, or CAD-connected engineering workflows.

  • Contributions to or practical experience with PETSc, Trilinos, MFEM, libCEED, OpenFOAM, NVIDIA Warp, CUDA-X, cuSPARSE, cuSOLVER, or related computational science frameworks.

  • Experience with industrial simulation, EDA, semiconductor, CAE, or CAD ecosystems, including Ansys, Abaqus, LS-DYNA, Siemens Simcenter, Dassault SIMULIA, Altair, Cadence, Synopsys, COMSOL, MathWorks, or comparable internal solver and design platforms.

  • Experience with distributed solvers using MPI, NCCL, asynchronous methods, or performance analysis on GPU clusters.

  • Publications, patents, open-source work, or deployed software in computational science venues or communities such as SC, SIAM CSE, SIAM SISC, CMAME, IJNME, JCP, AIAA, USNCCM, WCCM, or related areas.

Remote | Full-Time | SeedTrust Escrow

About us

At SeedTrust, we help families grow by making the financial side of surrogacy and egg donation journeys simpler, safer, and less stressful.

Behind every escrow account is a family going through an important chapter of their lives. Our job is to bring clarity, security, and peace of mind to that process, so they can focus on what matters most.

The opportunity

We're looking for an Escrow Administrator fluent in English and Mandarin to join our Escrow Operations team.

You'll be one of the first people our clients talk to. You'll answer their questions, set up their escrow accounts, and make sure every request is handled accurately and on time. Many of our clients are more comfortable in Mandarin, so you'll often be the person who makes a complex process feel clear in their language.

It's a role that combines client support, administrative precision, and teamwork. Behind every smooth client experience is a team that makes it happen, and you'll play a key part in making sure every detail is handled with care.

What you'll be doing

  • Be someone our clients can count on. Answer calls and emails in English and Mandarin, provide clear and thoughtful support, and connect clients with the right people when needed.

  • Get the details right. Open new escrow accounts and cases, making sure information is accurate and complete from the start.

  • Keep clients informed. Confirm incoming deposits and prepare reports, letters, invoices, and other documents with accuracy and care.

  • Keep things moving. Help manage our shared inbox, organize requests, and make sure nothing falls through the cracks.

  • Work as one team. Collaborate with Escrow Account Leads, Specialists, and other teammates to ensure smooth handoffs and timely follow-through.

  • Spot what needs attention. Flag missing information, potential errors, or issues that need to be escalated before they become bigger problems.

You might be a great fit if...

  • You're fluent in English and Mandarin, both spoken and written. You can explain a process on the phone and write a clear, professional email in both languages.

  • Details matter to you. You're organized, accurate, and take pride in getting things right the first time.

  • You enjoy helping people. You're patient, approachable, and good at making information easier to understand.

  • You know how to prioritize. You're comfortable handling multiple requests at once and keeping things moving in a busy environment.

  • You take ownership. You follow through, ask questions, and speak up when something doesn't look right.

  • You're comfortable with technology and pick up new tools and processes quickly.

Experience in customer service, financial services, or administrative operations is a plus. Familiarity with escrow, surrogacy, or fertility services is even better, but not required.

What we offer

We want people to feel trusted, supported, and empowered to do great work.

We're a fully remote team that values accountability, collaboration, and continuous improvement. We care deeply about the experience we create for our clients and how we work together to make it happen.

  • 100% remote work

  • Medical, dental, and vision benefits

  • Life insurance and 401(k)

  • Unlimited paid time off

Benefits may vary depending on your country of residence and employment arrangement.


Our hiring process

  1. Application and short questionnaire. Please answer in your own words. Honest, specific answers matter more than polished ones.

  2. 30-minute conversation with our recruiting team.

  3. Short language check in Mandarin with a member of our team.

  4. Interview with our Escrow Operations leadership.

This is a full-time, remote position open to candidates in multiple countries. Employment or contractor arrangements will depend on your country of residence and local requirements. Candidates must be legally authorized to work in their country of residence.

We do not work with staffing agencies for this role. Interviews are conducted live on video with cameras on.


Ready to join us?

If you enjoy helping people, bringing order to complex processes, and being someone others can rely on, we'd love to hear from you.

SeedTrust is an equal opportunity employer. We welcome applicants of all backgrounds and do not discriminate on the basis of race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, age, disability, veteran status, or any other legally protected characteristic.

Description

About the role
Finch is a performance marketing agency. We run digital advertising and SEO for e-commerce and B2B brands. We’re looking for an agency-side Account Manager to be the main strategic contact for a portfolio of our clients, the companies that hire Finch to run their marketing. You’ll lead each relationship and its strategy, and work with our channel specialists (Paid Search, Paid Social, Programmatic/DSP, SEO, Creative, Analytics) to deliver on each client’s business goals.

What you’ll do

  • Own the strategy for each client account: goals, KPIs and quarterly roadmaps.
  • Run recurring client meetings, manage stakeholders and document next steps.
  • Read performance against business metrics (ROAS, CPA, CAC vs. LTV, organic growth) and coordinate actions with Finch’s specialists.
  • Find and scope growth opportunities: new channels, tests and budget expansions.
  • Flag retention risks early and build mitigation plans across your portfolio.

Why Finch

  • Work globally, stay flexible: Join a fully distributed team across the US, LATAM, Europe, and APAC.
  • Meaningful impact from day one: Your work directly influences client outcomes and how Finch grows.
  • A culture built on curiosity, transparency, and ownership: We share context and empower people to make decisions.
  • High-caliber teammates: Collaborate with specialists in Paid Search, Paid Social, SEO, DSP, Creative, Analytics, and more.
  • Learning as a default: We encourage experimentation, cross-training, and growth as the company scales.
  • Real work-life balance: We value high performance, not overwork.

Requirements

You’ll be a great match if you have

  • 5+ years as an Account Manager or Account Director at a marketing agency (performance or digital).
  • Experience owning several B2B client accounts at the same time: managing the client relationship, growing the account, and running the project management behind it.
  • Experience as the Account Manager on advertising-driven accounts (Paid Search, Paid Social, Programmatic/DSP), coordinating the specialists who run each channel, with a solid grasp of attribution, KPIs and optimization logic.
  • Fluent written and spoken English, and comfort leading strategic conversations with senior client stakeholders.
  • A base in Latin America or Africa (or anywhere up to UTC+2), with availability to work roughly 9am–5pm US Central/Mountain time.

This role is not the right next step if most of your experience is in

  • Customer service or support, or customer success for consumers (B2C) or for a software product, even if the title was “Account Manager” or “Customer Success Manager”.
  • Working at an ad platform or affiliate network, managing advertisers on its behalf.
  • Managing a brand’s own e-commerce store or marketplace channels.
  • In-house marketing for a single company, without an agency client portfolio.
  • Sales or business development, without ongoing account management after the sale.
  • Account management at a branding, PR or creative agency, without performance accounts.

Nice to have

  • Experience with SEO-driven accounts.
  • Experience with US or international clients.

  • A high functioning workaholic
  • Looking for exponential career growth

Position Summary


The Senior Manager, Global Sourcing – Plastics is responsible for developing and executing the global sourcing strategy for plastic resin, injection molded components, extrusion products, thermoformed products, and other plastic-related direct material categories supporting CONMED's global manufacturing operations.

This role leads strategic supplier relationships, drives total cost of ownership improvements, ensures supply continuity, supports new product introductions, and partners closely with Engineering, Supplier Development, Manufacturing, Quality, R&D, and Operations teams. The Senior Manager plays a critical role in aligning sourcing strategies with enterprise growth objectives while balancing quality, service, innovation, and risk mitigation requirements.

The position combines strategic leadership, category expertise, supplier management, and cross-functional influence to deliver measurable business results across CONMED's global supply chain.


Key Responsibilities


Category Strategy & Leadership

  • Develop and execute multi-year global category strategies for plastics, resins, molded components, and related manufacturing technologies.
  • Build comprehensive category roadmaps aligned with business growth, manufacturing expansion, product development, and supplier capability requirements.
  • Analyze global market trends, commodity indexes, raw material availability, capacity constraints, geopolitical risks, and emerging technologies.
  • Provide executive recommendations regarding sourcing opportunities, supplier footprint optimization, and risk mitigation strategies.

Cost Optimization & Value Creation

  • Deliver annual cost reduction, cost avoidance, and productivity objectives.
  • Lead strategic sourcing initiatives including:
    • RFIs
    • RFQs
    • RFPs
    • Supplier consolidations
    • Resourcing projects
    • Make-versus-buy evaluations
  • Develop should-cost models and total cost of ownership analyses.
  • Negotiate long-term commercial agreements and pricing structures.
  • Identify opportunities for design-to-cost, material optimization, and value engineering initiatives.

Supplier Relationship Management

  • Lead strategic relationships with global plastics suppliers and contract manufacturers.
  • Establish governance processes including:
    • Quarterly Business Reviews
    • Executive Supplier Reviews
    • Performance Scorecards
    • Continuous Improvement Plans
  • Drive supplier accountability for:
    • Quality
    • Delivery
    • Cost
    • Capacity
    • Innovation
    • Business continuity
  • Partner with Supplier Development and Quality teams to improve supplier performance and compliance.

New Product Introduction (NPI)

  • Partner with Engineering, R&D, Supplier Development, and Manufacturing teams to support new product development and commercialization efforts.
  • Engage suppliers early in the development process to ensure manufacturability, scalability, and supply readiness.
  • Lead sourcing activities supporting:
    • Product launches
    • Product transfers
    • Dual source development
    • Supplier qualification
    • Capacity planning
  • Ensure sourcing strategies support CONMED's innovation pipeline and growth objectives.

Risk Management & Supply Continuity

  • Identify and proactively mitigate supply chain risks.
  • Develop continuity plans including:
    • Dual sourcing strategies
    • Capacity assessments
    • Geographic diversification
    • Inventory strategies
    • Supplier recovery plans
  • Monitor market dynamics impacting plastics and resin availability.
  • Lead supplier risk assessments and mitigation activities.

Cross-Functional Collaboration

  • Partner closely with:
    • Manufacturing Operations
    • Engineering
    • Quality & Regulatory
    • Supplier Development
    • Planning
    • Finance
    • Legal
    • R&D
  • Support strategic business initiatives and operational improvement projects.
  • Ensure sourcing decisions align with quality, regulatory, manufacturing, and financial objectives.

Leadership & Talent Development

  • Lead, coach, and develop sourcing professionals and category specialists as assigned.
  • Build organizational capability in strategic sourcing, analytics, supplier management, and negotiation excellence.
  • Promote a culture of accountability, collaboration, inclusion, and continuous improvement.
  • Support succession planning and talent development initiatives within Global Sourcing.

Qualifications


Required

  • Bachelor's degree in Supply Chain, Engineering, Operations, Business, or related field.
  • Minimum 8–10 years of progressive sourcing, procurement, supply chain, or category management experience.
  • Minimum 3 years of leadership experience.
  • Minimum 3 years of experience managing plastics, resins, molded components, or related direct material categories.

Preferred

  • MBA or advanced degree.
  • Medical device, healthcare, pharmaceutical, or highly regulated manufacturing experience.
  • CPSM, CIPS, CPM, or equivalent sourcing certification.
  • Experience supporting global manufacturing operations and new product introductions.
  • Proven track record delivering measurable cost savings and supplier performance improvements.
  • Strong negotiation and commercial management skills.
  • Experience leading cross-functional sourcing initiatives within manufacturing environments.

This position is not eligible for employer-based sponsorship.

Join our team as an Independent Contractor for Project Morava.
Project Morava aims to help build more natural and intelligent voice AI systems by collecting high-quality speech data from native speakers.
In this project, participants contribute by reading and recording short, scripted prompts in Vietnamese. These recordings are used to train and evaluate speech recognition models, enabling voice assistants and AI systems to better understand and respond to real-world users.
Project Benefits
  • The entire task takes approximately 2 hours, including time to review the guidelines
  • Work on your own schedule
  • Participate from anywhere within Japan
  • Record scripted prompts on your smartphone using the Appen Mobile app
Task Summary
You will use the Appen Mobile app on your smartphone to record 200 short, scripted voice prompts in Language. Each prompt is a brief spoken command — natural, everyday language. Simply read each prompt clearly and naturally, and you're done.
Requirements
  • Must be a fluent speaker of Vietnamese
  • Must be currently residing in Japan
  • Must be 18 years old or above
  • Must have a smartphone compatible with the Appen Mobile app
Payment
Get paid for just 2 hours of work — completed entirely on your smartphone, on your own schedule. Payment is issued only for completed 200-prompt sessions that pass our quality check. The quality bar is simple to hit: just follow the recording guidelines, speak clearly and naturally, and you're good to go. If assigned fewer than 200 prompts, payment is adjusted proportionally.
Please Note
This project follows a first-come, first-served approach and operates with demographic quotas to ensure fair and balanced representation across all participant groups. As a result, some individuals may not receive a task assignment if their group has already been filled.
Join us in shaping the future of voice AI. Your participation in Project Morava will directly help improve how technology understands and responds to real human speech.

About Us

Revvity is a developer and provider of end-to-end solutions designed to help scientists, researchers, and clinicians solve the world’s greatest health challenges. We pair the enthusiasm of an industry disruptor with the experience of a longtime leader. Our team of 11,000+ colleagues from around the globe are vital to our success and the reason we’re able to push boundaries in pursuit of better human health.

Find your future at Revvity

The Sr. Marketing Manager, US and Canada (USCAN) leads regional marketing, owning the deployment, management, and performance of integrated online and offline campaigns. Partnering with USCAN sales and global marketing teams at all levels, this critical role plans and executes measurable, high-impact campaigns for Life Sciences, Diagnostics, and Reproductive Health customers and drives disciplined lead follow-up from generation through qualification, conversion, and booked revenue. If you are a strong marketing leader with exceptional collaboration skills who thrives in a fast-paced, high-expectation environment and can build a high-performance regional team, we look forward to meeting you.


Key Responsibilities:

Responsibilities span three areas: Marketing and Commercial Partnership, Campaign Management and Optimization, and Leadership and Team Management.


Marketing and Commercial Partnership:

  • Bring deep understanding of business objectives, market dynamics, sales needs, and customer insights to marketing planning; collaborate with Global Marketing Strategy to develop and refine an aligned plan that meets USCAN objectives, with clear audiences, channel strategies, KPIs, and budget allocated by performance and priority.
  • Generate customer, local market, and campaign performance insights from voice of customer, approved AI tools, enterprise reporting, internal data, and external sources; turn them into actionable recommendations for USCAN sales and upstream marketing teams to optimize the plan and improve results.
  • Use AI-enabled productivity tools to accelerate research, ideation, synthesis, and insight generation while ensuring accuracy, data governance, and appropriate human review.

  • Prepare and present USCAN marketing performance in commercial operating reviews, sharing campaign results, market insights, and actions taken and underway to improve engagement, lead quality, pipeline contribution, and revenue impact.

Campaign Management and Optimization:

Lead the USCAN marketing team to ensure:

  • Timely setup and deployment of integrated campaigns from the aligned USCAN marketing plan, including SEM, ABM, webinars, social media, email, and in-person and virtual events; coordinate final launch details, including approvals and budgets, with upstream, creative, and channel teams.
  • Tracking marketing leads through regular communication with sales managers and representatives to ensure timely follow-up and accurate disposition.

  • Sharing performance by audience, content, message, channel, lead conversion, pipeline contribution, and realized revenue with upstream and channel marketing partners to improve future messaging, customer journeys, and channel performance.

  • Build a high-performance culture focused on accountability, customers, data-driven decisions, collaboration with sales and marketing partners, and measurable revenue impact.
  • Allocate team capacity and resources across priorities, remove execution barriers, provide timely feedback, and support professional development and succession planning.
  • Influence across a matrixed organization and build strong relationships with sales, global marketing, commercial operations, portfolio, IT, finance, and other key partners.

  • Bachelor’s degree in Marketing, Business Administration or a Life Sciences discipline.
  • 8+ years of B2B marketing experience supporting commercial teams within a scientific, clinical, laboratory, or healthcare setting.
  • 3+ years in a people leadership role.

Preferred Qualifications:

  • Master’s degree in marketing, business, or a related discipline; MBA preferred.
  • Passion for collaboration, stakeholder management, building strong relationships and driving results.
  • Strong analytical, budget management, communication, influence, and presentation skills.
  • Demonstrated success deploying and optimizing integrated campaigns across SEM, ABM, webinars, social media, email, web, and events.
  • Experience leading a regional marketing organization within a complex, matrixed, global business.
  • Knowledge of the US and Canadian life sciences, diagnostics, and reproductive health markets and customer segments.
  • Experience with marketing automation, SEO/SEM best practices, content management systems, and ABM platforms.
  • Working knowledge of Power BI for analysis and performance reporting, and of Workfront and Asana for workflow, project, and resource management.
  • Strong project management skills, with the ability to lead complex cross-functional initiatives, manage competing priorities, mitigate risks, and deliver high-quality results on time and on budget.
  • Passion for inspiring team members to amplify Revvity’s culture and values through everyday leadership, collaboration, and shared impact.
  • Strong Salesforce (SFDC) knowledge and hands-on experience with campaign management, lead and funnel reporting, data quality, sales follow-up, opportunity conversion, and marketing-attributed pipeline and revenue measurement
  • Proficiency with approved AI tools for market overviews, analysis, insight synthesis, and PowerPoint creation, with appropriate validation and governance.

Job Title:

Manager of Inpatient Coding

Department:

Health System Shared Services | MIM CDI and Coding

Scope of Position

The Manager of Inpatient Coding is responsible for managing systems and operations for efficient coding of inpatient medical record information. The manager monitors ICD-9-CM and ICD-10-CM/PCS code assignments for inpatient and rehabilitation prospective payment systems (MS-DRGs and APR-DRGs). Monitors computerized medical record information systems, i.e., IHIS and 3M Encoder. In this role, the Inpatient Coding Manager serves as a liaison and coordinator for special projects regarding the coding of medical records. This position is critical to the financial standing of the health system. The accuracy of the coding of diagnoses and procedures and the timeliness of their provision to the billing system will determine if the hospital will receive the full and proper payment from Medicare, Medicaid, CHAMPUS, and other third party payers. This position is critical to the reputation of the health system. The Manager trains coders and monitors coders’ performance to assure accurate and compliant coding.

Position Summary

This role serves as the manager for inpatient coding. This team is vital to the continued operation of the entire Department as it serves to assign the codes necessary for the billing of the inpatient accounts. Sets daily priorities, monitors accounts not coded, trains and supports coding specialists in assigning ICD-9-CM/ICD-10-CM/PCS diagnoses and procedure codes and determines Medicare Severity Diagnosis Related Group (MS-DRG) and All Patient Refined Diagnosis Related Groups (APR-DRG) for billing and statistical purposes. The manager monitors performance to assure compliance with policies and procedures and billing rules. The leader of this team must interact constantly with Department Administration, Department Managers, medical staff, and clinical operations.


Minimum Qualifications

Minimum five (5) years of progressive experience in hospital-based coding, with experience in inpatient facility coding required.

Bachelor's Degree in Health Information Administration or equivalent preferred.

Credentialed as a Registered Health Information Technician, Registered Health Information Administrator, or Certified Coding Specialist by the American Health Information Management Association

Experience with computer-assisted coding, coding automation, and revenue cycle analytics.

Experience working collaboratively with Clinical Documentation Integrity (CDI), Revenue Cycle, Patient Financial Services, physicians, and clinical departments.

Ongoing:

Maintains required competencies, certifications, and compliance training as applicable.

raw.description:
About Improvado

Improvado is an AI-powered marketing data platform built for mid-market and enterprise teams. We help companies automate complex marketing data workflows, unify data at scale, and surface insights through BI and AI. Brands like Genentech, T-Mobile, Activision, and H&R Block rely on us to simplify analytics and improve marketing performance.

We’re a fast-growing Series A startup backed by $34M in funding and driven by a team that moves fast, stays curious, and cares about high-quality execution.

About the role

Improvado is a marketing data platform for enterprise brands and agencies. You will own how our revenue runs and how it is measured. That covers Salesforce and the GTM tools, the path from signed contract to paid invoice, the revenue data model, and the reports leadership decides from. You work closely with the analytics team: you don’t have to build the data models yourself, but you must read them, spot what is wrong and say what to change. You work through AI agents daily, doing the work of a bigger team.

What you will do

Salesforce and GTM stack

  • Own Salesforce configuration, release process and user access, plus the integrations around it (Gong, Clay, Lemlist, enrichment, e-signature, lead routing).
  • Keep CRM data clean with guardrails that block mistakes. Manage licences and vendor renewals.
  • Maintain the Salesforce manual and RevOps SOPs, and train new hires.

Contract to cash

  • Own ARR and bookings logic (new, upsell, downsell, churn, renewals) and keep agreement, opportunity, and invoice consistent.
  • Run the closed-deals and billing check with Finance. Fix errors at the source and add a control so they don’t repeat.
  • Audit invoices, track and chase unpaid ones, and prepare quarterly commission and quota reports.

Revenue analytics and data model

  • Own the quarterly sales analytics pack, the CRO report, the forecast and pipeline coverage (including CS renewal inputs).
  • Track funnel conversion, explain why deals move, stall or slip, and keep attribution correct with Marketing.
  • Query ClickHouse daily, trace any number to its source, and write specs for model changes. Give each metric one documented definition and add data quality checks.
  • Build leadership dashboards, retire unused ones, and end every analysis with a recommendation, a number and an owner.

AI and automation

  • Use coding agents (Claude Code, Codex) for queries, scripts and Salesforce automation, and always verify their output.
  • Automate manual work (invoice and payment checks, CRM hygiene, deal-risk alerts, call analysis) and measure hours saved and errors avoided.

Ownership

  • Be the single RevOps contact for Sales, CS, Marketing, Finance and Product. Turn each request into a task with an owner, date and success metric.

Requirements

  • 4-6+ years in RevOps, Sales Ops or GTM systems in B2B SaaS, with hands-on admin of a live Salesforce org.
  • Strong SQL and comfort in a modeled warehouse (layers, lineage, one definition per metric). dbt is a plus.
  • Deep knowledge of the B2B SaaS revenue cycle: funnel, pipeline, forecast, ARR, churn, renewals.
  • Experience running the money side: contracts, invoicing, collections, kept in sync with the CRM.
  • Proof you build with AI agents: something you shipped that others use.
  • Fluent English and clear written updates without being asked.

Nice to have

  • Salesforce Administrator or Advanced Administrator certification.
  • ClickHouse or another columnar warehouse, and any BI tool.
  • Salesforce development (Apex, triggers, API).
  • Gong, Clay, Lemlist, or workflow automation tools.
  • Billing, CPQ, or accounting systems.
  • HubSpot to Salesforce migration.
  • Attribution or CS health score data.
  • Martech or analytics company background.

What We Offer

  • Remote-first environment
  • Strong product/market fit: marketing data product for US-based enterprises
  • 20 working days of PTO per year
  • US holidays and additional days off
  • Professional development reimbursement

About the Role:

Grade Level (for internal use):

10

Sales Compensation Analyst – Commercial Modelling & Governance Automation


The Team

We are a high-accountability, globally connected Sales Compensation team that values disciplined execution, a strong sense of urgency, and end-to-end ownership. We expect our people to understand the full lifecycle of their work, anticipate downstream impacts, and communicate outcomes with exceptional clarity, whether supporting our broad population of 1,500+ plan participants or partnering with C-level executives. We value precision, responsiveness, sound judgment, collaboration, and people who take ownership through to resolution.


Responsibilities and Impact

This is a role for someone who sees a manual compensation process and immediately knows how to automate it. As the analytical and engineering engine behind S&P Global Market Intelligence's sales compensation function, you will convert complex commercial deal structures, multi-tier incentive plans, and governance controls into automated, audit-ready data models — building the infrastructure that makes accuracy scalable and compliance systematic. If you combine deep technical fluency in SQL, Python, and Power BI with a genuine understanding of how enterprise compensation works, this role offers the scope, the complexity, and the leadership exposure to match.

  • Translate and engineer complex commercial deal structures — including multi-year enterprise agreements, joint-production credit splits, co-selling models, and overlay allocations — into structured algorithmic logic and standardised business rules within the compensation calculation engine, eliminating manual offline adjustments and ensuring downstream calculation readiness.
  • Model and simulate the financial impact of proposed changes to compensation plans and crediting rules — running Python and SQL scenario analyses on historical payout data and partnering with Revenue Operations and Legal/Deal Desk to evaluate non-standard transaction structures for data feasibility and commercial accuracy.
  • Build and maintain automated reconciliation engines using Python, Alteryx, and SQL — cross-comparing ledger revenues, CRM bookings, and calculated commissionable revenue, and engineering variance detection models that automatically surface anomalies including revenue double-counting, territory misalignment, unassigned account credits, and clawback mismatches.
  • Design and maintain governance control frameworks — building systematic tracking mechanisms for all manual adjustments with full origin, justification, and approval trails; directing comprehensive quarterly and annual SOX audit documentation; and running automated control test queries to demonstrate end-to-end calculation traceability.
  • Architect and maintain enterprise Power BI reporting suites — developing advanced data models using DAX and Power Query M to visualise sales performance, attainment distributions, and compensation trends; building real-time Data Health and Anomaly monitoring dashboards; and presenting variance summaries, root cause analyses, and actionable insights directly to Finance and Commercial leadership.
  • Standardise operations and advise stakeholders — converting fragmented legacy workflows into structured SOPs with clear SLAs; serving as the senior technical point of contact for Commercial and Finance stakeholders by translating complex data logic and calculation outcomes into plain-English explanations; and conducting technical peer reviews of queries, code updates, and configuration changes prior to production deployment.

Compensation and Benefits (US Candidates Only)

S&P Global states that the anticipated base salary range for this position is $70,817 to $125,091. Final base salary for this role will be based on the individual's geographic location, as well as experience level, skill set, training, licenses and certifications.

In addition to base compensation, this role is eligible for an annual incentive plan. This role is eligible to receive additional S&P Global benefits. For more information on the benefits we provide to our employees, please visit:


What We Are Looking For

Basic Required Qualifications

  • Experience: 5+ years in sales compensation analytics, financial modelling, or commercial data governance within a multinational organisation.
  • SQL and Data Modelling: Advanced SQL proficiency for data modelling, validation, and complex multi-table reconciliation across ledger revenues, CRM systems, and compensation engines.
  • Automation and Scripting: Hands-on experience using Python/Pandas or Alteryx to build automated reconciliation workflows, variance detection models, and data pipeline scripts.
  • Power BI Development: Advanced Power BI expertise including data modelling, star schema design, complex DAX measures, and Power Query M transformations for enterprise-level reporting suites.
  • Governance and SOX Controls: Proven experience operating within SOX-compliance frameworks — designing audit-ready controls, running automated control test queries, and producing end-to-end calculation traceability documentation.

Additional Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience working within B2B SaaS or subscription-based sales compensation environments, including enterprise crediting rules, quota structures, and multi-tier incentive plan mechanics.
  • Demonstrated experience presenting complex data logic, calculation methodologies, and compensation model outcomes to Finance and Commercial executive leadership in clear, non-technical language.
  • Experience translating complex commercial contract mechanics — including multi-year enterprise agreements, joint-production credit splits, co-selling models, and overlay allocations — into structured algorithmic logic within enterprise compensation calculation engines.
  • Experience partnering with Revenue Operations and Legal/Deal Desk to evaluate non-standard transaction structures for data feasibility and downstream compensation calculation readiness.
  • Experience building real-time data health and anomaly monitoring dashboards that surface unmapped accounts, missing credit assignments, adjustment volume trends, and pipeline integrity issues.
  • Experience designing and maintaining standardised adjustment protocols with systematic approval trail tracking for manual compensation overrides.
  • Proven experience conducting technical peer reviews of SQL queries, automation scripts, and configuration changes prior to deployment in production compensation environments.

Right to Work Requirements

This role is limited to persons with indefinite right to work in the United States.

Advancing Essential Intelligence.

Our team is driven by curiosity and a shared belief that Essential Intelligence can help build a more prosperous future for us all.From finding new ways to measure sustainability to analyzing energy transition across the supply chain to building workflow solutions that make it easy to tap into insight and apply it. raw.description:
Company Description

Zayo provides mission-critical bandwidth to the world’s most impactful companies, fueling the innovations that are transforming our society. Zayo’s 141,000-mile network in North America and Europe includes extensive metro connectivity to thousands of buildings and data centers. Zayo’s communications infrastructure solutions include dark fiber, private data networks, wavelengths, Ethernet, and dedicated Internet access. Zayo serves wireless and wireline carriers, media, tech, content, finance, healthcare and other large enterprises.

Zayo is seeking a Senior Commercial Account Executive to be responsible for identifying, developing and closing new revenue opportunities within large and complex commercial accounts across assigned geographic territories in Zayo’s Commercial Enterprise Segment. The successful candidate will prospect for new customers while strategically developing relationships within existing accounts to identify additional sales opportunities and grow customers into long-term, multi-service relationships.


The Senior Commercial Account Executive will develop and execute strategic account plans and multi-threaded prospecting and customer engagement campaigns designed to reach multiple decision-makers, influencers and technical stakeholders within target accounts. The position is responsible for achieving assigned new MRR and revenue growth targets through strategic prospecting, account development and complex solution selling.


The ideal candidate has a strong understanding of Zayo’s Fiber Infrastructure, Transport, IP, SD-WAN, Edge and Security services and demonstrated success developing and closing complex opportunities involving multiple products, locations, stakeholders and customer requirements. The successful candidate will apply a consultative, trusted-advisor approach, independently orchestrate internal and customer resources throughout the sales process, and develop relationships that create sustained opportunities for new MRR growth.


Responsibilities:

  • Achieve and exceed assigned new MRR and revenue targets through the acquisition of new customers and development of additional sales opportunities within large and complex commercial accounts.
  • Develop and execute strategic territory and account plans that prioritize high-potential prospects and customers based on market opportunity, network capabilities, customer requirements and potential for long-term new MRR growth.
  • Leverage SalesLoft to design and execute targeted, multi-threaded account engagement campaigns across multiple personas, decision-makers and influencers, using personalization, sequencing and engagement insights to penetrate complex accounts, generate meetings and create new sales opportunities.
  • Proactively identify and prospect into high-value commercial accounts, developing wedge opportunities that establish Zayo within the customer and create a foundation for broader, multi-product relationships.
  • Build and maintain relationships with multiple customer stakeholders, including business leaders, technical decision-makers and influencers, to understand organizational priorities and uncover opportunities across locations, products and business units.
  • Conduct effective discovery with business and technical stakeholders to understand customer objectives, network requirements, challenges and future initiatives and translate those needs into relevant Zayo solutions.
  • Apply a consultative and trusted-advisor approach to develop and position solutions across Zayo’s Fiber Infrastructure, Transport, IP, SD-WAN, Edge and Security portfolio.
  • Develop and manage large and complex opportunities involving multiple products, locations, stakeholders and solution requirements, effectively coordinating the technical, commercial and operational resources required to advance the opportunity.
  • Drive opportunities through the entire sales process, including discovery, qualification, solution development, business-case development, proposal, commercial negotiation and close.
  • Develop newly acquired customers into long-term, multi-service relationships, continually identifying opportunities to expand Zayo’s presence and generate additional new MRR.
  • Follow the One Zayo Way sales process and consistently apply Zayo’s defined sales methodologies, tools and best practices to account planning, opportunity qualification, pipeline management, customer engagement and deal progression.
  • Maintain a healthy, appropriately qualified pipeline and provide accurate and timely forecasts in accordance with One Zayo Way expectations, ensuring opportunity stage, new MRR, close date, probability, customer commitments and next steps accurately reflect the current status of each opportunity.
  • Maintain timely and accurate account, contact, activity and opportunity information in Salesforce, providing clear visibility into account strategy, pipeline development and deal progression.
  • Collaborate and coordinate effectively across Sales Engineering, Product, Operations, Legal, Finance, Marketing and other internal organizations to develop solutions, remove obstacles and successfully close complex opportunities.
  • Maintain strong knowledge of Zayo’s network capabilities, product portfolio, competitive environment, assigned markets and emerging customer requirements to effectively identify and position new sales opportunities.
  • Share best practices and market insights with other members of the Regional Enterprise organization and contribute to a culture of disciplined prospecting, collaboration and sales execution.

Qualifications:

  • Bachelor’s degree or equivalent combination of education and relevant professional experience.
  • Minimum of five (5) years of successful B2B sales experience, preferably in telecommunications, technology, network infrastructure or a related industry.
  • Demonstrated success prospecting for new customers, developing accounts and consistently achieving or exceeding assigned sales and revenue targets.
  • Proven experience developing and closing large, complex B2B sales opportunities involving multiple customer stakeholders, locations, products or solution requirements.
  • Strong working knowledge of telecommunications and network infrastructure, with demonstrated knowledge of Fiber Infrastructure, Transport, IP, SD-WAN, Edge and/or Security services.
  • Demonstrated ability to conduct sophisticated discovery with business and technical stakeholders, understand customer objectives and translate requirements into compelling solutions.
  • Proven ability to multi-thread within customer organizations, developing relationships with multiple decision-makers, technical stakeholders and influencers.
  • Experience developing strategic account plans and executing targeted prospecting and account-development strategies against high-value prospects and customers.
  • Strong experience using SalesLoft or similar sales engagement platforms to execute targeted, multi-persona prospecting and customer engagement campaigns.
  • Demonstrated ability to independently manage complex opportunities through the complete sales process, including qualification, solution development, proposal, negotiation and close.
  • Strong proficiency with Salesforce CRM or similar platforms, with demonstrated discipline in opportunity management, pipeline development and sales forecasting.
  • Ability to consistently execute the One Zayo Way sales process and demonstrate strong discipline around account planning, opportunity qualification, pipeline management, forecasting and sales execution.
  • Strong business acumen with the ability to understand customer business drivers, articulate business value and effectively communicate with both technical and business audience.
  • Excellent verbal, written, presentation, negotiation and interpersonal communication skills.
  • Strong organizational and time-management skills with the ability to prioritize and manage multiple large accounts and complex opportunities simultaneously.
  • Self-motivated, competitive and accountable, with demonstrated ability to operate independently while effectively orchestrating cross-functional resources.
  • Ability to travel as required to support customers and territory activities.

Estimated base salary range: $62,600 - $83,500 CAD/annually.

Production Estimator

About the Role

We are looking for a proactive and detail-oriented Senior Modular Estimator to join our growing team. This role is ideal for someone with strong structural steel estimating fundamentals who enjoys working independently while collaborating closely with drafting, production, and project teams.

The role is approximately 60% estimating and 40% coordination/project support, including exposure to drafting and project coordination. While experience in modular construction is advantageous, we are happy to train candidates with solid structural steel estimating experience.

Key Responsibilities

Estimating (60%)

  • Prepare accurate cost estimates, BOQs, and quantity take-offs from structural, fabrication, architectural, and engineering drawings.
  • Review project documentation and identify scope gaps, risks, and cost considerations.
  • Interpret shop drawings and fabrication details to develop commercially competitive estimates.
  • Prepare and manage tender submissions within required timelines.
  • Obtain and evaluate supplier and subcontractor quotations.
  • Maintain accurate pricing records and estimating documentation.
  • Support continuous improvement of estimating processes and pricing accuracy.

Coordination & Project Support (40%)

  • Coordinate with drafting, procurement, engineering, and production teams to ensure smooth project handovers.
  • Liaise with internal stakeholders regarding project scope, timelines, and technical requirements.
  • Assist in reviewing drawings and project documentation to ensure constructability and commercial accuracy.
  • Proactively raise questions, clarify project requirements, and identify potential issues before pricing.
  • Support project delivery by coordinating changes, variations, and documentation throughout the estimating process.

What We're Looking For

Required Experience

Today, SCAN is a nonprofit health organization serving more than 500,000 people across Arizona, California, Nevada, New Mexico, Texas, and Washington, with over $8 billion in annual revenue. With nearly five decades of experience, we have built a distinctive, values-driven platform dedicated to improving care for older adults.

Our work spans Medicare Advantage, fully integrated care models, primary care, care for the most medically and socially complex populations, and next-generation care delivery models. Across all of this, we are united by a shared commitment: combining compassion with discipline, innovation with stewardship, and growth with integrity.

At SCAN, we believe scale should strengthen—not dilute—our mission. We are building the future of care for older adults, grounded in purpose, accountability, and respect for the people and communities we serve.

The Job


The HEDIS Nurse reviews medical records for Quality Initiatives/HEDIS® reporting. Conducts outreach to members and/or providers in coordination with departmental outreach campaigns to collect necessary data to ensure complete medical records and reporting information.


Will participate in many interdepartmental initiatives which requires phone discussions with members. The primary objective is to discuss medication adherence and specific procedures which members need to fill gaps in their care (i.e. Bone density testing, colorectal cancer screenings, etc.).

raw.description:
As a Cost Consultant at Turner & Townsend, you will be responsible for delivering cost planning and commercial management services across a range of workplace, retail, manufacturing, and technical projects for leading enterprise clients. Drawing on your contractor-side experience in estimating, bid evaluation, and change management, you will provide an informed owner’s perspective, establishing robust cost positions, challenging commercial assumptions, and delivering clear, evidence-based advice that supports effective decision-making. Working under the guidance of a Senior Cost Consultant or Director, you will progressively take ownership of project cost plans and commercial strategies, developing the expertise and confidence to manage the commercial position throughout the full project lifecycle.


Responsibilities:

  • Prepare cost estimates and cost plans from concept through close-out for tenant improvement, remodel, and new build projects, including quantity takeoffs in Bluebeam and pricing in CSI MasterFormat structures.
  • Build and maintain parametric and hybrid cost models under senior direction, contributing clean, consistently coded data to the team's benchmarking library.
  • Lead bid leveling and GC and subcontractor bid analysis: qualify scope, normalize exclusions and allowances, and present a clear recommendation with the basis stated.
  • Test contractor pricing against takeoff-based estimates, historical data, and market intelligence, and explain variances rather than accept them.
  • Support value engineering by identifying scope and specification alternatives with quantified cost and schedule impact.
  • Administer the commercial position on assigned projects: review change orders for entitlement, scope, and pricing against the contract documents and field conditions, and recommend approve, reject, or negotiate.
  • Maintain the change, purchase order, and pay application registers, and reconcile pay applications to approved values and work in place.
  • Prepare cashflow, accrual, and estimate-at-completion forecasts aligned to the project schedule, and flag commercial exposure early.
  • Form and state a view on cost and risk with the reasoning visible: what the data supports, what it does not, and what you would need to be more certain.
  • Present cost and risk positions to client project teams in an observational, evidence-first voice, and escalate to senior colleagues when a position needs to be held under challenge.
  • Contribute project-level data and insight to portfolio capital planning and program reporting.
  • Keep register-driven templates, WBS, and cost code structures clean and consistent so program-level reporting and AI tooling can rely on them.
  • Identify repeatable analysis in your own work and, with senior colleagues, turn it into reusable templates and checklists.
  • Document methods, assumptions, and lessons so your outputs are reproducible by others.
  • Support onboarding and review for analysts, and model disciplined, well-organized delivery.
  • Apply client contract provisions and financial policies consistently, including SOX controls where applicable.
  • Bachelor's degree in construction management, architectural engineering, quantity surveying, or a related field preferred, with three to six years of relevant experience. In lieu of a degree, a combination of experience and education will be considered.
  • Hands-on experience in construction estimating and commercial administration, including quantity takeoffs, subcontractor bid leveling, subcontract and change order review, and submittal and procurement log management. Contractor-side experience on tenant improvement and renovation projects is directly relevant.
  • Working knowledge of CSI MasterFormat, change order mechanics, contingency, and basic cashflow forecasting; willingness to develop fluency in GMP reconciliation, escalation, and AACE estimate classification.
  • Ability to read and apply contract documents, including subcontract and general contractor contract provisions, and to verify proposed changes against drawings, specifications, and field conditions.
  • Proficiency in Bluebeam and Excel, including formula-driven estimates; familiarity with construction management platforms such as Viewpoint, Building Connected, or Procore. Interest in Python, BI tools, or AI-assisted analysis is a plus.
  • Organized, detail-oriented, and comfortable leading meetings and driving follow-up actions with project stakeholders.
  • Clear written and verbal communication, with the judgment to know when to bring a question or exposure to a senior colleague.
  • Progress toward a professional designation such as CCP, MRICS, or PMP is encouraged.

*On-site presence and requirements may change depending on our client's needs.

The base salary range for this role is $120,000-$150,000 USD. This range reflects the company's good faith estimate of the base salary for this position at the time of the posting. Final compensation will be determined based on factors including experience, skills, qualifications, and internal equity. In addition to base salary, employees may be eligible for bonuses and a comprehensive benefits package.

raw.excerpt: About EthosEthos (Nasdaq: $LIFE) is a leading life insurance technology company on a mission to protect families by democratizing access to life insurance and empowering agents at scale.
raw.description:
About Ethos

Ethos (Nasdaq: $LIFE) is a leading life insurance technology company on a mission to protect families by democratizing access to life insurance and empowering agents at scale. With its robust three-sided technology platform, Ethos is transforming the life insurance experience for consumers, agents, and carriers alike. Ethos offers instant, accessible products and a seamless online process that requires no medical exams and just a few health questions; it eliminates traditional barriers, making it easier than ever for everyone to protect their families. Ethos is redefining how life insurance is bought, sold, and underwritten.

About the role

Ethos is looking for a Staff Site Reliability Engineer to serve as a technical leader for our SRE organization in the US. In this role, you will help set the technical direction for how Ethos builds, runs, and scales production systems, from our core AWS and Kubernetes infrastructure to the internal platforms and toolchains that power our AI initiatives.

This is a senior, hands-on individual contributor role with organization-wide scope. You will design and build critical infrastructure yourself, lead cross-team initiatives from conception to delivery, and raise the reliability bar across engineering by partnering closely with product teams, up to and including submitting PRs to their codebases. You will work alongside SRE leadership in the US and Bangalore to shape the roadmap, and you will be a go-to technical authority for reliability, scalability, security, and cost-efficiency.

Duties and Responsibilities:

Technical Leadership & Strategy

  • Set Direction: Define and drive the multi-quarter technical strategy for reliability, infrastructure, and platform tooling, in partnership with SRE and engineering leadership and aligned with company OKRs.
  • Architecture: Lead the design of complex, cross-cutting infrastructure systems. Author and review technical specifications and architecture proposals to ensure consistency, resilience, and long-term maintainability.
  • Influence Without Authority: Motivate product engineering teams to adopt reliability best practices, and act as a trusted advisor on production readiness when new services are designed and brought online.
  • Mentorship: Grow the technical skills of SREs across our US and Bangalore teams through design reviews, pairing, and code review, and help raise the hiring bar by participating in interviews.

Reliability & Performance Engineering

  • Service Standards: Establish the framework for how teams define, measure, and act on SLIs, SLOs, and error budgets. Help teams instrument and monitor them.
  • Incident Excellence: Serve as a senior technical leader during high-severity incidents. Drive a culture of rigorous, blameless post-mortems and ensure follow-up work actually reduces recurrence.
  • Resilience: Lead capacity planning, disaster recovery, and failure-mode testing so our systems degrade gracefully and recover quickly.
  • Observability: Evolve our monitoring and alerting strategy so failures are detected before they impact customers and on-call is sustainable.

Infrastructure & AI Platform Tooling

  • Scalable Systems: Design, build, and operate our AWS cloud infrastructure using Infrastructure as Code (Terraform), Kubernetes, and GitOps workflows (ArgoCD, Atlantis).
  • AI Gateway & Governance: Architect and build governed gateways for AI model routing, including model access controls, audit trails, and secure data connectors (such as MCP) that prevent sensitive data exposure.
  • Security & Compliance: Ensure infrastructure, including AI prototyping environments, meets security and regulatory requirements through automated scanning, PII guardrails, and scoped data access.

Efficiency & Cost Optimization

  • FinOps: Lead initiatives to optimize cloud spend across the organization, including right-sizing, spot instance utilization, and cost attribution.
  • AI Cost Management: Design metering and budgeting for LLM token usage, and build cost-aware routing so workloads use the most efficient model for the job.
  • Visibility: Establish clear cost metrics and partner with engineering teams on architectures that are both performant and cost-effective.

Developer Productivity

  • Paved Roads: Build internal tools, CI/CD pipelines, and self-service platforms that make the reliable path the easy path for product engineering teams.
  • Toil Elimination: Identify systemic sources of toil across engineering and automate them away.

Qualifications and Skills:

  • Experience: 10+ years of full-time software engineering experience in relevant roles (SRE, Infrastructure, Platform, DevOps, or Backend SWE), including significant time operating production systems at scale.
  • Staff-Level Impact: A track record of leading complex, multi-team infrastructure or reliability initiatives from ambiguity to delivery, and of influencing technical direction beyond your immediate team.
  • Software Engineering: Strong coding skills in Golang, Python, or TypeScript, and a commitment to engineering best practices: design patterns, code reviews, and testing.
  • Cloud & Platform Expertise: Deep, hands-on experience with AWS, Kubernetes, and Terraform. Experience building Kubernetes operators is a plus.
  • Systems Knowledge: Strong understanding of distributed systems, PostgreSQL, CI/CD systems, and observability tooling such as DataDog.
  • Reliability Practice: Hands-on experience implementing SLIs/SLOs, leading incident response, and running effective post-mortems.

Imagine yourself…

It’s all possible with a role at Esko. Esko, a Veralto company, is a global provider of integrated software and hardware solutions that accelerate the go-to-market process of packaged goods. Our integrated platform and comprehensive tools empower retailers, pre-media and trade shops, manufacturers, and converters to manage best-in-class packaging design and print processes.


Innovation in the is built into the DNA of our business: every day, we challenge ourselves to be better by seeking out new ways to elevate our products, our processes, and our people.


We also know that innovation and ingenuity starts with prioritizing a diverse workforce and a deeply inclusive workplace. We encourage people from all backgrounds to apply to our positions. 


Reporting to the Global Controller, the Financial Compliance Lead is responsible for global internal controls and US-GAAP compliance, ensuring adherence to Veralto and Esko accounting policies. The role drives best financial practices, manages SOX compliance, and coordinates audits. The position also plays a key role in participating in the month-end closing process.


This is a remote position with regular visits to the Ghent office few times a year.


In this role, a typical day will look like:

  • Serve as the super user for AuditBoard, overseeing audit and compliance software usage.
  • Define, assure, and execute the global SOX program across Esko.
  • Lead the definition and optimization of Internal Controls and ensure US-GAAP compliance, including Veralto and Esko policies (CAPEX, Revenue Recognition, Leasing, etc.).
  • Act as a subject matter expert in accounting and finance policies, especially revenue recognition and lease accounting.
  • Drive the implementation of best-in-class financial processes and internal controls across Esko’s global operations.
  • Coordinate enterprise-wide risk initiatives (e.g., Anti-Corruption Program, ERM) and manage the annual Balance Sheet review for all Esko entities in collaboration with Veralto teams and auditors.

The essential requirements of the job include:

  • Master’s degree in economics, finance, or equivalent.
  • At least 3 years of experience in internal/external audit or controlling in an international setting; Big Four experience is a plus.
  • Hands-on SOX experience, particularly with sections 404 and 302.
  • Fluent in English (oral and written); proficiency in other languages is a plus. Comfortable with global travel (up to 10%).
  • IT-savvy, with a knack for optimizing financial processes; proficient in Advanced Excel and other reporting tools, with strong analytical skills.

Esko is proud to part of the Product Quality & Innovation segment of Veralto (NYSE: VLTO), a $5B global leader dedicated to ensuring access to clean water, safe food and medicine, and trusted essential goods. When you join Veralto’s vibrant global network of 16,000 associates, you join a unique culture and work environment where purpose meets possibility: where the work you do has an everyday impact on the resources and essentials we all rely on, and where you’ll have valuable opportunities to deepen your skillset, pursue your ambitions, and grow your career. Together, we’re Safeguarding the World’s Most Vital Resources™—and building rewarding careers along the way.


At Veralto, we value diversity and the existence of similarities and differences, both visible and not, found in our workforce, workplace and throughout the markets we serve.Our associates, customers and shareholders contribute unique and different perspectives as a result of these diverse attributes.
