raw.excerpt: Who we areSamsara (NYSE: IOT) is the pioneer of the Connected Operations™ Cloud, which is a platform that enables organizations that depend on physical operations to harness Internet of Things (IoT) data to develop actionable insights and improve their operations.
raw.description:
Who we are

Samsara (NYSE: IOT) is the pioneer of the Connected Operations™ Cloud, which is a platform that enables organizations that depend on physical operations to harness Internet of Things (IoT) data to develop actionable insights and improve their operations. At Samsara, we are helping improve the safety, efficiency and sustainability of the physical operations that power our global economy. Representing more than 40% of global GDP, these industries are the infrastructure of our planet, including agriculture, construction, field services, transportation, and manufacturing — and we are excited to help digitally transform their operations at scale.

Working at Samsara means you’ll help define the future of physical operations and be on a team that’s shaping an exciting array of product solutions, including Video-Based Safety, Vehicle Telematics, Apps and Driver Workflows, and Equipment Monitoring. As part of a recently public company, you’ll have the autonomy and support to make an impact as we build for the long term.

About the role:

Samsara’s Machine Learning, AI, Analytics & Data (MAAD) team builds the intelligence and technology that helps our go-to-market teams work faster, make better decisions, and spend more time with customers.

As the Director, GTM AI Engineering you’ll run our AI Engineering team for GTM. You’ll work closely with Data Science, Analytics, and Data Engineering to serve Sales, Customer Success, Support, Enablement, and GTM leadership. This is a hands-on Director role. Expect to spend about 70% of your time building (prototyping agents, writing code, designing evals) and about 30% leading the team, setting strategy, and influencing stakeholders.

You’ll build intelligent workflow experiences. That ranges from AI agents and copilots that take manual work off sellers’ plates, to signals for propensity and prioritization, to the data, evaluation, and measurement foundations that make these products reliable and trusted.

The ideal candidate is AI-native. You already run your own work through agents every day, you’ve shipped AI products to production, and you get as excited about a seller’s first “wow, this saved me an hour” moment as you do about a clean architecture.

This is a remote position open to candidates residing in the US.

In this role, you will:

  • Build hands-on. Prototype, ship, and iterate on AI agents, copilots, and workflow automations for GTM teams, from the first demo to a production system people rely on.
  • Build the platform, not just the apps. Own the architecture of the shared GTM AI platform: orchestration, LLM and tool gateways, identity and access, and the MCP and SDK contracts that let the GTM web app, Salesforce, Slack, desktop, and Claude plugins share one set of governed capabilities.
  • Make evals a first-class discipline. Design evaluation frameworks for agent and LLM behavior, including golden datasets, LLM-as-judge, human review loops, and regression suites, and run them in development and production. Use transcript analysis and eval results to find failures, guide what to fix first, and show quality improving over time.
  • Lead with AI day to day. Use agents, coding assistants, and agent harnesses in your own daily work, and build the shared tooling, patterns, and harnesses that make the whole team faster.
  • Stay ahead of the curve. Track new models, agent frameworks, MCP and tool ecosystems, and context engineering, and turn them into practical recommendations for Samsara's GTM use cases: what to adopt, what to test, and what to ignore. Make clear build-versus-buy calls on vendor tools, not just models.
  • Drive adoption with the field. Be the go-to advocate for AI across Sales, CS, and Support. Run demos, earn credibility with reps and frontline managers, collect real feedback, and turn skeptics into power users.
  • Set the strategy. Own the technical and product strategy for GTM AI, including the data foundations, instrumentation, governance, and observability these products depend on. Decide which prototypes move onto the shared platform, which merge, and which retire. Own model routing across vendors and the per-user spend controls that keep AI cost in line with value. Influence senior leaders on AI priorities, investment, and the operating model.
  • Ship revenue-critical intelligence. Own the forecasting, propensity, and CRM data-quality work that sales leadership acts on, and keep it calibrated, validated, and clear about its limits. Be comfortable across data and analytics engineering, and act as a business leader when the work calls for it.
  • Partner across GTM, Product, and Engineering. Work with Sales, Customer Success, Support, Enablement, Operations, Product, and Engineering leaders to find high-value opportunities, define success metrics, and turn them into durable products.
  • Build for trust. Put a pragmatic responsible-AI approach in place: safety, privacy, reliability, and human-in-the-loop workflows with clear approval and escalation paths. Agents that act on CRM and customer data run with per-user, least-privilege permissions, and changes to systems of record get human approval first.
  • Automatically included
    • All Roles: Champion, role model, and embed Samsara’s cultural principles (Focus on Customer Success, Build for the Long Term, Adopt a Growth Mindset, Be Inclusive, Win as a Team) as we scale globally and across new offices
    • People Manager Roles: Hire, develop and lead an inclusive, engaged, and high performing AI Engineering team

Minimum requirements for the role:

  • 10+ years across software engineering, machine learning, data science, or data platforms, including meaningful leadership experience. You still write code regularly.
  • Bachelor’s degree or equivalent relevant work experience.
  • Hands-on experience building and shipping LLM applications and agentic workflows to production, including tool use, retrieval, context engineering, and production reliability.
  • Production full-stack and cloud engineering experience (for example Python or TypeScript, AWS, and Databricks), including owning systems that other teams depend on.
  • Demonstrated experience designing and running evaluation frameworks for LLM or agent systems, and using them to drive quality decisions.
  • Daily, fluent use of AI agents and coding assistants in your own work, and a point of view on how they change the way teams build.
  • A track record of shipping internal or customer-facing AI/ML products with measurable business impact.
  • Experience with predictive modeling, experimentation, analytics, and data engineering foundations.
  • Strong product judgment and the ability to turn ambiguous business problems into simple, valuable solutions.
  • Excellent communication with both executives and frontline users. You can demo to a sales floor and present to a VP on the same day.
  • A people-first leadership style with a track record of hiring, developing, and keeping strong technical talent.

An ideal candidate also has:

  • Experience building AI or decisioning products for Sales, Customer Success, Support, Marketing, or other GTM functions, ideally in a fast-growing enterprise SaaS environment.
  • Experience with CRM, customer data, support, and knowledge-management systems (such as Salesforce, Gong, Gainsight, Zendesk, and Databricks), and connecting agents to them (for example, through MCP servers or similar integrations).
  • Experience with agent SDKs and harnesses (such as Claude Code / Agent SDK, OpenAI Agents SDK, LangGraph, or similar) and LLM observability tooling, eval tooling such as Braintrust or MLflow, and model APIs from Anthropic, OpenAI, and Google.
  • Experience operating AI products at scale, including cost management, monitoring, and governance.
  • A visible habit of learning in public, such as writing, talks, open-source work, or internal “what’s new in AI” sessions.

$182,000—$325,000 USD

Total Rewards

At Samsara, we build for the people who keep the global economy moving. We want owners, not passengers, which is why our rewards are designed to fuel high-impact builders. Our compensation program delivers above-market total compensation through a combination of base salary, performance-based bonus/variable pay, and equity (for eligible roles) in a high-growth public company. We meaningfully differentiate pay for our top performers, who have the opportunity to earn above-market compensation that can outpace the broader market over time.

Beyond compensation, we provide the foundations that enable long-term success: a flexible, employee-led remote model, a professional development stipend, comprehensive health and parental leave plans, and more. If you’re ready to build for the long term and own the outcome, your journey starts here.

Flexible Working

At Samsara, we embrace a flexible working model that caters to the diverse needs of our teams. Our offices are open for those who prefer to work in-person and we also support remote work where it aligns with our operational requirements. For certain positions, being close to one of our offices or within a specific geographic area is important to facilitate collaboration, access to resources, or alignment with our service regions. In these cases, the job description will clearly indicate any working location requirements. Our goal is to ensure that all members of our team can contribute effectively, whether they are working on-site, in a hybrid model, or fully remotely. All offers of employment are contingent upon an individual’s ability to secure and maintain the legal right to work at the company and in the specified work location, if applicable.

Belonging at Samsara

At Samsara, we welcome everyone regardless of their background. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, national origin, sex, gender, gender identity, sexual orientation, protected veteran status, disability, age, and other characteristics protected by law. We depend on the unique approaches of our team members to help us solve complex problems and want to ensure that Samsara is a place where people from all backgrounds can make an impact.

Accommodations

Samsara is an inclusive work environment, and we are committed to ensuring equal opportunity in employment for qualified persons with disabilities. Please email or click here if you require any reasonable accommodations throughout the recruiting process.

Our Commitment to Authenticity

We use Tofu, a fraud detection tool, to validate the authenticity of applications and protect against identity fraud. This ensures we are connecting with real people and allows us to prioritize genuine candidates. Please see Samsara’s Candidate Privacy Notice for more information.

Fraudulent Employment Offers

Samsara is aware of scams involving fake job interviews and offers. Please know we do not charge fees to applicants at any stage of the hiring process. Official communication about your application will only come from emails ending in @samsara.com, @us-greenhouse-mail.io or @mail3.guide.co. We, at Leggett & Platt Inc., are searching for a Sr. EHS Specialistwithin our EHSteam to help support our UK Spring business. Did you know we have been revolutionizing the sleep industry since 1883? That’s right! In fact, we hold the original patent on a spiral steel coil bed spring, filed way back in 1885. Since then, we have been an industry leader in guaranteeing you get the best sleep possible. If you join our team, your work will ensure people across the world have a little more comfort in their lives.

As a Sr. EHS Specialist you will have the opportunity to support and strengthen EHS’ performance across its European operations. Reporting directly to the Regional EHS Manager, this role works closely with site EHS representatives and site leadership to help improve compliance, reduce risk, support practical EHS solutions, and promote consistent execution of BU and corporate EHS expectations. The role requires strong EHS and Occupational Safety and Health (OSH) knowledge, good judgment, and the ability to work independently while knowing when to escalate complex or high-risk matters.

So, what will you be doing as a Sr. EHS Specialist?

  1. Leadership & Strategy
  • Support regional EHS plans and improvement activities aligned with corporate goals, BU priorities, and site-specific risks across Europe.
  • Serve as a regional EHS resource to site leadership teams on regulatory expectations, safety culture, employee engagement, and practical risk reduction.
  • Work independently to assess site needs, prioritize EHS actions, and recommend practical solutions, escalating complex or high-risk matters to the Regional EHS Manager as required.
  • Maintain visible field presence during site visits and provide hands-on guidance to local leaders, supervisors, employees, and EHS representatives.
  • Identify EHS capability gaps at assigned sites and help strengthen local ownership, accountability, and execution.
  • Promote consistent adoption of corporate EHS expectations while interpreting country-specific regulatory requirements and operating practices.
  1. Incident Management & Corrective Action
  • Work collectively with site EHS representatives and site leadership to ensure incidents, near misses, and hazards are reported and investigated by the responsible site teams in accordance with company expectations.
  • Assist with incident investigations as needed, particularly for complex, recurring, or higher-risk events, by helping site teams evaluate facts, identify root causes, develop corrective actions, and consider the hierarchy of controls.
  • Analyze incident trends and recurring findings to identify systemic prevention opportunities and recommend practical process improvements.
  • Share lessons learned and support preventive actions across assigned facilities.
  1. Compliance & Risk Management
  • Monitor and support compliance with applicable EU-level requirements, national implementing legislation, and country-specific environmental and occupational safety and health requirements.
  • Conduct and support site inspections and assessments related to workplace conditions, work equipment, machinery safety, chemical management, dangerous substances, occupational exposure risks, emergency preparedness, and EHS program implementation.
  • Interpret internal and external compliance challenges and recommend best practices to improve EHS processes, controls, and site-level execution.
  • Develop practical action plans to close regulatory, program, and risk-control gaps and monitor progress through sustainable completion.
  • Provide technical guidance for environmental compliance activities, including waste management, hazardous substances, air and water requirements, permits, regulatory reporting, sustainability data, and related inspections or records.
  • Support implementation of ISO 14001, ISO 45001, REACH, CLP, ATEX, machinery safety, work equipment, and other applicable EHS requirements where relevant to assigned operations.
  • Support emergency response plans, first aid, fire prevention, procedures, drills, and preparedness activities based on local site risks and regulatory expectations.
  1. Training & Development
  • Provide guidance/assistance to sites in coordination of required EHS training, including new hire orientation, annual compliance training, regional program rollouts, and site-specific safety topics.
  • Evaluate training needs based on incident trends, compliance findings, risk assessments, operational changes, worker feedback, site leadership input, and emerging regulatory expectations.
  • Coach site leaders and EHS representatives on safety communication, hazard recognition, worker engagement, accountability, and practical risk control.
  • Help strengthen site-level EHS knowledge and capabilities through education, coaching, technical guidance, and practical support.
  1. Performance Monitoring
  • Track, evaluate, and communicate leading and lagging EHS indicators, including injuries, near misses, hazard observations, inspections, audit findings, corrective actions, and training completion.
  • Analyze EHS performance data to identify trends, recurring risks, and improvement opportunities that may affect compliance, operations, projects, or service objectives.
  • Prepare routine and ad hoc reports that communicate trends, priorities, risks, and recommended improvement actions to site, BU, and corporate leadership.
  • Partner with site managers to develop measurable action plans, assign clear ownership, and monitor progress through completion.
  • Maintain accurate EHS documentation, records, reports, and system entries in accordance with company and regulatory expectations.
  1. Audits & Program Management
  • Lead periodic EHS audits and assessments to evaluate compliance, risk-control implementation, and program effectiveness.
  • Lead or support functional EHS projects with moderate risk or complexity, including regional program rollouts, corrective action initiatives, and continuous improvement efforts within assigned operations.
  • Help implement corporate EHS programs, tools, standards, and improvement initiatives in a way that fits regional and site-specific needs.
  • Follow up on audit findings and program gaps to ensure timely closure, effective verification, and sustainable improvement.
  1. Stakeholder Engagement
  • Partner with HR, Operations, Legal, Engineering, Maintenance, site leadership, worker representatives, safety committees, and external agencies to support EHS initiatives and practical risk reduction.
  • Communicate complex or sensitive EHS/OSH topics clearly and professionally, while helping build agreement on required actions.
  • Influence leaders and cross-functional partners to improve compliance, reduce risk, and strengthen EHS execution.
  • Support site engagement with workers, worker representatives, and applicable safety committees in accordance with local consultation and participation requirements.
  • Represent Leggett & Platt professionally during regulatory inspections, agency interactions, customer inquiries, and industry forums.
  • Support customer sustainability inquiries related to finished goods by coordinating EHS, environmental, and product-related information as needed.

To be successful in this role, you’ll need:

  • Relevant Environmental, Health & Safety qualification, certification, or equivalent regional credential preferred, such as a NEBOSH, NVQ Level 5/6, or comparable qualification; equivalent professional experience may be considered.
  • Minimum of 5–7 years of progressive EHS experience, preferably in a manufacturing or industrial environment with multi-site, regional, or cross-functional exposure.
  • In-depth practical knowledge of applicable EU-level EHS/OSH requirements, national implementing legislation, country-specific regulations, standards, and compliance expectations.
  • Strong practical knowledge of EU OSH principles and applicable environmental, chemical, machinery safety, work equipment, occupational exposure, waste management, and emergency preparedness requirements is preferred.
  • Demonstrates ability to identify known, potential, and emerging workplace hazards and recommend sustainable risk-reduction solutions.
  • Experience assisting with incident investigations, root cause analysis, corrective action development, and verification of corrective action effectiveness in partnership with responsible site teams.
  • Strong written and verbal communication skills, including the ability to explain complex or sensitive EHS information, prepare reports, communicate expectations, and influence others without direct authority.
  • Ability to work effectively across cultures, languages, and geographically dispersed operations.
  • Ability to travel regularly within Europe as business needs require.
  • Specialized EHS expertise with strong field presence and the ability to build trust with site leadership and employees.
  • Practical understanding of manufacturing operations, EHS controls, business priorities, and how EHS execution impacts operational performance.
  • Ability to guide others through complex problem solving using data, judgment, technical experience, and multiple sources of information.
  • Ability to communicate clearly, build agreement, influence action, and reinforce accountability across functions and cultures.
  • Ability to balance hands-on site engagement with broader regional priorities, project leadership, and sustainable program execution.
  • Ability to respond calmly and professionally to emergencies, regulatory inquiries, and changing priorities.

Things we consider a plus:

  • Experience supporting EHS programs in a multi-country European manufacturing environment.
  • Experience with manufacturing-related EHS programs such as ergonomics, machinery safety, work equipment, contractor safety, chemical management, and occupational exposure controls.
  • Experience using cloud-based EHS/EMS software platforms such as Enablon, Benchmark Gensuite, or similar systems.
  • Proficiency with Microsoft 365 tools, including Teams, SharePoint, Outlook, Excel, Word, and PowerPoint.
  • Multilingual communication skills.

What to Do Next

Now that you’ve had a chance to learn more about us, what are you waiting for! Apply today and allow us the opportunity to learn more about you and the value you can bring to our team. Once you apply, be sure to create a profile, and sign up for job alerts, so you can be the first to know when new opportunities become available.

Our Values

Our values speak to our shared beliefs, and describe how we approach working together.

  • Put People First reflects our commitment to safety and care of each other, learning and development, and creating an inclusive environment of mutual respect, empathy and belonging.
  • Do the Right Thing focuses us on acting with honesty and integrity, delivering the results the right way, taking pride in our work, and speaking the truth – good or bad.
  • Do Great Work…Together occurs when we engage without hierarchy, collaborate as a team, embrace challenges, and work for the good of all of us.
  • Take Ownership and Raise the Bar demonstrates our responsibility to add value and make a difference, challenge the status quo and biases to make things better, foster innovative and creative solutions to drive impact, and explore new perspectives and embrace change.

Our Commitment to You

We're actively taking steps to make sure our culture is inclusive and that our processes and practices promote equity for all. Leggett & Platt is comprised of people of all abilities, gender identities and expressions, ages, ethnicities, sexual orientations, veteran status, and more. Join us!

We welcome and encourage applications if you meet the minimum qualifications. Even if you do not meet the preferred qualifications, we’d love the opportunity to consider you.

raw.title: Senior Solutions Engineer, Acquisition | Central | Remote
raw.excerpt: Grafana Labs is the company behind Grafana Cloud, the fully managed observability platform trusted by more than 10,000 organizations to ensure reliability, resolve incidents faster, and optimize telemetry at scale.
raw.description:
Grafana Labs is the company behind Grafana Cloud, the fully managed observability platform trusted by more than 10,000 organizations to ensure reliability, resolve incidents faster, and optimize telemetry at scale. Built on open source and open standards and designed for interoperability across any stack, Grafana Cloud brings AI to observability and observability to AI, giving teams (and their agents) unified visibility so they can see, understand, and act on all their disparate data, wherever it lives, and move at the speed of their ambitions. Customers, including Anthropic, Bloomberg, NVIDIA, Microsoft, and Salesforce, rely on Grafana Labs. We are a 100% remote company with team members across 40+ countries, backed by leading investors including Lightspeed Venture Partners, Sequoia Capital, GIC, Coatue, J.P. Morgan, CapitalG, and Lead Edge Capital. Learn more at and follow us on LinkedIn and X.

We’re scaling fast and staying true to what makes us different: an open-source legacy, a global collaborative culture, and a passion for meaningful work. Our team thrives in an innovation-driven environment where transparency, autonomy, and trust fuel everything we do.

You may not meet every requirement, and that’s okay. If this role excites you, we’d love you to raise your hand for what could be a truly career-defining opportunity.

The Opportunity:

Make a difference.

Are you looking for something new in your career? Enjoy a challenge? Love to innovate and learn? This is an exciting opportunity to join a technology startup in a high growth phase. Our Enterprise Solutions Engineering team are our in-house, customer-facing product experts. The Enterprise SE team enables Grafana Labs worldwide growth by educating potential and existing customers to ensure they are happy and successful. We share our technical and product expertise with customers through demos, hands-on enablement, presentations, technical evaluations and ongoing interaction. We also partner closely with our Sales team to help qualify and close opportunities. The Commercial SE team is also one of the primary routes of communication from our customers through into the Product Management and Engineering teams.

What You’ll Be Doing:

  • Join as an early member of a high growth team working together to solve technical and customer problems the right way
  • Partner with our Sales team to articulate the overall Grafana value proposition, vision, and strategy to customers
  • Own the technical engagement with customers and help to close high-velocity opportunities through advanced competitive knowledge, technical skill, and credibility
  • Deliver product and technical presentations to potential and existing customers
  • Proactively communicate with customers and internal teams to provide a feedback loop on our products and the competitive landscape
  • Drive product conversations based on need and problems learned during customer interactions
  • Work with the team to enhance documentation, write blog posts, record videos, contribute knowledge base articles, and create other public and internal enablement material

What Makes You a Great Fit:

  • Ideally located in Minnesota, Wisconsin, Chicago, Michigan, Indiana, Ohio
  • 5+ years of technical pre-sales experience, ideally with Open Source technologies, or in the Metrics/Monitoring space while we will be adding more junior folks later on, right now we just need team members that can hit the ground running.
  • We’re a startup so your job duties will be varied and complex and will require strong judgment, collaboration, and leadership
  • We are a remote-first company so you would need to learn to work and collaborate with an international team
  • You will need first class written and oral communication skills to collaborate with our remote-first internal teams and with our worldwide customers. You will need to be able to skillfully articulate our value proposition and the technical advantages of our products
  • You will love solving technical challenges and thrive on bringing creative solutions to our customers
  • You should have a technical mindset and a desire to grow technically. Great candidates may be a recent grad of a coding bootcamp or have previous post-sales or engineering experience–we are excited to see what unique experiences and skill sets you bring to the table!
  • You are self-motivated, initiative, creative, and maybe you’ve already done a brave thing or two in your life!

Compensation & Rewards:

In the United States the OTE (On-Target Earnings) compensation range for this role is $204,000 - $254,000. Actual compensation may vary based on level, experience, and skillset as assessed throughout the interview process. All of our roles include Restricted Stock Units (RSUs), giving every team member ownership in Grafana Labs' success. We believe in shared outcomes—RSUs help us stay aligned and invested as we scale globally.

*Compensation ranges are country specific. If you are applying for this role from a different location than listed above, your recruiter will discuss your specific market’s defined pay range & benefits at the beginning of the process.

Why You’ll Thrive at Grafana Labs:

  • 100% Remote, Global Culture - As a remote-only company, we bring together talent from around the world, united by a culture of collaboration and shared purpose.
  • Scaling Organization – Tackle meaningful work in a high-growth, ever-evolving environment.
  • Transparent Communication – Expect open decision-making and regular company-wide updates.
  • Innovation-Driven – Autonomy and support to ship great work and try new things.
  • Open Source Roots – Built on community-driven values that shape how we work.
  • Empowered Teams – High trust, low ego culture that values outcomes over optics.
  • Career Growth Pathways – Defined opportunities to grow and develop your career.
  • Approachable Leadership – Transparent execs who are involved, visible, and human.
  • Passionate People – Join a team of smart, supportive folks who care deeply about what they do.
  • In-Person onboarding - We want you to thrive from day 1 with your fellow new ‘Grafanistas’ to learn all about what we do and how we do it.
  • Balance is Key - We operate a global annual leave policy of 30 days per annum. 3 days of your annual leave entitlement are reserved for Grafana Shutdown Days to allow the team to really disconnect. *We will comply with local legislation where applicable.

Equal Opportunity Employer:Grafana Labs is an equal opportunities employer. We welcome applications from everyone regardless of race, colour, nationality, origin, caste, sex, gender reassignment identity or expression, sexual orientation, age, religion or belief, disability, veteran status, genetic information, pregnancy, maternity, marital, family or carer status, or any other characteristic which is protected by local law. We believe that equality and diversity build a strong organisation, and we work hard to ensure that is the foundation of our organisation as we grow.

Grafana Labs may utilize AI tools in its recruitment process to assist in matching information provided in CVs to job postings. The recruitment team will continue to review inbound CVs manually to identify alignment with current openings.

For information about how your personal data is used once you’ve applied to a job, check out our privacy policy.

raw.description:
All roles at JumpCloud® are Remote unless otherwise specified in the Job Description.

About JumpCloud®

JumpCloud® is the AI-powered unified IT management platform designed to secure the modern workforce. By consolidating identity, device, and access management, JumpCloud provides intelligent, secure IT that scales from human users to autonomous AI agents. We help organizations around the globe eliminate complexity and turn AI risk into an optimized advantage, ensuring the right people and agents have secure access to the right resources at all times.

JumpCloud is Intelligent, Secure IT.

As Manager, Sales Engineering, you will lead, coach, and scale a distributed team of Sales Engineers across multiple countries to drive technical wins and accelerate JumpCloud’s international revenue growth. You will bridge people leadership, commercial strategy, and technical judgment to solve complex identity, access, and unified device management challenges for modern IT environments. By establishing rigorous business and technical discovery, value-based demonstrations, and focused Proofs of Value (POVs), you ensure predictable deal progression and eliminate technical friction throughout the sales cycle. Additionally, you will optimize SE resource allocation across qualified opportunities and partner with Professional Services and Customer Success to ensure seamless implementation handoffs and long-term customer retention.

Employee Value Proposition

  • Purpose: Lead JumpCloud's front-line technical engagement, empowering global IT and security leaders to modernize identity and device infrastructure in an AI-driven era.

  • Growth: Expand your leadership footprint across multi-country technical operations, defining presales methodologies, coaching frameworks, and cross-functional strategies across Sales and Post-Sales organizations.

  • Motivators: High-autonomy leadership role at a hyper-growth open directory platform, shaping team culture, driving strategic enterprise deals, and influencing product evolution.

Major Performance Objectives

    Measurable outcomes for the first 6-12 months:

    1. Team Development & Quota Ramp: Onboard, coach, and develop a distributed multi-country SE team through structured call reviews and individualized development plans (IDPs), achieving 100% team ramp and quota attainment within the first 6 months.

    2. Technical Win Rate Improvement: Increase regional technical win rates by standardizing outcome-focused discovery, value-based demonstrations, and deal qualification criteria.

    3. Proof of Value (POV) Efficiency: Shorten average POV completion through agreed mutual technical success criteria and proactive blocker resolution.

    4. Multi-Country Resource Optimization: Design and roll out an SE resource allocation model across international territories, balancing technical complexity, language/regional requirements, and deal tiering to maximize capacity.

    5. Cross-Functional Alignment & Asset Reusability: Partner with Professional Services, Customer Success, and Product to achieve seamless handoffs, and introduce reusable demo assets and AI-assisted win/loss analysis to continuously elevate team effectiveness

Critical Subtasks

    1. Establish a recurring coaching cadence with weekly 1-on-1s, Gong call reviews, and demo simulations focused on business discovery and technical outcome articulation.

    2. Partner with Sales leadership to review pipeline health, assess technical risks early in the sales cycle, and ensure commercial alignment before technical progression.

    3. Develop a standardized POV execution framework featuring pre-agreed evaluation scopes, customer milestones, and formal technical sign-offs.

    4. Implement a dynamic SE assignment and scheduling workflow that accounts for time zones, regional nuances, and specialized product capabilities.

    5. Directly participate in high-value deal reviews, technical escalations, and executive customer discussions to secure strategic technical wins.

    6. Formalize seamless handoff documentation and technical validation reviews with Professional Services and Customer Success to guarantee smooth post-sales implementations.

    7. Analyze team performance metrics and win/loss data to identify curriculum gaps, institutionalize competitive battlecards, and adopt thoughtful AI tools for team productivity.

Required Skills and Experience

    Must-have functional skills:

  • Presales People Leadership: Demonstrated success in coaching, developing, and managing Sales Engineers or technical solutions professionals in a fast-paced environment.

  • Technical Discovery & POV Strategy: Proven expertise in coaching value-based discovery, solution design, and guiding structured Proofs of Value with agreed business outcomes.

  • Commercial & Resource Strategy: Strong ability to partner with Sales leaders on pipeline qualification, deal risk identification, and strategic technical resource allocation.


    • Preferred domain knowledge:

  • Identity and Access Management (IAM), Directory Services (LDAP, Active Directory), Single Sign-On (SSO), and Multi-Factor Authentication (MFA).

  • Unified Endpoint Management (UEM) / Mobile Device Management (MDM) across macOS, Windows, Linux, iOS, and Android ecosystems.


    • Tools or systems knowledge:

  • Industry Platforms: JumpCloud, Microsoft Entra/Intune, Okta, Omnissa (Workspace ONE), or Jamf.

  • Sales & Coaching Tech: Salesforce, Gong/Chorus, demonstration automation software, and modern generative AI productivity tools.


    • Behavioral or power skills:

  • Distributed Team Leadership: Exceptional ability to motivate, align, and maintain team cohesion across multi-country, remote environments.

  • Executive Communication: High-impact verbal and written communication skills with the ability to bridge complex technical details and business outcomes.

  • Adaptability & Problem-Solving: High-conviction operational mindset with the resilience to thrive in a high-growth, changing SaaS environment.

  • Years of Experience: 5+ years of presales sales engineering or technical solutions experience in B2B SaaS/IT infrastructure, including 2+ years of formal people management or technical team leadership.

Where you’ll be working/Location:

JumpCloud® is committed to being Remote First, meaning that you are able to work remotely within the country noted in the Job Description.
This role is remote in the country of England. You must be located in and authorized to work in the England to be considered for this role.
Language:
JumpCloud® has teams in 15+ countries around the world and conducts our internal business in English. The interview and any additional screening process will take place primarily in English. To be considered for a role at JumpCloud®, you will be required to speak and write in English fluently. Any additional language requirements will be included in the details of the job description.

Why JumpCloud®?

If you thrive working in a fast, SaaS-based environment and you are passionate about solving challenging technical problems, we look forward to hearing from you! JumpCloud® is an incredible place to share and grow your expertise! You’ll work with amazing talent across each department who are passionate about our mission. We’re out of the box thinkers, so your unique ideas and approaches for conceiving a product and/or feature will be welcome. You’ll have a voice in the organization as you work with a seasoned executive team, a supportive board and in a proven market that our customers are excited about.
One of JumpCloud®'s three core values is to “Build Connections.” To us that means creating " human connection with each other regardless of our backgrounds, orientations, geographies, religions, languages, gender, race, etc. We care deeply about the people that we work with and want to see everyone succeed." - Rajat Bhargava, CEO
Please submit your résumé and brief explanation about yourself and why you would be a good fit for JumpCloud®. Please note JumpCloud® is not accepting third party resumes at this time.
JumpCloud® is an equal opportunity employer. All applicants will be considered for employment without attention to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, veteran or disability status.

Scam Notice:

Please be aware that there are individuals and organizations that may attempt to scam job seekers by offering fraudulent employment opportunities in the name of JumpCloud. These scams may involve fake job postings, unsolicited emails, or messages claiming to be from our recruiters or hiring managers. Please note that JumpCloud will never ask for any personal account information, such as credit card details or bank account numbers, during the recruitment process. Additionally, JumpCloud will never send you a check for any equipment prior to employment.
All communication related to interviews and offers from our recruiters and hiring managers will come from official company email addresses (@jumpcloud.com) and will never ask for any payment, fee to be paid or purchases to be made by the job seeker. If you are contacted by anyone claiming to represent JumpCloud and you are unsure of their authenticity, please do not provide any personal/financial information and contact us immediately at with the subject line "Scam Notice"

raw.description:
Kondex is seeking an HDD Account Manager to support growth within its Horizontal Directional Drilling market segment. This role is responsible for developing and maintaining relationships with dealers, distributors, contractors, and end users while identifying new business opportunities and expanding market share throughout the assigned territory. The ideal candidate will bring a blend of sales expertise, technical aptitude, and industry knowledge to help customers improve productivity, tackle demanding field applications, and support projects that expand critical utility and broadband infrastructure.

Including the following, but not limited to:

  • Sales Growth & Business Development: Grow existing accounts through relationship development, territory planning, and proactive account management while identifying new business opportunities with dealers, distributors, and contractors.
  • Territory Management: Maintain an active sales pipeline, execute territory growth strategies, and achieve established sales and margin objectives.
  • Product Application Support: Recommend tooling and product applications that provide customers with a competitive advantage while supporting distribution development, dealer onboarding, training, and territory coverage initiatives.
  • Customer & Dealer Relationships: Build and maintain strong relationships with dealers, distributors, contractors, and end users through regular customer visits, contractor meetings, and jobsite evaluations.
  • Customer Education & Training: Ensure customers understand product benefits and competitive positioning through demonstrations, product training, field support activities, and industry events.
  • Customer Service & Issue Resolution: Resolve customer concerns in partnership with internal teams and ensure timely support to dealers, distributors, and contractors.
  • Account Planning & Forecasting: Create and manage account plans, sales forecasts, territory strategies, CRM records, and opportunity pipeline reporting.
  • Cross-Functional Collaboration: Partner with Sales, Engineering, Quality, Product Management, and Operations teams to support customers, resolve field issues, and provide market feedback.
  • Market & Competitive Intelligence: Monitor competitive activity, pricing trends, distribution channel developments, and regional market conditions while providing voice-of-customer feedback and application insights to internal stakeholders.
  • Industry Engagement: Participate in trade shows, customer events, training activities, and other industry functions to strengthen market presence and identify growth opportunities.

Experience & Education:

  • Bachelor's degree in Business, Engineering, Construction Management, or a related field preferred
  • 5+ years of sales, account management, business development, field service, or industry experience within HDD, underground utilities, construction, or related markets
  • Proven track record of growing territories, developing customer relationships, and generating new business opportunities
  • Experience working with dealers, distributors, contractors, or channel partners
  • Experience with HDD tooling, drilling operations, utility installation, or related applications preferred
  • Ability and willingness to travel up to 75% throughout the assigned territory

Skills:

  • Strong relationship-building and consultative sales skills
  • Strong mechanical aptitude and the ability to understand field applications and technical products
  • Ability to communicate technical information effectively to customers, dealers, and contractors
  • Experience conducting product demonstrations, training sessions, or field support activities
  • Strong organizational, planning, and territory management skills
  • Working knowledge of Microsoft Office and CRM systems
  • Ability to identify market opportunities and develop strategic account growth plans
  • Self-motivated with the ability to work independently in a remote environment

All your information will be kept confidential according to EEO guidelines.

Kondex Corporation is a leading manufacturer of cutting and wear-resistant components serving the agriculture, vegetation management, construction, forestry, and utility markets. Through a commitment to innovation, engineering excellence, and customer-focused solutions, Kondex develops products that help customers maximize performance in demanding field applications. Many of the products manufactured by Kondex support industries that help feed communities, maintain critical infrastructure, and expand broadband and utility networks. Employees enjoy a collaborative culture, opportunities for professional growth, and the stability of a well-established and growing organization.

Location:

  • Remote (Territory coverage focused on the Southeastern U.S.)
  • Hybrid opportunity available for candidates located near Lomira, WI

Working Conditions:

Physical Effort

raw.description:
Behavioral Health Case Mgr - CT08IE

We’re determined to make a difference and are proud to be an insurance company that goes well beyond coverages and policies. Working here means having every opportunity to achieve your goals – and to help others accomplish theirs, too. Join our team as we help shape the future.

Our team is committed to driving profitability by delivering exceptional customer service and superb claim outcomes! The ideal candidate will be part of a dynamic and talented team of Behavioral Health Disability Claim professionals that are committed to conducting comprehensive evaluations of disability claimants' functionality via functional assessments. This position is part of a vast team of Behavioral Health Case Managers who are responsible for the review and evaluation of Short-Term Disability (STD) and Long-Term Disability (LTD) claims. While reviewing cases, our goal is to assess a client’s “return to work” potential while also improving their functional capabilities. Successful incumbents in this role will perform functional client assessments and interpret clinical information. They will utilize established clinical guidelines/protocols to facilitate a client’s ability to leverage their functional capabilities, work experience and educational background to allow for a safe and productive return to work environment.


Responsibilities:

  • Conducts comprehensive evaluation of a disability claimant functionality.
  • Advises on highly complex claims at multidisciplinary clinical review roundtables to ensure optimal outcomes.
  • Determines when claims contain quality of care issues and escalates these through established channels.
  • Independently conferences with treating providers and/or other higher-level facilities to evaluate clinical symptomology present in claimants.
  • Leverages resources such as vocational rehabilitation, risk management unit, physician reviews, home assessments, etc.
  • Manages risk and resources on highly complex behavioral health claims.
  • Identifies appropriate return to work options and/or barriers to partner with internal resources to ensure a smooth transition back into employability and normal activities.
  • Reviews clinical integration systems and determines appropriate referral resources to achieve an optimum level of health.
  • Supports the leadership team by demonstrating understanding of customer needs and expectations as well as ensuring performance objectives are met.
  • Ensures excellent documentation that clearly and concisely communicates focus of functionality vs. impairment and provides a recommendation of support or non-support of clinical findings.
  • Collaborates with Ability Benefits Manager and other key players (Vocational Rehabilitation, Consultants, Medical Nurse Reviewers, etc.) for proactive movement of the claim to resolution.
  • Manages Short Term Disability (STD) to Long Term Disability (LTD) transition on all behavioral health claims, coordinating with all resources necessary to ensure a seamless process.

Qualifications:

  • Minimum of 3 years of clinical practice experience following a clinical master’s degree.
  • Master’s Degree required in a behavioral health or mental health discipline.
  • License in Behavioral Health Clinical work which may include professional designations in Social Work, Mental Health, Marriage/Family Counseling, etc.
  • Professional licenses in: LMHC, LCSW, LMFT, LPC or other similar designations are required.
  • A license to practice independently is required.
  • Preference for case management and discharge experience.
  • Preference for managed care/utilization review/insurance experience.
  • Preference for crisis intervention skills.
  • Solid technical acumen with Microsoft Office: Word, Excel & PowerPoint.
  • Ability to assess and explain complex medical condition.
  • Demonstrated aptitude for communicating with attending physicians to identify current workplace limitations or restrictions.
  • Accurate clinical assessment and analytical skills.
  • Ability to make sound judgments.
  • Readily able to accurately document activities.
  • Demonstrated desire to learn about the insurance business.

Key Competencies:

  • Negotiation Skills
  • Problem Solving
  • Plan Development
  • Attention to Detail
  • Team-Player
  • Positive Customer-Focused Approach
  • Organizational and Change Management Skills

Additional Information:

  • This role can have a Hybrid or Remote work schedule. Candidates who live near one of our office locations (Hartford, CT, San Antonio, TX, Lake Mary, FL, Scottsdale, AZ, and Alpharetta, GA, Naperville, IL, will have the expectation of working in an office 3 days a week (Tuesday through Thursday). Candidates who do not live near an office will have a remote work schedule, with the expectation of coming into an office as business needs arise.

The base pay is just one component of The Hartford’s total compensation package for employees. $74,800 - $112,200

raw.excerpt: About the RoleGreen Ocean Property Management is looking for an experienced Remote Maintenance Manager to lead and manage day-to-day maintenance operations across our residential and HOA/condo portfolio.
raw.description:
About the Role

Green Ocean Property Management is looking for an experienced Remote Maintenance Manager to lead and manage day-to-day maintenance operations across our residential and HOA/condo portfolio.

This role is responsible for making sure maintenance requests are handled quickly, vendors are managed well, costs are controlled, and residents, owners, and property managers receive clear updates.

We are looking for someone who can manage people, solve maintenance problems, build strong systems, and keep a large number of work orders moving without losing track of details.

Key Responsibilities

  • Manage the daily maintenance workflow from initial request through completion.
  • Review, assign, prioritize, and follow up on maintenance work orders.
  • Lead and support remote Maintenance Coordinators.
  • Coordinate with technicians, contractors, vendors, property managers, tenants, owners, and HOA teams.
  • Handle escalated or complex maintenance concerns.
  • Review maintenance requests and help determine the right next step before sending a vendor.
  • Monitor emergency and urgent maintenance issues.
  • Make sure vendors respond and complete work within expected timelines.
  • Review vendor quotes, estimates, invoices, and scopes of work.
  • Compare pricing and help control maintenance costs.
  • Build and maintain a reliable vendor network.
  • Track vendor performance, response time, quality, and communication.
  • Follow up on delayed or overdue work orders.
  • Keep maintenance records, notes, photos, estimates, and invoices organized.
  • Make sure residents and internal teams receive regular updates.
  • Identify repeat maintenance problems and recommend long-term solutions.
  • Create and improve maintenance SOPs, workflows, and escalation procedures.
  • Track maintenance KPIs such as open work orders, completion time, vendor response time, aging tickets, and cost.
  • Support after-hours and emergency maintenance processes.
  • Work closely with Property Management, HOA, Leasing, Finance, and Operations teams.
  • Provide regular maintenance reports and updates to leadership.

Qualifications

  • At least 3–5 years of property maintenance, facilities management, property management, or maintenance coordination experience.
  • At least 1–2 years of leadership or team management experience.
  • Strong understanding of residential property maintenance.
  • Experience managing a high volume of maintenance requests or work orders.
  • Experience working with vendors, contractors, technicians, and residents.
  • Good understanding of common property issues involving:
    • HVAC
    • Plumbing
    • Electrical
    • Appliances
    • Roofing
    • Water leaks
    • Mold or moisture concerns
    • General repairs
    • Preventive maintenance
  • Strong problem-solving and decision-making skills.
  • Strong written and spoken English.
  • Excellent organization and follow-up skills.
  • Comfortable managing multiple urgent issues at the same time.
  • Able to work independently in a remote environment.
  • Comfortable working during U.S. Eastern Time business hours.

Preferred Experience

  • Experience managing maintenance for large residential portfolios, scattered-site properties, or HOA/condo associations.
  • Experience with property management software such as Property Meld, Buildium, AppFolio, or similar platforms.
  • Experience using Asana, Slack, Google Workspace, or similar tools.
  • Experience creating maintenance SOPs and workflows.
  • Experience reviewing vendor pricing and negotiating service costs.
  • Experience managing remote maintenance coordinators or support staff.

What We Will Ask During the Interview

Please be ready to discuss:

  • How many properties, units, or associations you have supported or managed.
  • How many maintenance requests or work orders your team handled.
  • The size of the maintenance team you managed.
  • Your experience handling emergency maintenance situations.
  • Your experience managing and negotiating with vendors.
  • Your current or expected hourly/monthly rate.
  • How soon you can start.

What Success Looks Like

The right Maintenance Manager will help us achieve:

  • Faster maintenance response and completion times.
  • Fewer overdue work orders.
  • Better communication with residents and property managers.
  • Stronger vendor accountability.
  • Better cost control.
  • Clear and organized maintenance records.
  • Stronger systems and processes as the company grows.

Money is moving onto the internet, and the shift has a name: Open Money. This is money that is open, portable, agentic, and owned by you. MetaMask spent the last ten years building it; with 100M+ downloads, users in ~190 countries, and trillions in cumulative transaction volume, it's the most trusted self-custodial financial platform on the internet. Now we're building the operating system for your money: one place to hold, move, grow, and use anything you own. Join a remote-first, global team rebuilding how money works: a problem that touches everyone, every day.

About the role

MetaMask is building the infrastructure for a decentralised web. Our TechOps team keeps that infrastructure running — reliably, securely, and at scale. As a Senior Systems Administrator, you'll own the technical backbone that our engineers, product teams, and operations depend on every day.

You'll work across cloud and SaaS environments, driving improvements that raise the bar on system reliability and operational maturity. You'll be expected to bring judgment, initiative, and technical depth — and to operate with significant autonomy.

As a member of the TechOps team, you will drive the operational reliability of the technical ecosystems utilized by our global workforce. Beyond day-to-day administration, you will spearhead high-impact infrastructure initiatives that define our organizational maturity and technical trajectory. As the main IT point of contact for our employees, you will also assist with technical projects as we scale various teams.

What you'll do

  • Ticket management and remote support
  • Hardware and software support
  • Networking
  • Videoconferencing (both digital and physical)
  • Onboarding and offboarding tasks for new hires and departing employees
  • Procuring and shipping equipment to remote employees across the EU
  • General technical assistance
  • Execution of large-scale technical projects and company-wide technology initiatives
  • Work as part of the team responsible for the administration, performance, and reliability of cloud infrastructure across multiple environments, including Okta, Google Workspace, Slack, Zoom and Atlassian
  • Manage and evolve hybrid systems, ensuring seamless integration with cloud workloads
  • Administer and optimise the SaaS and MDM tooling stack that supports a globally distributed workforce
  • Lead incident response for critical systems, including root cause analysis and post-incident review
  • Build and maintain automation to reduce manual overhead and improve system observability
  • Define and enforce security and access control policies across platforms
  • Partner with the Security teams to support compliance requirements
  • Contribute to technical documentation and runbooks that raise team-wide operational standards

What you'll bring

  • 5+ years in systems administration or infrastructure engineering roles
  • Strong working knowledge of cloud infrastructure environments
  • Experience administering enterprise SaaS platforms and MDM solutions (e.g. Jumpcloud, Okta)
  • Solid understanding of networking fundamentals, identity management, and access control
  • Track record of operating autonomously and making sound technical decisions under pressure
  • Clear communicator — able to translate technical complexity for non-technical stakeholders

Nice to have

  • Experience in a web3, fintech, or high-growth tech environment
  • Exposure to security frameworks or compliance programmes (SOC2, ISO 27001)
  • Experience supporting globally distributed, fully remote teams
  • Experience across at least two major cloud providers (AWS, GCP, Azure)

The salary range listed for this role applies to US-based candidates only. Compensation for candidates based outside the US (including Canada, EMEA, and LATAM) will be determined based on location, experience, and skills during the interview process, and may differ from the listed US range.

$138,745—$202,336 USD

In the rapidly evolving Web3 space, we believe that everyone is a builder. This expansive paradigm requires a range of backgrounds, talents, skills, and experiences to influence and shape the future. At MetaMask, this diversity fuels our ability to shift control and redefine the realm of possibility. We are committed to ensuring that our technology empowers people and communities through decentralized technologies. We welcome the range of perspectives and differences and celebrate them. We're excited to see how your unique skills as a builder can contribute to our vision, drive innovation, and help us shape a more inclusive Web3.

raw.description:
Position Overview:

We are seeking a highly skilled Web Scraping Architect to join our team. The successful candidate will be responsible for designing, implementing, and maintaining web scraping processes to gather data from various online sources efficiently and accurately. As a Web Scraping Specialist, you will play a crucial role in collecting data for competitor analysis, and other business intelligence purposes.

Responsibilities:

  • Scalability/Performance: Lead and provide expertise in scraping at scale e-commerce marketplaces.
  • Data Source Identification: Identify relevant websites and online sources from which data needs to be scraped. Collaborate with the team to understand data requirements and objectives.
  • Web Scraping Design: Develop and implement effective web scraping strategies to extract data from targeted websites. This includes selecting appropriate tools, libraries, or frameworks for the task.
  • Data Extraction: Create and maintain web scraping scripts or programs to extract the required data. Ensure the code is optimized, reliable, and can handle changes in the website's structure.
  • Data Cleansing and Validation: Cleanse and validate the collected data to eliminate errors, inconsistencies, and duplicates. Ensure data integrity and accuracy throughout the process.
  • Monitoring and Maintenance: Continuously monitor and maintain the web scraping processes. Address any issues that arise due to website changes, data format modifications, or anti-scraping mechanisms.
  • Scalability and Performance: Optimize web scraping procedures for efficiency and scalability, especially when dealing with a large volume of data or multiple data sources.
  • Compliance and Legal Considerations: Stay up-to-date with legal and ethical considerations related to web scraping, including website terms of service, copyright, and privacy regulations.
  • Documentation: Maintain detailed documentation of web scraping processes, data sources, and methodologies. Create clear and concise instructions for others to follow.
  • Collaboration: Collaborate with other teams such as data analysts, developers, and business stakeholders to understand data requirements and deliver insights effectively.
  • Security: Implement security measures to ensure the confidentiality and protection of sensitive data throughout the scraping process.

Requirements:

  • Proven experience of 4+ years as a Web Scraping Specialist or similar role, with a track record of successful web scraping projects.
  • Expertise in handling dynamic content, user-agent rotation, bypass CAPTCHAs, rate limits, and utilization of proxy services.
  • Knowledge on browser fingerprinting
  • Has leadership experience.
  • Proficiency in programming languages commonly used for web scraping, such as Python, BeautifulSoup, Scrapy, or Selenium.
  • Strong knowledge of HTML, CSS, XPath, and other web technologies relevant to web scraping and Coding.
  • Knowledge and experience in best of class data storage and retrieval of large volume of scraped data.
  • Understanding of web scraping best practices, including handling dynamic content, user-agent rotation, and IP address management.
  • Attention to detail and the ability to handle and process large volumes of data accurately.
  • Familiarity with data cleansing techniques and data validation processes.
  • Good communication skills and the ability to collaborate effectively with cross-functional teams.
  • Knowledge of web scraping ethics, legal considerations, and compliance with website terms of service.
  • Strong problem-solving skills and the ability to adapt to changing web environments

Preferred Qualifications:

  • Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Data Science, Information Technology, or related fields.
  • Experience with cloud-based solutions and distributed web scraping systems.
  • Familiarity with APIs and data extraction from non-public sources.
  • Knowledge of machine learning techniques for data extraction and natural language processing is desired but not mandatory
  • Prior experience in handling large-scale data projects and working with big data frameworks.
  • Understanding of various data formats such as JSON, XML, CSV, etc.
  • Experience with version control systems like Git.

    This is a Work from Home position

raw.title: Director of Psychiatric Clinical Operations
raw.excerpt: Who are we and why should you join us? BetterHelp is on a mission to remove the traditional barriers to therapy and make mental health care more accessible to everyone.
raw.description:
Who are we and why should you join us?

BetterHelp is on a mission to remove the traditional barriers to therapy and make mental health care more accessible to everyone. Founded in 2013, we are now the world’s largest online therapy service, providing affordable and convenient therapy across the globe. Our network of over 30,000 licensed therapists has helped millions of people take ownership of their mental health and change their lives forever. And we’re not stopping there – as the unmet need for mental health services continues to grow, BetterHelp is committed to being part of the solution.

As the Director of Clinical Psychiatric Operations at BetterHelp, you’ll join a diverse team of licensed clinicians, engineers, product pros, creatives, marketers, and business leaders who share a passion for expanding access to therapy. And as a mental health company, we take employee mental health just as seriously as we do our mission. We deeply invest in our team’s well-being and professional development, because we know that business and individual growth go hand-in-hand. At BetterHelp, you’ll carve your own path, make an immediate impact, and be challenged every day – with a supportive community behind you the whole way.

What are we looking for?

BetterHelp is seeking an experienced, innovative, and operationally-minded Psychiatric Mental Health Nurse Practitioner (PMHNP) to lead our Psychiatry Practice Management team.

This role sits at the intersection of clinical operations, quality assurance, compliance, clinical excellence, provider operations, and product innovation. As a senior clinical leader supporting BetterHelp's psychiatric provider network, you will help shape how the daily behind-the-scenes operations evolve and how psychiatric care is delivered at scale through technology–keeping quality, safety, and regulatory compliance top-of-mind.

You are an experienced psychiatric clinician who understands both the realities of direct patient care and the opportunities technology creates to improve access to mental healthcare. You are obsessed with operational efficiency, systems that scale, and creating a white-glove work environment for our providers. You are equally comfortable consulting on complex clinical situations, analyzing operational data, improving processes, collaborating with cross-functional stakeholders, and coaching team members.

You thrive in fast-paced environments, embrace ambiguity, and are excited by the opportunity to build and scale psychiatric operations as BetterHelp continues expanding its behavioral healthcare services.

This role offers the opportunity to influence psychiatric care delivery for hundreds of providers and thousands of members while helping define the future of telepsychiatry.

What will you do?

Clinical Quality & Compliance

  • Lead a team who conducts documentation and quality audits, quality assurance initiatives, and support investigations involving provider performance, prescribing concerns, documentation quality, and regulatory compliance.
  • Help your team provide actionable, constructive, and clinically informed feedback to psychiatric providers.
  • Partner closely with Legal, Compliance, Credentialing, and Patient Safety teams to ensure adherence to applicable regulations and professional standards.
  • Stay current on evolving telehealth, prescribing, and psychiatric practice regulations and communicate relevant changes throughout the organization.
  • Identify trends impacting psychiatric providers and recommend operational improvements.

Team Leadership & Management

  • Directly manage and develop Psychiatry Operations team members, including Clinical Operations Managers, Quality Assurance Specialists, and Psychiatry Support Specialists.
  • Establish team priorities, workflows, performance expectations, and operational goals.
  • Coach and mentor team members through complex clinical and operational scenarios.
  • Foster a culture of accountability, collaboration, innovation, and continuous improvement.
  • Support workforce planning, hiring, onboarding, and development as the Psychiatry Operations function scales.

Operational Excellence & Provider Engagement

  • Monitor key performance indicators, quality metrics, provider engagement data, and operational trends to identify opportunities for improvement.
  • Use data-driven decision making to optimize provider experience, member outcomes, and operational efficiency.
  • Lead or contribute to strategic initiatives involving psychiatric care delivery, provider support, quality assurance, and risk mitigation.
  • Help develop scalable operational processes to support future growth and expansion of psychiatric offerings.

Product & Innovation

  • Serve as a key clinical subject matter expert for psychiatric care delivery and medication management workflows. Partner with Associate Medical Director for thought-partnership.
  • Collaborate with Product, Engineering, AI, and Clinical Operations stakeholders to identify opportunities for platform enhancements.
  • Provide clinical guidance on new products, tools, workflows, and technology initiatives impacting psychiatric providers and members.
  • Support implementation and adoption of new technologies, including AI-enabled workflows and quality initiatives.

External Representation

  • Collaborate with Marketing, Communications, and Public Relations teams as needed.
  • Participate in provider-facing webinars, training events, educational content, and media opportunities.
  • Represent BetterHelp's commitment to safe, ethical, and accessible psychiatric care.

Additional Responsibilities

  • Maintain a small caseload of psychiatric clients on the platform (approx 2-3 clinical hours per week) to understand the lived experience of our providers.
  • Support insurance and payer-related quality initiatives as BetterHelp expands its healthcare offerings.

What will you NOT do?

  • You will NOT worry about "runway", "cash left", or "how much time we have until the next round". We have the startup DNA but we're fully backed and funded, all the way to success.
  • You will NOT be confined to your "job". You will get involved in product, marketing, business strategy, and almost everything we do.
  • You will NOT be bogged down by office politics, ego, or bad attitude. Only positive, pleasure-to-work-with people are allowed here!
  • You will NOT get yourself burned out. We work hard but we believe in maintaining a sustainable work/life balance. Really.

Can I work remotely?

Yes. We operate on PST and candidates in any time zone are welcome to apply. We ask employees to travel to our San Jose, CA office up to three times per year plus one company-wide offsite to collaborate in person and strengthen working relationships. Travel expenses are covered and reasonable accommodations are made for those under unique circumstances who cannot travel.

Requirements

  • Active, unrestricted Psychiatric Mental Health Nurse Practitioner (PMHNP) license in good standing.
  • Minimum 8 years of post-licensure clinical experience providing psychiatric assessment, diagnosis, and medication management.
  • Experience delivering psychiatric services via telehealth preferred.
  • Demonstrated leadership, supervisory, or management experience.
  • Strong understanding of psychiatric prescribing practices, risk assessment, documentation standards, and clinical quality management.
  • Experience investigating or resolving complex clinical, quality, compliance, or provider performance concerns.
  • Strong analytical and problem-solving skills with the ability to make data-informed decisions.
  • Excellent written, verbal, and presentation skills.
  • Ability to effectively collaborate with clinical, operational, legal, product, and executive stakeholders.
  • Comfortable working in a fast-paced, high-growth technology environment.
  • Demonstrated ability to manage competing priorities and drive projects to completion.
  • Passion for improving access to high-quality mental healthcare through innovation and technology.
  • Ideally located or licensed in AL, GA, IN, MO, MS, NC, OH, TN, TX

Preferred Qualifications:

  • Experience working with digital health organizations.
  • Experience supporting or supervising other psychiatric providers.
  • Experience in healthcare operations, quality assurance, utilization management, or clinical leadership roles.
  • Familiarity with state and federal telehealth and prescribing regulations.
  • Experience supporting AI-enabled healthcare initiatives or healthcare technology products.
  • Previous experience with UpLift or other similar virtual care platforms.

Benefits

  • Remote work with regular in-person bonding experiences sponsored by the company
  • Competitive compensation
  • Holistic perks program (including free therapy, employee wellness, and more)
  • Excellent health, dental, and vision coverage
  • 401k benefits with employer matching contribution
  • The chance to build something that changes lives – and that people love
  • Any piece of hardware or software that will make you happy and productive
  • An awesome community of co-workers

The base salary range for this position is $175,000 - $210,000. In addition to the base salary, this position is eligible for a performance bonus and the extensive benefits listed here (subject to eligibility requirements): Teladoc Health Benefits 2026. Total compensation is based on several factors – including, but not limited to, type of position, location, education level, work experience, and certifications. This information is applicable to all full-time positions.

At BetterHelp we thrive on difference and individuality, and as part of the Teladoc Health family, we are proud to be an Equal Opportunity Employer. We never have and never will discriminate against any job candidate or employee due to age, race, ethnicity, religion, sex, color, national origin, gender, gender identity, sexual orientation, medical condition, marital status, parental status, disability, or Veteran status.

BetterHelp has been made aware of fraudulent job postings and unaffiliated third parties posing as our recruiting team – please know that we have no affiliation or connection to these situations. We only post open roles on our career page () or reputable job boards like our official LinkedIn or Indeed pages, and all official BetterHelp recruitment emails will come from the domain @. Our commitment is to ensure a safe and transparent hiring experience for all candidates. We will never ask you for money, gift cards, or any form of payment during our hiring process, and we will never send money or checks to candidates. If you experience this, it is a scam.

  • proof-of-concept etc.

PLOS is a nonprofit organization on a mission to drive open science forward with measurable, meaningful change in research publishing, policy, and practice. Qualifications

Physical Requirements and Work Environment

  • Prolonged periods stationary at a desk and working on a computer
  • Some national and international travel may be required occasionally
  • Some flexibility to work across time zones

  • Private medical insurance
  • Life assurance
  • Income protection 
  • Personal accident insurance

Building on a strong legacy of pioneering innovation, PLOS continues to be a catalyst in open science, reimagining models to meet open science principles, removing barriers and promoting inclusion in knowledge creation and sharing, and publishing research outputs that enable everyone to learn from, reuse and build upon scientific knowledge.

Our work is supported by a highly skilled global in-house team, partnerships with local scholarly organizations, and the valued contributions of a diverse, international community of scientific researchers.

About the role
Finch is a performance marketing agency. We run digital advertising and SEO for e-commerce and B2B brands. You’ll lead each relationship and its strategy, and work with our channel specialists (Paid Search, Paid Social, Programmatic/DSP, SEO, Creative, Analytics) to deliver on each client’s business goals.

What you’ll do

  • Own the strategy for each client account: goals, KPIs and quarterly roadmaps.
  • Run recurring client meetings, manage stakeholders and document next steps.
  • Read performance against business metrics (ROAS, CPA, CAC vs. LTV, organic growth) and coordinate actions with Finch’s specialists.
  • Find and scope growth opportunities: new channels, tests and budget expansions.
  • Flag retention risks early and build mitigation plans across your portfolio.

Why Finch

  • Work globally, stay flexible: Join a fully distributed team across the US, LATAM, Europe, and APAC.

  • A culture built on curiosity, transparency, and ownership: We share context and empower people to make decisions.
  • High-caliber teammates: Collaborate with specialists in Paid Search, Paid Social, SEO, DSP, Creative, Analytics, and more.
  • Learning as a default: We encourage experimentation, cross-training, and growth as the company scales.
  • Real work-life balance: We value high performance, not overwork.

Requirements

You’ll be a great match if you have

  • 5+ years as an Account Manager or Account Director at a marketing agency (performance or digital).
  • Experience owning several B2B client accounts at the same time: managing the client relationship, growing the account, and running the project management behind it.

  • Fluent written and spoken English, and comfort leading strategic conversations with senior client stakeholders.
  • A base in Latin America or Africa (or anywhere up to UTC+2), with availability to work roughly 9am–5pm US Central/Mountain time.

This role is not the right next step if most of your experience is in

  • Customer service or support, or customer success for consumers (B2C) or for a software product, even if the title was “Account Manager” or “Customer Success Manager”.
  • Working at an ad platform or affiliate network, managing advertisers on its behalf.

  • In-house marketing for a single company, without an agency client portfolio.
  • Sales or business development, without ongoing account management after the sale.

Nice to have

  • Experience with SEO-driven accounts.
  • Experience with US or international clients.

  • Supports communication of the Company’s Compliance program, including applicable healthcare laws and regulations, company values, and standards, and helps promote a culture of compliance.
