raw.description:
Job Description:

SAP Sales & Distribution Functional Analyst


About the role


We’re looking for an SAP Sales & Distribution (SD) Functional Analyst to join our team and play an important role in supporting and improving SAP solutions for our client.


This is a great opportunity for someone with hands-on experience in SAP SD who enjoys understanding how a business works, talking to users, solving problems and finding practical ways to make processes better.

You’ll work closely with both business users and technical teams, helping to understand what people need from SAP and turning those needs into effective solutions. You’ll be involved in everything from day-to-day support and troubleshooting through to configuration, testing, process improvements, and new developments.


You don’t need to know everything from day one. We’re particularly interested in someone who is curious, willing to learn and keen to broaden their SAP knowledge into other Logistics areas over time.


Due to the nature of the client environment, eligibility for security clearance is required for this role. To meet the current security requirements, candidates must be sole UK nationals and have lived and worked continuously in the UK for the past five years. Unfortunately, we are unable to consider dual nationals for this position.


What you'll be doing

  • Working with business users to understand their requirements, challenges and day-to-day processes.
  • Using your SAP SD knowledge to identify practical solutions that meet business needs.
  • Helping to map current processes and design improved AS-IS and TO-BE processes.
  • Configuring SAP and translating business requirements into clear functional specifications.
  • Supporting the resolution of SAP SD issues, working closely with both users and technical colleagues.
  • Helping to identify opportunities to improve existing processes and make better use of SAP.
  • Creating and carrying out test scenarios to make sure changes work as expected.
  • Supporting users through changes, including providing training and guidance where needed.
  • Working with colleagues and sharing your knowledge to help others develop their SAP skills.
  • Contributing to projects, enhancements and other SAP-related initiatives.
  • Being open to learning and supporting other areas of SAP and Logistics functionality as your experience develops.

What we're looking for

We’re looking for someone who has:

  • Relevant hands-on experience working with SAP Sales & Distribution (SD).
  • Experience in business analysis, business solutions or a similar role.
  • A good understanding of business processes and how SAP can support and improve them.
  • Experience supporting users through business process changes or improvements.
  • Experience working with both business and technical teams to resolve issues.
  • Good analytical and problem-solving skills.
  • The ability to listen, ask the right questions and turn business requirements into practical solutions.
  • Experience creating and executing test scenarios.
  • Strong written and verbal communication skills.
  • The confidence to explain technical concepts in a way that makes sense to non-technical audiences.
  • A willingness to learn, develop and broaden your SAP knowledge.

An SAP certification would be great, but it isn't essential. We're also happy to support someone who is keen to work towards certification.


A degree or equivalent experience is preferred.


The kind of person who will enjoy this role

You’ll enjoy this role if you like getting to the bottom of a problem rather than simply fixing the symptom.

You’ll be comfortable speaking with different people across a business, from end users to technical specialists, and enjoy understanding what they need and finding a way to make things work.


We’re looking for someone who is approachable, curious and solutions-focused, with the confidence to take ownership while knowing when to ask for help.


Things don't always go to plan in SAP, so being able to manage changing priorities, stay calm when there are competing demands and work through problems logically is important.


Most importantly, we're looking for someone who wants to develop their skills and grow with the role, rather than someone who already knows everything.


Where you'll work

This is primarily a work-from-home role, giving you the flexibility to work remotely while remaining closely connected with the wider team and client.

There may be occasional travel to client sites for meetings, workshops or other business requirements.

From time to time, there may also be a requirement to work outside standard hours, including occasional weekends, depending on client and project requirements.


Why join us?

This is more than a role focused purely on keeping SAP running. You'll have the opportunity to work directly with users, understand real business challenges and see the impact of the solutions you help deliver.


In addition, DXC offers a competitive salary and a flexible benefits package designed to support you both professionally and personally — including pension, private medical cover, and wellbeing programmes.


You'll also have the opportunity to develop your SAP skills, gain exposure to wider Logistics functionality, and build your experience across both functional and business-facing areas.

At DXC Technology, we believe strong connections and community are key to our success. Our work model prioritizes in-person collaboration while offering flexibility to support wellbeing, productivity, individual work styles, and life circumstances. We’re committed to fostering an inclusive environment where everyone can thrive.

Recruitment fraud is a scheme in which fictitious job opportunities are offered to job seekers typically through online services, such as false websites, or through unsolicited emails claiming to be from the company. These emails may request recipients to provide personal information or to make payments as part of their illegitimate recruiting process. DXC does not make offers of employment via social media networks and DXC never asks for any money or payments from applicants at any point in the recruitment process, nor ask a job seeker to purchase IT or other equipment on our behalf. About tabbyTabby is on a mission to give people power over their money. For too long, financial systems have worked for the institutions that built them, not the people using them. Runaway interest, fine print and limited access have left many behind, feeling shut out of a system that wasn't setting them up for success.

We're building a different kind of system—in a complete money app to send, spend and save. One that's clear, flexible and puts people and businesses in control. Founded in 2019, we serve customers and businesses across Saudi Arabia, the United Arab Emirates and Kuwait. Millions of customers and 65,000 global brands, government services and small businesses rely on us today.

What began as a better way to pay at checkout has grown into a financial system working the way it should have all along.


About the Role

As a Risk Analyst at Tabby, you will play a key role in analysing risk performance and contributing to the risk strategy across our products. You will work with large datasets to identify trends, monitor portfolio performance, and support data-driven decisions that balance growth with risk discipline. This role is highly cross-functional, requiring close collaboration with data, product and engineering teams to ensure healthy portfolio performance.

What You’ll Do

  • Analyse portfolio performance, customer behavior, and key risk indicators across products and segments.
  • Utilize big data analytics to identify risk patterns and insights. Develop reports and dashboards to monitor risk metrics and performance and present insights to leadership
  • Optimize risk strategies and policies to support sustainable growth
  • Contribute to the design and rollout of new products and policies
  • Collaborate with cross-functional teams to support launches in new markets and verticals
  • Continuously seek to improve risk management processes and strategies through innovation and adopting best practices.

What We’re Looking For

  • Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Finance, Economics, Statistics, or a related field.
  • 2–4 years of experience in risk management, fraud analytics, or a related data-driven role preferably in the Fintech sector or related financial services.
  • Strong analytical skills and experience with SQL, Python or similar tools
  • Understanding of consumer lending, digital wallets, transfers and fintech risk models
  • Ability to work independently and in a fast-paced, high-growth environment
  • Excellent communication and interpersonal skills, with the ability to convey complex information clearly and concisely.

Job Benefits

Locations
We hire candidates based within four hours of Dubai time, with remote work available in eligible locations. Depending on your circumstances, we can also discuss an individual relocation plan to our hubs in Armenia, Georgia, Serbia, Poland, and Spain.

    You own the commercial strategy, executive relationships, and overall business success of each partnership, working closely with the Client Success Engineer, who owns technical strategy, product adoption, and technical value realization. You bring together Client Success Engineering, Professional Services, Support, Product, Sales, and executive leadership to deliver a unified client experience. This is a senior individual contributor role in the Client Excellence organization, reporting to the VP, Client Excellence, with a high degree of autonomy and an informal leadership role in mentoring other Account Managers. This is a fully remote position open to candidates based in the United States.

What You’ll Do

  • Own the commercial success of a portfolio of Lucidworks’ largest and most strategic accounts, driving Gross Retention, Net Retention, renewals, expansion revenue, and long-term account growth.

  • Develop and execute multi-year account strategies that align Lucidworks solutions with client business priorities, strengthening strategic partnerships and maximizing client value.

  • Serve as the executive relationship owner for your clients, building trust with executive sponsors and leading Executive Business Reviews that demonstrate measurable business outcomes.

  • Source, qualify, and close the largest and most complex expansion opportunities, developing business cases and leading pricing, contract, and renewal negotiations, including multi-year and non-standard agreements.

  • Maintain an accurate renewal forecast and commercial pipeline, communicating business outlook, risk mitigation plans, and growth strategies to leadership.

  • Represent the voice of the client across Lucidworks as the executive escalation owner for business issues, aligning Client Success Engineering, Professional Services, Support, Product, and Sales around coordinated resolution plans.

  • Mentor and coach Account Managers, sharing account strategy, negotiation, and executive engagement practices across the Client Excellence organization.

  • Apply Gen AI tools to accelerate account planning, research, business reviews, and client communications, using sound judgment to validate AI-generated content and protect confidential client information.

What We’re Looking For

    Must-Haves

  • Demonstrated ownership of complex enterprise client relationships, balancing retention, growth, and long-term planning across a portfolio, with strong forecasting and pipeline discipline.

  • Track record of leading enterprise renewals, commercial negotiations, and large expansion deals to close while consistently achieving retention and revenue objectives.

  • Ability to build trusted executive relationships, influence senior stakeholders, and translate client priorities into multi-year account strategies delivered through cross-functional teams.

  • Excellent communication, presentation, and executive facilitation skills, with experience leading Executive Business Reviews and strategic client discussions.

  • Ability to use Gen AI tools to improve account planning and client communications while applying sound judgment on confidentiality, accuracy, and quality.

    • Nice-to-Haves

  • Experience managing enterprise SaaS clients within a subscription-based business model.

  • Experience using CRM and customer success platforms to manage account strategy, forecasting, and commercial performance.

  • Knowledge of enterprise search, AI, digital experience, or commerce technologies.

  • Experience mentoring or informally leading other account management professionals.

What Success Looks Like

  • Consistently achieves or exceeds Gross Retention, Net Retention, expansion revenue, and renewal objectives across a portfolio of Lucidworks’ largest strategic accounts.

  • Builds executive relationships that position Lucidworks as a strategic partner and deepen long-term client loyalty.

  • Delivers strategic account plans that produce measurable business outcomes, sustained adoption, and commercial growth.

  • Maintains an accurate commercial forecast and drives mitigation plans before issues affect client success or business performance.

  • Is recognized as a cross-functional leader and mentor who aligns internal teams around client priorities and strengthens the Client Excellence organization through knowledge sharing and process improvement.

Competencies

  • Resourceful: willing to jump in, be agile and flexible, leverage existing resources to accomplish goals, and work independently

  • Team player: confident in collaborating with a diverse community of people and personalities across geographies, backgrounds, and professional abilities

  • Strong verbal and written communication skills

  • Empathy and care for all stakeholders of Lucidworks, including employees, customers, partners, and guests

  • Ability to handle confidential information

Who We Are

Moniepoint Inc. is Africa’s all-in-one financial platform, helping 20 million businesses and individuals access seamless payments, banking, credit, cross-border, and business management tools each month.

As Nigeria’s largest merchant acquirer, we power most of the country’s point-of-sale (POS) transactions. Through our subsidiaries, Moniepoint Inc. processes over $250 billion in digital payment transaction value annually.

Job Title: Workforce Business Partner (North East)

Reports to: Team Lead, Workforce Partner

Job Purpose

The Workforce Business Partner (WBP) serves as a strategic partner to business leaders, driving the alignment of people strategy with business priorities. This role exists to ensure that every people-related initiative — from performance enablement and workforce planning to leadership effectiveness — is executed with precision, empathy, and measurable impact.

Beyond traditional HR delivery, the WBP acts as a trusted advisor, shaping organizational health and fostering a culture of accountability, engagement, and inclusion. The role bridges the gap between business needs and people solutions, ensuring that talent is positioned as a key enabler of growth and innovation.

Key Responsibilities

  • Partner with business leaders to translate organizational goals into actionable people plans that drive capability, performance, and retention.
  • Lead workforce planning and organizational design discussions to ensure the right structure, roles, and talent are in place to meet current and future needs.
  • Coach and influence leaders on talent strategy, performance management, and Independent Contractor engagement to strengthen leadership effectiveness and team culture.
  • Act as a trusted advisor on IC relations matters, ensuring fair, consistent, and business-aligned resolutions in collaboration with the Workforce Relations COE.
  • Analyze people data and insights to identify trends, risks, and opportunities, presenting data-driven recommendations to business leaders.
  • Champion change management and communication strategies that support transformation, adoption, and continuous improvement within business units.
  • Ensure compliance with internal policies and local labor laws while promoting a positive, high-performance culture.

Qualifications

  • 2–4 years of progressive HR experience, including at least 2 years in a Business Partnership or advisory capacity.
  • Demonstrated experience working in fast-paced, matrixed, or multinational environments.
  • Strong understanding of core HR functions — performance management, people relations, organizational design, and workforce planning.
  • Proven ability to use HR data and analytics to inform decision-making.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience supporting technical or commercial business units in a fintech, banking, or tech environment.
  • Demonstrated success influencing senior stakeholders and leading complex change initiatives.

About You

  • You’re a strategic thinker who sees the big picture but executes with precision.
  • You build trust quickly and communicate with empathy, clarity, and confidence.
  • You thrive in ambiguity and can balance multiple stakeholders with ease.
  • You’re data-driven — you make decisions grounded in insight, not intuition.
  • You’re committed to continuous improvement, always seeking better ways to drive business impact through people.

What Success Looks Like

  • You have established yourself as a trusted advisor to senior business leaders, influencing key people and organizational decisions.
  • Business units under your support demonstrate improved engagement, retention, and performance outcomes.
  • You’ve delivered a measurable improvement in workforce planning accuracy and performance management effectiveness.
  • Leaders actively seek your input on strategic and people-related matters, not just HR processes.
  • You’ve successfully embedded at least one COE-led initiative (e.g., new policy, performance framework, or workforce process) within your business unit with strong adoption and feedback.

Why join us

  • Competitive compensation, comprehensive benefits, and impactful career growth opportunities.
  • Fully remote/flexible work culture backed by continuous support for your learning and professional development.

raw.excerpt: Job DescriptionPTG is seeking a Vice President, ServiceNow Practice to lead the strategy, growth, commercial performance, and overall direction of our ServiceNow business.
raw.description:
Job Description

PTG is seeking a Vice President, ServiceNow Practice to lead the strategy, growth, commercial performance, and overall direction of our ServiceNow business.


PTG has established a growing ServiceNow practice with strong public sector experience, an expanding customer base, established sales and delivery capabilities, and significant opportunity for continued growth. As the practice enters its next stage, we are looking for an experienced ServiceNow leader who has successfully helped build and scale a consulting and services business and understands how to turn market opportunity into a focused, repeatable growth strategy. This is not simply a sales leadership position.


The Vice President will serve as the senior leader of the ServiceNow practice, bringing together Sales, Solution Consulting, and Operations & Delivery under a clear strategy and operating model. This leader will be responsible for determining where and how PTG competes, strengthening PTG's position within the ServiceNow ecosystem, building a scalable growth roadmap, developing the team and organizational structure as the practice grows, and ensuring commercial decisions translate into successful and profitable customer outcomes.


The right candidate will bring deep ServiceNow ecosystem experience, strong consulting and services business acumen, and the judgment that comes from having helped scale a ServiceNow business before. This individual should be equally comfortable setting long-term direction, coaching a team through a complex pursuit, challenging an investment decision, engaging ServiceNow leadership, and making the day-to-day decisions necessary to move a growing practice forward.

What You'll Own

Practice Strategy & Direction

  • Own and develop the strategic roadmap for PTG's ServiceNow practice, establishing clear priorities for near-term execution and long-term growth.
  • Determine where PTG should compete, how the practice should differentiate, and where the company should invest to drive sustainable growth.
  • Evaluate opportunities across net-new business, install-base expansion, managed services, packaged offerings, new capabilities, partnerships, and other potential growth channels.
  • Translate strategy into clear priorities so investment, hiring, sales activity, capability development, and go-to-market decisions support a common direction.
  • Build the structure and operating discipline necessary to scale the practice without creating unnecessary complexity or bureaucracy.
  • Continuously assess the practice's strengths, gaps, market position, and growth opportunities and adjust the roadmap accordingly.
  • Develop business cases and recommendations for significant new offerings, investments, partnerships, and strategic initiatives.

Commercial & Growth Leadership

  • Own the overall commercial performance of the ServiceNow practice, including revenue growth, pipeline, bookings, pricing strategy, deal economics, and profitable growth.
  • Establish and lead the sales strategy for the practice.
  • Own pipeline management, forecasting discipline, account strategy, territory and account alignment, and overall sales performance.
  • Establish expectations, processes, and accountability across the sales organization while maintaining PTG's collaborative, discovery-led approach.
  • Provide experienced guidance on deal structure, pricing, commercial models, and pursuit strategy.
  • Serve as an executive leader on PTG's largest, most complex, or strategically important pursuits.
  • Identify opportunities to turn successful customer engagements, capabilities, and solutions into repeatable growth motions.
  • Open doors and leverage industry relationships where appropriate while enabling Account Executives to maintain day-to-day ownership of their accounts and opportunities.
  • Assess the sales organization as the practice grows and recommend additional talent, roles, territories, or capabilities as needed.

ServiceNow Ecosystem & Market Leadership

  • Strengthen PTG's position, visibility, and credibility within the ServiceNow ecosystem.
  • Build and maintain senior relationships across relevant ServiceNow sales, public sector, partner, and regional leadership organizations.
  • Develop a deliberate strategy for increasing ServiceNow awareness of PTG's capabilities and creating stronger co-sell and partner-led opportunities.
  • Position PTG as a partner ServiceNow leaders and sellers trust and actively want to bring into customer opportunities.
  • Ensure PTG is taking full advantage of applicable ServiceNow partner programs, competencies, designations, enablement opportunities, and market investments.
  • Represent PTG credibly with ServiceNow executives, customers, partners, and other industry stakeholders.
  • Maintain a strong understanding of changes within ServiceNow's market strategy, product direction, partner ecosystem, and competitive environment and translate those changes into action for PTG.

Practice Leadership & Operating Model

  • Serve as the senior leader across the ServiceNow practice, aligning Sales, Solution Consulting, and Operations & Delivery around common priorities and outcomes.
  • Establish clear roles, decision rights, accountability, and operating expectations across the practice.
  • Provide decisive leadership and experienced guidance when teams need direction, particularly in complex pursuits, customer situations, investment decisions, and cross-functional issues.
  • Create repeatable operating models for how the practice approaches sales pursuits, proposals, customer engagement, new offerings, strategic initiatives, and internal decision-making.
  • Ensure the practice remains focused on agreed priorities rather than pursuing disconnected initiatives that do not support the broader strategy.
  • Build an organizational structure that evolves appropriately as the business grows rather than adding layers ahead of demonstrated need.
  • Develop leaders and team members while creating clear expectations for performance and accountability.

Sales, Solution Consulting & Delivery Alignment

  • Lead the Account Executive, Solution Consulting, and Operations & Delivery leadership functions as an integrated practice.
  • Preserve and strengthen collaboration between Sales and Solution Consulting while establishing clear accountability for each function.
  • Ensure Delivery is engaged appropriately throughout the sales lifecycle so commitments are feasible, appropriately scoped, and aligned with execution capabilities.
  • Partner closely with the Director of Operations & Delivery on capacity, capability, delivery risk, customer health, and execution readiness.
  • Own final practice-level business decisions while ensuring material delivery risks and feasibility concerns are surfaced, understood, and appropriately addressed.
  • Ensure commercial decisions consider scope, delivery requirements, staffing, margin, customer outcomes, and long-term account value—not simply revenue.
  • Intervene when cross-functional issues require senior leadership, clear direction, or accountability.

Leadership & Decision Authority

The Vice President is expected to operate with significant autonomy and make day-to-day strategic, commercial, organizational, and operational decisions for the ServiceNow practice.


The role will partner with the COO / Executive Sponsor on significant matters including major changes to practice strategy, material investments outside established budgets, significant organizational expansion, executive-level hiring or termination decisions, acquisitions, and other decisions with broader PTG implications.


As the leader establishes a strong understanding of PTG's business, culture, customers, and financial model, the expectation is increased autonomy—not continued executive dependence for routine practice decisions.


Required Experience

  • Significant leadership experience within the ServiceNow ecosystem, with a strong understanding of how ServiceNow's sales, partner, and services ecosystem operates.
  • Demonstrated experience helping build, lead, or scale a ServiceNow consulting and professional services business.
  • Proven experience leading sales teams and developing high-performing commercial organizations.
  • Strong understanding of consulting and professional services economics, including pricing, margin, utilization implications, staffing considerations, and deal structure.
  • Demonstrated experience developing and executing growth strategies rather than solely carrying an individual sales quota.
  • Proven ability to lead complex enterprise pursuits and provide experienced guidance on deal strategy and commercial models.
  • Established relationships and credibility within the ServiceNow ecosystem, with evidence of successfully converting ecosystem relationships into business opportunity and strategic alignment.
  • Experience selling consulting and technology services to public sector customers or significant experience supporting organizations focused on public sector markets.
  • Demonstrated ability to lead cross-functional teams that include Sales, Solution Consulting, and Delivery.
  • Experience making organizational, investment, and go-to-market decisions in a growing business environment.

Preferred Experience

  • Experience scaling a ServiceNow consulting/services practice through a comparable stage of growth.
  • Experience working for a ServiceNow implementation partner, consulting organization, or within ServiceNow in a role with significant partner/services exposure.
  • Experience developing managed services or other recurring services offerings.
  • Experience building repeatable or packaged ServiceNow offerings.
  • Experience with ServiceNow subscription/resale models.
  • Experience working with public sector procurement vehicles and complex government buying processes.

Leadership Profile

We are looking for a leader who:

  • Is decisive and comfortable making informed decisions with incomplete information.
  • Has the confidence and experience to provide clear direction rather than escalating routine decisions upward.
  • Can challenge Sales, Delivery, executives, and customers constructively when necessary.
  • Is commercially minded without sacrificing delivery quality or customer outcomes.
  • Thinks strategically but remains close enough to the business to understand what is actually happening.
  • Brings structure and discipline without creating unnecessary bureaucracy.
  • Communicates clearly, directly, and consistently.

raw.title: Backend Software Engineer
raw.excerpt: About MegaportWe’re not your typical tech company – and we don’t want to be.
raw.description:
About Megaport

We’re not your typical tech company – and we don’t want to be. Megaport is the global leader in Network as a Service (NaaS), and has transformed the way businesses connect to the cloud, data centers, and each other. We’re publicly listed on the Australian Stock Exchange and partnered with the biggest names in tech like Amazon, Microsoft, Google, Oracle, IBM, and more. Headquartered in Brisbane with a crew of over 600 people spread across Asia-Pacific, Europe, and the Americas, our employees enjoy an environment that is collaborative, supportive, and (actually) fun.

Our Team Culture

We’re a team of problem solvers, pixel pushers, code slingers, and cloud fanatics. Culture is more than a poster on the wall here – collaboration beats hierarchy, curiosity fuels our growth, and everyone’s voice matters. We take our work seriously, but not ourselves. We work across time zones to execute on our global vision, trust each other to get things done, and never compromise our values for commercial gain. Most importantly, we place our customers at the center of everything we do.
We’re committed to increasing representation in the tech industry and welcome applicants from all backgrounds. Don’t meet every requirement? That’s okay. If you’re excited about this role, we encourage you to apply.

Your Role

You’ve got a few years of building backend services under your belt, and you’re ready to own real features on systems that customers depend on every day.

We’re looking for a mid-level Backend Engineer to join our Engineering team and help us ship high-quality software, faster. Reporting to the Engineering Manager, you’ll work on the core systems behind the Megaport platform — the APIs and services that turn a click in the Portal into provisioned connectivity between data centers on opposite sides of the world.

Our main codebase is a mixture of Java and Kotlin using the Spring Boot framework, and we are migrating fully to Kotlin over time. You don’t need Kotlin on day one, but you’ll be writing it before long.

You'll work alongside a skilled, driven team, and have genuine room to shape how we solve problems. Our backend engineers also run a dedicated mentoring program, so you'll have someone in your corner as you grow.

What You’ll Be Doing

  • Design, build and ship backend services and APIs, from an ambiguous problem through to tested, maintainable code in production.
  • Work in a modern JVM stack including Java, Kotlin, Spring Boot, Postgres, RabbitMQ and Redis, and help shape how we use it.
  • Ship to a Kubernetes and AWS platform where GitHub Actions handle the heavy lifting, so you spend your time on the product rather than on infrastructure.
  • Turn business requirements into technical solutions, and speak up when a requirement doesn't quite add up. We'd rather you asked why before how.
  • Collaborate with engineers, product, and stakeholders across the business to build systems that stay reliable, secure and fast as we grow.
  • Write JUnit and Kotest tests that let us ship with confidence, and take part in code review as both author and reviewer.
  • Help improve our architecture, patterns and processes, and keep our technical debt in check to ensure the codebase remains flexible and well-maintained.

What We Are Looking For

    We care as much about how you think and work as what you already know. The technical bar matters, but so does curiosity, clear communication, and the drive to own your work.

    You'll thrive here if you:

  • Have a few years building backend services in Java or Kotlin.
  • Are comfortable working with Spring, and have a sense of what it's doing for you.
  • Know your way around relational databases and can model data with an eye on how it'll be queried.
  • Communicate clearly — you can explain a technical trade-off to an engineer and to a non-engineer, and you listen as well as you talk.
  • Like solving problems, and can think critically about them. You dig into the why, weigh options, and aren't satisfied with "it works" when it could be right.
  • Take ownership — you're keen to pick up a problem, run with it, and see it through.

    • Nice to have (or happy to help you learn):

  • Kotlin, or an appetite for picking it up.
  • Experience with Go or Terraform. We maintain our own Terraform Provider, and we’re upskilling the team to build on it.
  • Experience with ORMs like Hibernate, and a sense of when not to reach for one.
  • Knowledge of the major cloud providers’ products or APIs. We integrate directly with AWS, Azure and GCP to provision customer connectivity.
  • An interest in networking — IP routing, MPLS, or just how the internet actually fits together.

What We Offer

  • Flexible working environment — Brisbane-based with one or two days a week in the office, or fully remote anywhere in Australia with good overlap with east-coast hours
  • Generous leave plans — including parental leave, birthday leave, and a purchased annual leave program
  • Health and wellness support — through a wellness allowance and employee wellbeing initiatives
  • Comprehensive learning support — generous study and training allowance plus paid study leave
  • Creative, modern workspaces — designed to inspire when you're not working remotely, plus access to coworking spaces via our global WeWork membership if you work remotely, but like to get out of the house sometimes
  • Motivated, inclusive team — work alongside industry experts and fresh talent
  • Recognition programs — celebrate achievements with our Legend and Kudos awards
If you have any questions, please reach out to Megaport's Talent Acquisition Team at
NOTE: All Megaport business correspondence is conducted via our business email accounts (@megaport.com). If you have any concerns, please reach out to Megaport's careers team directly and we will verify the legitimacy of any communication. Megaport will not ask you to create an account via Microsoft teams, and does not associate with any email accounts under "@megaportau.com".
All applications will be treated in confidence.
Please see Part 2 of our Privacy Policy to see what information Megaport collects from job applicants, why, and how we store and use it. Note that you’re entitled to know what personal data of yours Megaport holds, to request updates, rectification, and in some circumstances restriction or deletion thereof if you object (you being entitled to withdraw your consent to our holding your information at any time). Please see Part 5 of our Privacy Policy for more details on this and how to contact Megaport's data protection officer if you have any further privacy-related questions. Candidates who meet the selection criteria will be invited to attend an interview. Strictly no Recruitment Agencies.

raw.description:
What Do We Do?

Triple Whale is the AI operating system built for modern commmerce. We help you see what's actually working in your business, what's not, and what to do next. Then we take action for you — pausing the underperforming ad, generating the next batch of creative, flagging the inventory risk before it hurts your bottom line.

We pull every signal in your business into one place, and put it on the most trusted measurement foundation in the industry. And on top of that, we give you the only AI harness in commerce — Moby — letting you tap any LLM you want, grounded in the full context of your business. Moby doesn't just surface insights, it executes decisions for you, with automations that make the rest of your stack smarter.

The result: more than 65,000 brands like Kitsch, OUAI, and True Classic turn mountains of complex data into actions that actually grow profit, at a speed and scale that is not humanly possible.

Why Triple Whale Needs You

This is not a passive relationship management role. It's a hands-on, technically demanding position where you'll be the first person a brand trusts with their data stack — and the last thing standing between them and churn.

As a CSM on the Growth team, you'll guide a high-volume book of eCommerce brands through the full onboarding lifecycle — owning every technical configuration, every kickoff call, and every moment where the platform either clicks or doesn't. Once a brand is live, you stay in their corner as a scaled, data-driven consultant across a shared inbox, live chat, and office hours model.

The people who thrive here move fast, think in systems, love solving technical puzzles for non-technical users, and genuinely care about whether a brand succeeds.

What You'll Do

  • Own an active book of onboardings end-to-end — from kickoff call through nurture — operating with speed, ownership, and clear communication at every step.
  • Run structured kickoff calls that map each customer's tech stack, stakeholders, and goals before diving into configuration.
  • Guide customers through Triple Pixel installation: enabling Theme App Embed and Checkout Web Pixel in Shopify, validating with live URL tests, and advising on third-party/landing page installs via GTM.
  • Configure and validate UTM and tracking parameters (tw_source, tw_campaign, tw_ad_id) with platform-specific dynamic tokens, ensuring Triple Whale attribution is capturing data accurately across all paid channels.
  • Connect and troubleshoot coreintegrations — Meta, Google Ads, TikTok, Klaviyo, Google Sheets, Slack — preventing feature-blockers before they happen.
  • Walk customers through the Summary and Attribution dashboards — validating clean data, configuring Custom Metrics (CM1/CM2, blended ROAS), and explaining attribution model selection (Triple Attribution, Last Click, First Click, Linear) based on their business use case.
  • Manage your onboarding and success pipelines in HubSpot, tracking health and milestone progress from kickoff through renewal.
  • Collaborate with Sales on unresponsive customers and with Support on technical escalations, keeping onboarding velocity high across your entire book.
  • Manage a high-volume, scaled customer portfolio through shared inbox, live chat, and office hours — driving retention and satisfaction in a fast-paced, largely automated environment.
  • Proactively identify churn risk early: monitor usage patterns, flag cost-based objections, and develop resolution strategies before the renewal conversation.
  • Drive expansion by identifying upsell opportunities within the Growth segment and collaborating cross-functionally to move them forward.
  • Contribute to the continued development of the Triple Whale customer experience — improving playbooks, surfacing common friction points, and helping the team get better every quarter.

What You'll Bring

  • Experience supporting customers in the eCommerce or marketing technology space — ideally within a SaaS environment.
  • Demonstrated comfort with technical setup and configuration: you don't need to be an engineer, but you need to be the kind of person who learns a new platform thoroughly and can confidently walk someone else through it.
  • Familiarity with the eCommerce marketing stack — Meta Ads, Google Ads, TikTok, Klaviyo, Shopify, UTM tracking — is a strong advantage.
  • Prior high-volume customer success, customer support, or SDR experience; you know how to manage a large book of accounts without letting things fall through the cracks.
  • Superb written and verbal communication skills — you can translate complex technical concepts into clear, actionable guidance for operators who are experts in their business, not in analytics.
  • Strong organizational skills and comfort managing multiple onboardings simultaneously in a fast-moving, process-driven environment.
  • A natural sense of ownership: you're the kind of person who tracks things down, follows up proactively, and doesn't wait to be asked.
  • Positive, high-energy, service-oriented mindset — customers feel your investment in their success.
  • Comfort driving negotiation and renewal conversations to positive outcomes.
  • Thrives in collaborative team environments and embraces change as the product and processes continue to evolve.

Join Us in Making Waves

If you’re looking for more than just a job and want to be part of a movement reshaping the future of Ecommerce, Triple Whale is the place for you. We’re on the lookout for driven, curious, and creative individuals ready to thrive in a fast-paced environment.

Referred? Got here thanks to a friend? Splash some gratitude their way! They'll need to submit your application through our referral system to make it official.

raw.description:
About Constellation Kidney Group

The Constellation Kidney Group (CKG), part of the Miram Solutions Portfolio of the Perseus Group within Constellation Software Inc. Group of companies, is a global leader in dialysis technology serving kidney care providers across seven countries. CKG’s integrated KidneyOne platform brings together modern EHR, analytics, and interoperability capabilities built on over 50 years of innovation, helping providers optimize care, operations, and compliance.

CKG’s US solution portfolio spans Clinical Vision (CV), FOCUS Billing, CKG Intelligence, Renal AI, DrFirst/e-Prescribe, and related platform services supporting dialysis providers across clinical documentation, billing, analytics, and regulatory compliance.

Role Summary

The Head, Client Training & Adoption is accountable for the end-to-end design, delivery, and continuous improvement of client-facing training programs and revenue cycle management (RCM) education across CKG’s US operations. Reporting to the Director of Professional Services, this role serves as the single point of expertise bridging product training, clinical workflow enablement, and medical billing knowledge ensuring clients achieve measurable adoption, operational proficiency, and financial performance outcomes across the KidneyOne platform.

Day to day, the Head, Client Training & Adoption designs scalable curricula spanning clinical and billing workflows, leads training engagements tied to implementation milestones and go-live readiness, and acts as the primary RCM subject-matter expert for client-facing billing questions, denial resolution guidance, and revenue cycle optimization. This role partners closely with implementation project teams, the Engagement organization (Clinical & Billing Services), and the RCM team to drive feature adoption, support retention and expansion, and translate complex payer and regulatory requirements into actionable education for both clients and internal teams.

In this role, ‘clients’ encompasses both external customers dialysis providers using the KidneyOne platform and internal teams who rely on product and billing proficiency to serve those customers effectively. External-facing work centers on client training and adoption; internal-facing work centers on product enablement, ensuring every team that touches the client experience has the knowledge and confidence to deliver.

Key Responsibilities

1. Training Strategy & Program Ownership

  • Own the overall client and internal product training strategy and annual roadmap across client-facing and internal education, aligning training priorities to CKG’s business objectives, product roadmap, and client success goals.
  • Help set the standard for how product / client training is designed, delivered, and measured across CKG establishing consistent quality, methodology, and governance for all education programs.
  • Define product / client training program priorities in partnership with Professional Services, Engagement, and Product Management leadership, ensuring resources are allocated to highest-impact initiatives.
  • Maintain a rolling training roadmap that accounts for product releases, implementation schedules, client adoption goals, and internal enablement needs.

2. Client Training Program Design & Delivery

  • Design and deliver comprehensive role-based training programs across all CKG platforms including Clinical Vision, FOCUS Billing, CKG Intelligence, Renal AI, and DrFirst/e-Prescribe tailored to client workflows and operational environments.
  • Develop scalable curricula, certification-style training pathways, and continuous learning programs that support client onboarding, platform proficiency, and ongoing maturity.
  • Lead end-user, super-user, and train-the-trainer sessions, embedding change-management principles to accelerate adoption and reduce time to value.
  • Create and maintain a library of training assets including role-based guides, video learning modules, recorded webinars, and step-by-step platform walkthroughs.
  • Own the learning management system (LMS), e-learning content, knowledge base, and self-service content library for clients and internal teams.
  • Develop and maintain quick reference guides (QRGs) and short, focused videos for common tasks and new features.
  • Deliver regular webinars for clients and internal teams covering product releases, best practices, and feature deep dives.

3. Revenue Cycle Management Subject-Matter Expertise

  • Serve as the primary RCM subject-matter expert for client-facing billing and revenue cycle questions, providing credible, knowledgeable guidance on claims processing, payer requirements, and reimbursement workflows.
  • Maintain deep knowledge of commercial, Medicare, Medicaid, and managed care billing rules, including dialysis-specific reimbursement requirements, NPA, unbilled charges, COB, denials, underpayments, and payer nuances.
  • Interpret payer behavior, billing outcomes, and denial patterns to develop targeted training content that addresses root causes and drives measurable improvement in client revenue cycle performance.
  • Develop and deliver RCM-specific training modules covering denial prevention, appeals workflows, A/R aging management, and compliance with CMS and commercial payer requirements.

4. Implementation & Go-Live Training Support

  • Partner closely with implementation project teams to structure training plans aligned to project milestones, configuration timelines, and go-live readiness criteria.
  • Coordinate with Professional Services Group (PSG) to manage education-related backlog items, ensuring visibility, prioritization, and timely execution of training deliverables.
  • Maintain reporting on training workload, backlog trends, and delivery performance to support operational decision-making and resource planning.
  • Standardize training documentation, templates, and repeatable processes to enable consistent, scalable delivery across implementations.

5. Client Feature Adoption & Expansion Support

  • Drive awareness and utilization of product features including advanced reporting, analytics dashboards, and AI-supported clinical and billing tools through structured education and value-driven workshops.
  • Support Engagement team activities for client retention and account growth through education-based conversations that demonstrate product value and identify expansion opportunities.
  • Create learning pathways that highlight cross-product synergies across the KidneyOne platform, enabling clients to realize the full value of their investment.
  • Participate in client-facing strategy sessions where training and RCM expertise contribute to adoption, change management, or performance improvement plans.

6. Internal Product Onboarding & Enablement

  • Deliver structured product and RCM training across CKG internal teams ensuring consistent, high-quality client interactions.
  • Equip internal staff with billing subject-matter knowledge, product workflow expertise, and training tools to handle client questions and escalations effectively.
  • Own and continuously improve product onboarding for all new employees, including an introduction to each CKG product, role-specific training, and role-playing exercises to build confidence and assess readiness.
  • Implement certification or readiness checks so employees are verified as prepared before supporting clients establishing clear proficiency gates tied to product and billing knowledge.
  • Drive internal teams’ readiness on new products and releases before they reach clients, ensuring staff can support and articulate changes from day one.
  • undefined

7. Compliance & Patient Safety in Training Content

  • Ensure all training content reflects relevant HIPAA requirements, including patient data handling, privacy safeguards, and security protocols applicable to CKG’s products and client workflows.
  • Incorporate CMS regulatory requirements including conditions for coverage, billing compliance, and quality reporting obligations into client and internal training curricula.
  • Embed patient-safety considerations specific to dialysis providers into clinical workflow training, ensuring staff and clients understand the care implications of system use and data accuracy.
  • Partner with Compliance and Clinical teams to keep training materials current with regulatory changes, audit findings, and industry best practices for healthcare IT in the dialysis space.

8. Measurement, Reporting & Continuous Improvement

  • Track and report the impact of training programs on client adoption metrics, implementation success rates, Net Revenue Retention (NRR), and client satisfaction.
  • Monitor the effectiveness of training programs by measuring engagement, completion, and effectiveness outcomes across all training programs to identify gaps and inform curriculum evolution.
  • Incorporate client feedback, RCM performance data, and internal stakeholder input into a continuous improvement cycle for all training content and delivery methods.
  • Translate revenue cycle performance insights including A/R aging, denial trends, and collection performance into updated training materials and proactive client education.
  • Track time-to-readiness for new hires as a success measure, measuring how quickly new employees achieve product and billing proficiency sufficient to support clients independently.

9. Instructional Design & Learning Best Practices

  • Apply learning best practices and instructional design methodologies and adult learning principles to ensure all programs drive measurable knowledge transfer and behavior change.
  • Evaluate and recommend training delivery techniques, live virtual, on-site, self-paced e-learning, and blended approaches to optimize engagement and accessibility across client populations.
  • Stay up to date with training trends and best practices in healthcare technology training, client education, and learning management systems to continuously elevate program quality and reach.

10. Cross-Functional Partnership

  • Partner closely with Product Management to align training content with the product roadmap, upcoming features, and known client pain points.
  • Collaborate with Support to identify recurring client issues and translate them into targeted training content that reduces ticket volume and improves first-contact resolution.
  • Work with Implementation and Engagement teams to ensure training is tightly integrated into the client lifecycle from onboarding through go-live, adoption, and ongoing account health.
  • Coordinate with RCM Services so that billing education reflects current payer behavior, denial trends, and the issues coming up most often in day-to-day operations.
  • Partner with Product Management to ensure training materials, release notes, and internal teams are ready ahead of each product release, so clients and staff are prepared before new features reach production.

Qualifications

Required

  • 7+ years of progressive experience in client training, instructional design, or learning & development within healthcare technology, SaaS, or revenue cycle management environments.
  • Demonstrated subject-matter expertise in medical billing and revenue cycle management including commercial, Medicare, Medicaid, and managed care billing rules.
  • Experience in training delivery, instructional design, or related experience tied to software implementation, product adoption, and client success outcomes.
  • Strong understanding of dialysis or nephrology healthcare workflows (clinical and/or billing) preferred, or demonstrable ability to acquire deep domain knowledge rapidly.
  • Proficiency in training delivery techniques, presentation skills, and facilitation of group discussions across diverse client audiences.
  • Excellent communication skills (written and verbal) with the ability to translate complex technical and billing concepts into clear, actionable training content.
  • Proven project management skills with the ability to manage multiple concurrent training engagements, deadlines, and stakeholder relationships.
  • Proficiency with billing systems, payer portals, reporting tools, LMS platforms, and standard productivity tools (Excel, PowerPoint, Word).
  • Working knowledge of HIPAA privacy and security requirements and familiarity with CMS regulatory frameworks relevant to dialysis and healthcare IT.

Strongly Preferred

  • Experience with dialysis-specific EHR, billing, or RCM platforms (e.g., Clinical Vision, FOCUS Billing, or comparable systems).
  • Background in professional services, implementation consulting, or client success roles within healthcare IT.
  • Experience with denial management, appeals, payer dispute resolution, and reimbursement optimization.
  • Familiarity with CMS or other healthcare regulatory requirements relevant to dialysis providers.
  • Education in Instructional Design, Education, or related field; instructional design certification (e.g., ATD, CPTD) or equivalent.
  • Experience building scalable e-learning content, certification programs, or learning management system curricula.
  • Experience in high-growth healthtech or multi-entity healthcare environments.
  • Analytical mindset with the ability to interpret training effectiveness data, RCM performance metrics, and client feedback to drive program improvements.

raw.description:
An applied research team within NVIDIA’s Networking Systems & Software Architecture group is solving some of AI’s hardest infrastructure problems. The team builds systems-level software that moves data between GPUs, nodes, and storage at the speed modern AI demands—spanning low-level transport optimization, hardware-software co-design, and communication frameworks that plug directly into production AI stacks. The team's charter expands into emerging domains including quantum computing interconnects.

The Senior Architect role is to own modules and projects end-to-end—from scoping research questions to shipping production code. It calls for a recognized expert who drives technical decisions, pulls in ideas from research and industry, and regularly prototypes new approaches to prove a point. The work lives at the boundary of applied research and production engineering!

What you will be doing:

  • Architecting and implementing high-performance communication and memory management libraries for distributed AI

  • Driving hardware-software co-optimization with GPU, DPU, NIC, and switch teams through GPUDirect RDMA, NVLink, and next-generation interconnects

  • Profiling and optimizing data movement across GPU memory, system DRAM, NVMe, and network fabrics

  • Integrating networking capabilities into AI serving stacks such as vLLM, SGLang, and TensorRT-LLM

  • Contributing to and maintaining open-source projects, mentoring engineers, conducting design reviews, and prototyping experimental technologies to evaluate their viability

What we need to see:

  • 12+ years in systems software and/or networking with demonstrated ownership of complex projects.

  • MS, PhD or equivalent experience in Computer Science, Computer Engineering, Electrical Engineering, or a related field.

  • Solid understanding of high-performance networking: InfiniBand, RoCE, RDMA, NVLink, GPUDirect.

  • Strong C/C++/Rust systems programming with comfort in performance profiling and low-level debugging.

  • Understanding of ML systems concepts—transformer architectures, KV cache mechanics, model parallelism, or distributed training and inference patterns.

Ways to stand out from the crowd:

  • Knowledge of ML inference frameworks (vLLM, SGLang, TensorRT-LLM) and their communication requirements.

  • Knowledge of storage networking (NVMe-oF, GPUDirect Storage, S3).

  • Background of Reinforcement Learning systems.

With competitive salaries and a comprehensive benefits package, NVIDIA is widely regarded as one of the most desirable technology employers in the world. Our teams are composed of some of the most forward‑thinking and driven engineers in the industry, and we continue to grow rapidly. If you are a senior data engineer passionate about building large‑scale, high‑impact data platforms, we’d love to hear from you.

Your base salary will be determined based on your location, experience, and the pay of employees in similar positions. The base salary range is 224,000 USD - 356,500 USD for Level 5, and 272,000 USD - 431,250 USD for Level 6.

You will also be eligible for equity and benefits.

Applications for this job will be accepted at least until November 2, 2026.

ABOUT THE TEPA COMPANIES


Established in 2005 and owned by the Paskenta Band of Nomlaki Indians, The Tepa Companies deliver comprehensive and sustainable solutions to federal, state, local, and private-sector clients throughout the United States. The tribally owned companies work independently and collaboratively to provide wide-ranging construction, engineering, environmental, industrial, staffing, and technology services.


When you join Tepa Companies, you have the opportunity to expand your entrepreneurial skill set while growing professionally alongside the best in the industry. You will have the opportunity to impact your team, the organization as a whole, and subsequently, our Tribe.


We seek out top talent to provide the best services for our clients. We focus on being a responsible company for our employees and their families by creating a culture that reflects our core values and offering competitive pay and benefits package. Our benefits package includes comprehensive medical, dental, vision, generous paid time off and holidays, 401(k) plan with company match, life insurance, flexible spending and health savings account, mental health support and resources, short and long-term disability, and tuition reimbursement.

LOCATION: Remote


ABOUT THE JOB


The Tepa Companies are seeking a Senior Project Manager to own and manage all aspects of projects to include client relationships, schedules, budgets, and profitability through comprehensive project completion. This role collaborates with Superintendents, Quality Control Managers, and Site Safety Officers to ensure contractual requirements are met and exceeded. The Senior Project Manager works with and trains other Project Managers to ensure their wealth of knowledge is shared and utilized throughout all projects.

  • Ensures Tepa Core Values are being practiced by all Tepa staff
  • Creates a project schedule in P6 as required
  • Establishes a budget based on scope, estimate, and subcontractor quotes
  • Manages the project and its development from beginning to end
  • Facilitates the definition of project scope, goals and deliverables.
  • Manages every aspect of the development process including consultants, subcontractors, vendors, specialty contractors, budgets, and internal departments
  • Manages each phase of the project including entitlement, design-build, permitting, bidding, contracting, construction, billing, and project close out
  • Plans, schedules, and manages project timelines to see all deadlines are met
  • Presents reports defining project progress, problems and solutions
  • Performs cost estimating
  • Performs quality control and assurance
  • Performs budget development, forecasting and management
  • Establishes site office and communications
  • Tracks RFIs
  • Evaluates superintendents and QCs
  • Conducts pre-qualification and procurement activities (buyout) of subcontractors
  • Ensure project requirements are being met for bonding and insurance per current Tepa standards
  • Initiates and works through Cure Process with Subcontractors/Vendors when required
  • Verifies Superintendent’s 3-Week Look Ahead Schedule
  • Updates and maintains budget in ERP and delivers reports as required
  • Performs cost and risk analysis and provides recommendations to management
  • Maintains open communication with field staff regarding all issues and work to resolutions
  • Communicates frequently all project, client, and staff concerns to EVP and/or Operations Manager
  • Trains Project Managers, Quality Control Managers, Superintendents, and Site Safety Officers as required to ensure project staff meet or exceed Tepa standards
  • Works with Proposal Management and Business Development staff to deliver complete proposals on time
  • Writes Technical Approaches and other proposal documents as required
  • Manages design process on Design Build projects
  • Works with EVP and/or Operations Manager and staff to ensure Tepa Employees are being treated fairly and their concerns are being addressed
  • Works with Human Resources/Recruiting group through hiring and disciplinary process as required
  • Has decision making authority at project level as designated by EVP and/or Operations Manager
  • Travels to project sites, typically 1–2 times per month, with additional or extended travel based on assigned project requirements as directed by the EVP or Operations Manager.

WHAT WE’RE LOOKING FOR


  • Bachelor’s degree in construction/engineering or similar
  • 10+ years of construction project management experience in new and vertical construction, and the design-build construction process
  • 5+ years experience working on federal construction projects (USACE, NAVFAC, GSA, VA, NPS, or other federal agencies)
  • Proven experience establishing and maintaining effective project management control systems in compliance with contract requirements on USACE and other projects including field experience providing oversight on construction site work activities.
  • Capable of running multiple projects simultaneously
  • Ability to build rapport with field staff, office staff, clientele, Tepa management staff, subcontractors
  • Ability to manage time efficiently.
  • Must possess ability to communicate in a professional manner both verbally and in writing.
  • Good understanding of administrative and management principles involved in project planning, resource allocation, leadership technique, production methods, and coordination of people and resources to assist in quality control management.
  • Must be able to obtain and maintain required authorization to access U.S. military installations and other client/project sites, as applicable to assigned work.

raw.excerpt: OverviewThe AWS DevSecOps Engineer builds, secures, and operates the AWS environments and automated delivery pipelines that PhoenixTeam uses for internal and client applications.
raw.description:
Overview

The AWS DevSecOps Engineer builds, secures, and operates the AWS environments and automated delivery pipelines that PhoenixTeam uses for internal and client applications. This is a hands-on production engineering role spanning infrastructure as code, container deployment, CI/CD, security controls integrated into releases, reliability, and incident recovery. The engineer uses shared Platform patterns to make deployment repeatable rather than relying on one-off application setups.

Agentic orchestration is a primary delivery approach: the engineer designs, supervises, and verifies AI-assisted workflows for testing, hardening, containerization, infrastructure provisioning, and deployment. Success depends on independent AWS, DevSecOps, and security judgment—especially when generated scripts or configurations are wrong. The goal is to improve speed and reliability from prototype through production without bypassing security reviews or release controls.

Key Functions

  • Build and operate AWS infrastructure using Terraform, AWS CDK, or CloudFormation, including VPC networking, IAM, ECS/Fargate or EKS, RDS, load balancing, KMS, Secrets Manager, S3, and CloudWatch.
  • Implement application infrastructure within shared Platform patterns; support multi-account controls using AWS Organizations, Control Tower, service control policies, or comparable guardrails.
  • Own build, test, approval, and deployment pipelines as code using GitHub Actions, Forgejo Actions, AWS CodePipeline, or comparable tools; create reusable, documented workflows.
  • Embed SAST, DAST, software-composition/dependency, container-image, and infrastructure-as-code scanning in release stages; maintain blocking criteria and escalate risk acceptance and exceptions to authorized decision-makers.
  • Apply least-privilege IAM, encryption, secrets handling, network isolation, and controlled production access; constrain what automation and AI agents can access or change.
  • Design and verify agent-executable playbooks for hardening, testing, provisioning, and deployment; independently review and test generated code, infrastructure definitions, and security evidence.
  • Support blue/green or canary deployment and tested rollback; use lead time, deployment frequency, failure rate, and recovery metrics to improve reliable release delivery.
  • Implement logs, metrics, tracing, health checks, alerts, and cost visibility; participate in a rotating on-call schedule, respond to incidents, and contribute to post-incident reviews and runbooks.
  • Use AWS security and audit tooling such as Security Hub, GuardDuty, Config, CloudTrail, Inspector, and IAM Access Analyzer as applicable; remediate findings and support relevant evidence needs.
  • Work with application engineers, Platform, QA/verification, and client security stakeholders to support secure handoffs and explain deployment decisions, controls, and human verification.

Minimum Qualifications

  • 5+ years of hands-on DevOps, DevSecOps, site reliability, or platform engineering experience, including production responsibility, infrastructure automation, and deployment or incident recovery.
  • Strong production AWS experience spanning VPC/networking, IAM, ECS or EKS, RDS, KMS, secrets management, CloudWatch, and CloudTrail.
  • Experience deploying containerized workloads with Docker and building production infrastructure as code using Terraform, AWS CDK, or CloudFormation.
  • Experience owning CI/CD pipelines as code, including automated testing, security gates, release promotion, troubleshooting, and rollback.
  • Hands-on experience integrating SAST, DAST, SCA/dependency, container, and infrastructure-as-code security checks into delivery workflows.
  • Ability to script automation in Python, Bash, or Go and independently validate generated scripts and infrastructure configurations.
  • Practical understanding of least-privilege access, encryption, secure credential handling, and NIST SP 800-53 or a comparable security-control framework.
  • Ability to supervise and verify AI-assisted engineering workflows with independent judgment; clear written and verbal communication with technical and non-technical partners.

Preferred Qualifications or Skills

  • Experience with LLM-assisted or multi-agent engineering automation, including Amazon Bedrock or comparable orchestration tools.
  • AWS multi-account landing-zone expertise; policy-as-code or guardrails using OPA, Checkov, cfn-guard, SCPs, or comparable controls.
  • Experience supporting SOC 2 or other applicable commercial security assessments and automated audit evidence.
  • Relevant AWS professional, cloud security, or security engineering certification.
  • Client-facing delivery in mortgage, financial services, or another regulated industry; experience mentoring engineers in reliable pipeline practices.

Position Details

  • Employment type: Full-Time, W2 employee; not a contract or 1099 position.
  • Work arrangement: Remote-first, with flexible arrangements and collaboration across engineering and client teams.
  • On-call: Participation in a rotating schedule to support production systems and incident response is required; coverage details will be discussed during hiring.
  • Travel: Up to 10% may be required based on business or client needs.

About PhoenixTeam

PhoenixTeam partners with organizations to deliver real results across GenAI, data, product, and technology. We help clients modernize legacy systems, redesign complex workflows, and move practical AI and digital solutions into production in regulated environments.

PhoenixTeam is an Equal Opportunity Employer. We consider qualified applicants without regard to race, color, religion, sex, national origin, age, disability, genetic information, protected veteran status, or any other status protected by applicable law.

Capture Manager

About Doodle Labs

Doodle Labs builds the connectivity backbone of the autonomous systems revolution — resilient wireless mesh networks that let drones, robots, and unmanned platforms operate reliably in the world's most demanding environments. We sit at the intersection of defense, robotics, and next-generation autonomy, powering the machines that are changing how militaries, first responders, and industries operate in the field. Our core purpose is simple: connect anyone and anything, at any time, in any place.

For over 25 years, our team has been at the forefront of mesh networking, partnering with leading defense programs, robotics manufacturers, and system integrators worldwide. The work here doesn't sit in a slide deck — it ends up in the field, in the hands of people for whom failure isn't an option.

About the Role

The Capture Manager is a director-level role focused on winning strategically important government contracts through competitive capture and bid strategy. You'll lead the capture process from discovery through contract award, navigating government procurement requirements, managing prime contractor relationships, and positioning Doodle Labs for success.

This role combines deep government procurement expertise with business development acumen. While your primary mandate is winning the contract, you'll also develop customer relationships that naturally surface follow-on opportunities—understanding the customer's long-term strategy and positioning Doodle Labs as a strategic partner, not just a vendor.

This is an opportunity to lead one of Doodle Labs' most strategically important pursuits and establish the foundation for expanded presence in a key international market.

What You'll Do

  • Develop and execute capture strategy and competitive positioning
  • Navigate government procurement processes and regulatory requirements across international markets
  • Manage prime contractor relationships and flow-down requirements, ensuring legal and operational compliance
  • Lead capture team execution, managing schedules, deliverables, and cross-functional alignment
  • Engage customer stakeholders at strategic and technical levels, building trust and understanding customer priorities
  • Develop customer intelligence and identify follow-on opportunities that align with customer strategy and Doodle Labs' roadmap
  • Coordinate with internal leadership and cross-functional teams to ensure alignment and strategic coherence through contract award

What Success Looks Like

  • Contract awarded with strong customer alignment and clear expectations for post-award execution
  • Capture team fully mobilized and positioned with compelling value proposition and competitive differentiation
  • Strong cross-functional alignment and stakeholder buy-in across internal teams and customer leadership
  • Clear pipeline of follow-on opportunities and customer insights positioned for future growth
  • Doodle Labs established as a trusted strategic partner with the customer, not a transactional vendor

Who You Are

  • 10+ years of progressive experience in government capture, procurement management, and/or proposal management
  • Proven track record at director level winning high-stakes government contracts at major defense primes
  • Deep understanding of international government procurement environments and regulatory frameworks
  • Legal and contract fluency: you understand prime contractor flow-down obligations, compliance requirements, and risk mitigation
  • Business development experience: you understand customer strategy, can develop consultative relationships, and naturally identify expansion opportunities
  • Politically astute: you navigate complex stakeholder dynamics and understand how government customers think and make decisions
  • Operationally excellent: you manage complex pursuits with multiple workstreams, competing priorities, and external stakeholders
  • Comfortable working in international markets and embedded with international teams
  • Entrepreneurial: you thrive in a scale-up environment where capture wins directly shape the trajectory of the company

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience with autonomous systems, robotics, wireless networking, or defense electronics
  • Experience working with OEMs or embedded systems/hardware products
  • Program management background or experience with capture-to-execution transitions
  • Fluency in European defense procurement or experience with international government agencies
  • Advanced degree in business, engineering, or related field

Why Join Doodle Labs

  • Lead and win a strategically important government contract for a cutting-edge technology company
  • Work on technology powering the future of autonomous systems and defense communications
  • Build strategic customer relationships that naturally expand into new opportunities
  • Collaborate with engineers and innovators building industry-leading connectivity solutions
  • Make a meaningful impact in a fast-growing company shaping the next generation of robotics and autonomous systems
  • Expand Doodle Labs' presence in key international markets during a critical growth phase
  • Competitive compensation package and the opportunity to grow with a scale-up building transformational technology

Travel Expectations

This role requires 20–30% travel for customer meetings, capture activities, stakeholder engagement, and team collaboration across multiple locations.

Job Description

Position Summary

The Space, Cyber and Directed Energy Segment Vice President of Engineering serves as the senior engineering authority for the segment and is responsible for establishing the technical vision, engineering rigor, and product development discipline required to support a rapidly scaling portfolio of defense and national security programs.


This leader oversees a diverse mix of engineering services and product-based businesses, balancing lightweight governance for mature service programs with rigorous systems engineering, execution oversight, and technical risk management for high-priority product development efforts.

The role partners closely with the business leadership, CTO, program management, manufacturing, and growth teams to ensure engineering excellence, product commonality, rapid deployment capability, affordability, and successful transition from development into scalable production.


The Vice President of Engineering will help mature the segment engineering organization over time, including the future establishment and leadership of Chief Engineers aligned to business units and major product lines.


Position Responsibilities
Technical Leadership & Engineering Governance

  • Serve as the senior engineering authority across the segment portfolio.
  • Establish engineering standards, technical review processes, and development rigor appropriate for both services and product organizations.
  • Ensure technical execution aligns with customer mission requirements, affordability targets, schedule commitments, and long-term product strategy.
  • Drive engineering best practices across systems engineering, software, hardware, integration, test, cybersecurity, reliability, and manufacturing readiness.
  • Lead independent technical assessments and support executive decision-making related to technical risk, investment priorities, and program execution.

Product Development & Productization

  • Support the transition from bespoke engineering efforts to scalable, repeatable product solutions.
  • Ensure engineering organizations are structured to move rapidly while maintaining technical discipline and mission assurance.
  • Promote modular architectures, common product frameworks, reuse strategies, and product commonality across programs.
  • Partner with manufacturing and operations teams to improve producibility, reliability, and lifecycle affordability.
  • Drive engineering alignment with enterprise initiatives focused on speed, agility, commercialization, and rapid deployment.

Partnership with CTO & Enterprise Engineering Alignment

  • Partner directly with the CTO to flow enterprise engineering strategies, processes, tools, and governance into the segment.
  • Support implementation of common engineering frameworks, digital engineering approaches, model-based systems engineering, and enterprise product development standards.
  • Ensure engineering organizations adopt enterprise technology roadmaps and modernization initiatives where appropriate.

Talent Strategy & Organizational Development

  • Support engineering workforce planning, hiring strategies, succession planning, and capability development across the segment.
  • Monitor engineering staffing requirements against strategic growth objectives.
  • Help shape future engineering organizational structures, including eventual establishment of Chief Engineer roles aligned to business units or product portfolios.
  • Foster a culture centered on accountability, innovation, technical excellence, collaboration, and mission focus.

Cross-Functional Collaboration

Partner closely with:

  • Business Unit leaders
  • Program Management
  • Manufacturing & Supply Chain
  • Quality
  • Finance
  • Growth & Capture
  • Security and Contracts
  • Support customer engagements, technical roadmap discussions, milestone reviews, and strategic captures.
