  • Demonstrated experience leading complex engineering organizations supporting both development and production environments.
  • Strong background in systems engineering, product development, and transition to manufacturing.
  • Experience operating within high-growth, fast-paced technology organizations.
  • Ability to balance technical rigor with speed and execution urgency.
  • Experience collaborating across enterprise engineering and business leadership organizations.
  • Strong communication skills with the ability to engage effectively with executives, customers, and technical teams.
  • Top Secret/SCI Clearance or the ability to obtain a clearance

Other Qualifications and Desired Competencies

  • Experience supporting defense acquisition programs, rapid prototyping efforts, and productized defense systems.

  • Execute Strategic Mobile Priorities: Lead the cross-functional product roadmap for the Mobile App under the Activate team’s strategy, focusing on converting DNA-first customers into Family History subscribers and streamlining early user conversion flows.
  • Bridge DNA to Family History (FH): Build and refine intuitive, high-converting "Bridges" experiences (such as connecting DNA Matches and Origins to family tree building and record exploration) that capture user curiosity and drive conversion during key high-intent moments.
  • Modernize the Mobile Tech & Conversion Stack: Support the building and delivery of a native, frictionless mobile subscription and checkout architecture to improve user experience and lift conversion rates.
  • Drive In-App Subscriptions & Retain Early Users: Increase In-App Mobile GSA conversion volume, repeat 30-day product usage, and long-term retention by removing complexity and providing clear guidance for new registrants.
  • Lead Strategy & Cross-Functional Alignment: Establish a clear product vision and 18-24 month roadmap for native mobile experiences. Align senior product leadership, engineering, design, marketing, analytics, and adjacent product teams (e.g., Engage, Preserve & Share, DNA Science) around shared outcomes and priorities.
  • Define & Monitor KPIs: Establish quantitative success metrics (In-Product Sign-ups, Repeat Usage, UX Score) and guardrail metrics to continuously evaluate and optimize native app performance.
  • Champion Customer Empathy & Continuous Testing: Leverage foundational user research, A/B testing, and behavioral data to solve core user pain points, eliminate cognitive friction for novice explorers, and advocate for the voice of the mobile customer.

Who You Are...

  • Experience & Scope:5+ years (or equivalent) of Product Management experience in consumer-facing (B2C) digital products, with proven experience building and shipping features for native mobile applications (iOS/Android).
  • Mobile Monetization Experience: Hands-on experience improving native mobile onboarding, paywall, or subscription flows to drive conversion.
  • Growth & Optimization Focus: Track record of optimizing conversion funnels, running experiments, and guiding users across multi-product portfolios or freemium/trial experiences.
  • Data-Driven Approach: Proficient with data analytics tools, defining feature-level KPIs, setting up A/B tests, and synthesizing quantitative data with qualitative research to inform roadmap prioritization.
  • Cross-Functional Collaboration: Demonstrated capability to collaborate effectively with engineering, design, and analytics partners, navigating technical dependencies and clearly communicating progress to product management leadership.
  • Technical Understanding: Good understanding of the native mobile development lifecycle, app store release processes, mobile UX patterns, and agile workflows.
  • Passion: Curiosity and passion for genomics, personal identity, storytelling, and family history.

Why Ancestry?

Join a dedicated team working to connect millions of people with their past and enrich their futures. At Ancestry, you will play a role in pioneering legal solutions that shape the consumer genomics industry. Your contributions will help foster and protect our workforce that is dedicated to helping our customers tell their own stories, while supporting a brand recognized and trusted around the world. We offer a collaborative workplace, competitive compensation, and the opportunity to make a meaningful difference.

Ancestry values pay transparency and equity. As a signatory of the ParityPledge in Support of Women and the ParityPledge in Support of People of Color, we are pleased to share the base salary range for this position: $140,000 - $157,000, with eligibility for bonus, equity, and comprehensive benefits including health, dental, and vision. raw.description:
Overview

The Patient Advocate II promotes favorable company relationships with patients, providers, and payers through prompt, accurate, and courteous resolution of telephone and written inquiries. All new hires must submit to and pass a pre-employment drug screen and background check.

At this time, US Anesthesia Partners does not hire candidates residing in California, Hawaii, or Alaska.

The base pay estimate for this role is $16.49 - 26.39 hourly. The final offer will depend on the skills, experience, and qualifications of the selected candidate. This range is for base pay only and does not include bonuses or other compensation. This position is eligible for a quarterly bonus. Bonuses are not guaranteed and are awarded based on company and individual performance.

Job Highlights

ESSENTIAL DUTIES AND RESPONSIBILITIES (include but not limited to):

  • Answers incoming patient, insurance company, physician office and facility telephone calls.
  • Receives and responds to all inquiries and complaints that may pertain to all phases of operations including billing, claims, claim denials, payments, and collection activities.
  • Records all customer contacts, including resolution or forwarding action taken to refer question to proper party.
  • Whenever possible, resolves question directly so that patient receives prompt satisfaction.
  • Responds promptly to all written inquiries or notifies patient if there will be a delay in obtaining a final resolution to the problem.
  • Explains account situation accurately in simple language so that patient can understand the explanation and how it applies to the particular question.
  • Works assigned tasks, edits, queues and correspondence as assignment in a timely manner.
  • Takes note of recurring questions or problems that may be resolved or alleviated by changes in policy or procedures.
  • Attends in-service training to improve skills and to keep abreast of changes in contracts and procedures.
  • Identifies and communicates complaint patterns to management team.
  • Maintains strictest confidentiality.
  • Documents all actions in the system notes.
  • Demonstrates a positive attitude and serve others with personal service 100% of the time.
  • Uses the phone in a responsible, courteous and professional manner; keeping personal phone calls to a minimum.
  • Meets customer satisfaction standards set forth by management
  • Meets productivity/performance standards as set forth by management.
  • Adheres to all company policies and procedures.
  • Performs other duties as assigned.

REPORTING TO THIS POSITION: No direct reports

Qualifications

JOB REQUIREMENTS (Knowledge, Skills and Abilities):

  • Bilingual Spanish preferred.
  • Excellent verbal and written English language skills to answer customer concerns in simple, common language.
  • Proficiency with math skills (i.e., skill in calculation of charges, payments and adjustments).
  • Knowledge of insurance processing, guidelines and general laws related to all payers.
  • Must be able to establish proficiency in using the IDX practice management system.
  • Excellent customer service skills.
  • Ability to multi-task effectively.
  • Data entry skills.
  • Basic knowledge of CPT, ICD-9 and ASA codes.
  • Sound problem solving skills & decision-making ability.
  • Strong analytical skills.
  • Skill in gathering and reporting information from multiple sources, (IDX, internet, electronic records).
  • Must have a pleasant disposition and high tolerance level.
  • Must display a positive “teamwork” attitude and strong interpersonal skills.
  • Ability to work effectively and independently.
  • Ability to maintain confidentiality.
  • Willingness and ability to follow direction and/or company policy as directed by management.

EDUCATION/TRAINING/EXPERIENCE:

  • Minimum 1 year of customer service or billing collections experience.
  • High-school graduate or equivalent required.
  • Associate degree in health or business administration or related field of study preferred.
  • Equivalent combination of education and experience will be considered. Prefer experience in a health care organization.

PHYSICAL REQUIREMENTS:

  • Requires prolonged sitting, some bending, stooping and stretching.
  • Must possess sufficient eye-hand coordination/manual dexterity to operate a keyboard, photocopier, telephone, calculator and other office equipment.
  • Required normal range of hearing and eyesight to record, prepare, and communicate appropriate reports and evaluations.
  • Requires lifting papers and boxes weighing up to 35 pounds occasionally.
  • Requires dexterity to type at least 50 wpm.

WORKING CONDITIONS (environment and safety):

  • Work performed in office environment.
  • Involves frequent contact with professional staff and managed care organizations.
  • Work may be stressful at times.
  • Interaction with others is frequent and often disruptive.

Description du poste

Alphanumeric recrute un Spécialiste bilingue du service client dans le secteur pharmaceutique (anglais/français) - CDI à temps plein (télétravail au Canada)pour travailler à distance et soutenir l’une des plus grandes sociétés pharmaceutiques au monde. Vous fournirez du soutien relativement à des produits liés au diabète, à l’obésité, aux maladies rares ainsi qu’à la santé cardiovasculaire et hépatique.

Il s’agit d’un centre de contact à volume élevé, et les candidats sont sélectionnés pour offrir une expérience de service à la clientèle optimisée et personnalisée. Ce poste joue un rôle essentiel dans le soutien aux patients, aux professionnels de la santé et aux parties prenantes internes, en fournissant des réponses exactes, rapides et empathiques, tout en respectant les normes les plus élevées en matière de qualité, de conformité et d’éthique.

La personne retenue répondra aux questions fréquemment posées et fournira des renseignements généraux conformes à l’indication approuvée. Elle devra également reconnaître les demandes d’information médicale et les acheminer au service approprié. Le poste exige également de savoir reconnaître les événements indésirables (EI) potentiels et les plaintes potentielles relatives à la qualité des produits (PQP), aux fins de documentation et de signalement.

Veuillez noter que nous ne pouvons embaucher que des personnes résidant déjà au Canada et disposant de documents entièrement légaux et valides les autorisant à y travailler.

Veuillez soumettre votre CV en anglais, puisque les gestionnaires responsables de l’embauche ne sont pas établis au Québec. En plus du français, la personne titulaire du poste doit maîtriser l’anglais à l’oral et à l’écrit, car elle communiquera avec des parties prenantes, des gestionnaires et des clients situés à l’extérieur du Québec, dans un environnement qui exige l’usage de l’anglais. Une préférence sera accordée aux personnes résidant dans le fuseau horaire de l’Est ou dans un fuseau similaire.

Conditions/offre:

  • Emploi: poste permanent à temps plein
  • Mode de travail: entièrement à distance au Canada, de préférence dans le fuseau horaire de l’Est ou un fuseau voisin.
  • Salaire : 50 000 $CA brut par année
  • Heures de travail: 40h par semaine
  • Quarts de travail: du lundi au vendredi, entre 9:00 et 20:00 dans le fuseau horaire de l’Est — quarts de 8 h comprenant une pause-repas d’une heure
  • Avantages sociaux : assurance maladie, soins dentaires et assurance vie après la période d’essai
  • Formation: 3 semaines de formation + 1 semaine de certification, soit 4 semaines
  • Horaires de formation: du lundi au vendredi 8:00-17:00 EST
  • Vacances: 2 semaines de vacances payées
  • Équipement: entièrement fourni par l’entreprise; aucun achat d’équipement n’est requis.
  • Il est obligatoire de résider au Canada et de disposer de documents entièrement légaux et valides (permis de travail, résidence permanente et NAS). Veuillez noter que nous n’offrons pas de parrainage.

Exigences:

  • Excellente maîtrise de l’anglais et du français (il est obligatoire de parler couramment les deux langues)
  • Une préférence sera accordée aux personnes possédant au moins 2 ans d’expérience dans le soutien de centres d’appels pharmaceutiques ou biotechnologiques, ou dans un environnement médical ou commercial
  • Une expérience préalable avec des produits pharmaceutiques dans un centre d’appels pharmaceutique ou biotechnologique est souhaitée
  • Une expérience préalable avec Salesforce et Vonage est souhaitée
  • Une expérience antérieure en centre de contact constitue un atout
  • Passion pour le service à la clientèle, excellentes aptitudes relationnelles au téléphone et volonté d’exceller
  • Capacité à s’épanouir dans un environnement innovant et au rythme soutenu, tout en faisant preuve de souplesse, d’initiative, d’ingéniosité et d’efficacité

Qualités clés et responsabilités:

  • Répondre aux appels entrants généraux, aux clavardages et aux courriels des patients, des professionnels de la santé et des parties prenantes internes, de manière professionnelle et empathique
  • Répondre aux demandes générales des consommateurs et/ou des professionnels de la santé
  • Naviguer sur les sites et aider les utilisateurs à y naviguer
  • Utiliser différents sites et contenus afin que le consommateur ou le professionnel de la santé reçoive un service à la clientèle rapide, complet et professionnel
  • Traiter les demandes et les mises à jour concernant les excursions de température (p. ex., origine de l’excursion de température)
  • Reconnaître et signaler les événements indésirables (EI) potentiels et les plaintes relatives à la qualité des produits (PQP)
  • Consigner les notes de dossier dans le système de gestion de la relation client (CRM)
  • Soutenir le contrat, agir comme agent de liaison et représenter le client
  • Possibilité de quarts rotatifs et de soutien en dehors des heures normales

Compétences et aptitudes requises:

  • Excellentes aptitudes interpersonnelles et capacité à établir et à maintenir des relations importantes avec les principales parties prenantes, par téléphone, clavardage ou courriel.
  • Excellente capacité d’écoute et empathie manifeste envers la personne aidée.
  • Capacité démontrée à communiquer et à distinguer différents types de questions liées aux demandes commerciales
  • Volonté d’apprendre à reconnaître les événements indésirables ou les plaintes relatives aux produits, ainsi qu’à les documenter et à les signaler
  • Capacité à traiter tous les canaux de travail : appels, clavardages et courriels
  • Capacité démontrée à résoudre des problèmes
  • Esprit d’équipe, approche axée sur le service à la clientèle et orientation vers les solutions
  • Capacité à apprendre rapidement à utiliser de nouveaux systèmes et de nouvelles technologies

Compétences techniques:

  • Systèmes d’exploitation : Windows, jusqu’à la version actuelle
  • Outils Microsoft Office
  • Environnement matériel informatique : ordinateurs portables, ordinateurs de bureau et imprimantes
  • Outils de téléphonie, de courriel et de clavardage pour centre de contact — souhaité
  • Connaissance d’un système de gestion de la relation client — souhaitée

Autres exigences:

  • Capacité à rester assis pendant de longues périodes
  • Connaissances informatiques et matérielles de base permettant d’installer un poste de travail à distance
  • Connexion Internet filaire offrant une vitesse minimale de 15 Mbit/s en téléversement et de 15 Mbit/s en téléchargement
  • Disposer d’un espace de bureau privé et calme, sans interruptions, afin de mener des appels professionnels au nom d’un client.
Salary: $50,000 / year

Account Manager - Logistics SaaS | Accelerate European Supply Chain Transformation

Are you ready to accelerate the future of digital supply chains across Europe? Join Transporeon, a Trimble Company, where you will empower leading enterprise clients to optimize their freight operations using industry-leading cloud solutions. In this high-impact role, you will champion meaningful transformation, expand strategic partnerships, and deliver innovative SaaS technology that connects logistics networks worldwide.


About Us:

Trimble is an industrial technology company transforming the way the world works by delivering solutions that enable our customers to thrive. We create technologies that connect the digital and physical worlds, helping our customers increase productivity, quality, safety, and sustainability.

Transport & Logistics Business Unit: In the Transportation & Logistics segment, our solutions make it safer, simpler and more efficient to move freight - bringing together a global network of shippers, carriers, brokers and 3PLs.


What Makes This Role Great:

In this role, you will be the trusted strategic advisor to European market leaders, driving digital transformation across complex logistics operations. You will directly influence how global enterprises collaborate and optimize freight movements by deploying cutting-edge SaaS platform, combining strategic account growth with high-visibility stakeholder collaboration across IT, procurement, and executive leadership.


Key Exciting Responsibilities

  • Drive revenue growth and account expansion by identifying and executing high-value cross-selling, upselling, and renewal opportunities across a premier portfolio of European enterprise clients.
  • Cultivate consultative partnerships with key decision-makers across logistics, procurement, IT, and senior management to align Transporeon solutions with customer business goals.
  • Lead strategic account planning and pipeline management within CRM to proactively forecast, track, and achieve ambitious growth targets.
  • Champion customer needs by collaborating cross-functionally to deliver tailored, cloud-based SaaS solutions that solve complex supply chain challenges.

Essential Skills & Experience

  • 4+ years of successful experience selling logistics software, supply chain technology, or complex B2B SaaS solutions.
  • Proven track record of consistently exceeding sales quotas and delivering exceptional customer satisfaction.
  • Demonstrated ability to balance strategic account retention and proactive expansion across diverse industry accounts.
  • Native/Near native German and proficient English language skills (at least C1) are essential for navigating local and global stakeholders.

Bonus Points For

  • In-depth familiarity with transportation management systems (TMS), real-time visibility platforms, or freight procurement platforms.
  • Experience utilizing enterprise CRM tools (such as Salesforce) and modern sales acceleration methodologies.
  • An established professional network within European logistics, manufacturing, or retail supply chains.

Logistics

Location: Germany remote, Austria remote

Travel Requirement: 20%


Why You'll Love Working With Us


At Trimble, we're not just a company that "does good" -we are a team dedicated to making a tangible, positive Real-World Impact. raw.excerpt: About OkendoWe believe happy customers make the best marketers.
raw.description:
About Okendo

We believe happy customers make the best marketers.

That’s why we built Okendo – the customer marketing platform that creates stronger connections between consumers and the brands they love.

Using Okendo, Shopify brands can grow faster and more efficiently by cultivating brand advocacy and maximising lifetime value.

Our unified platform and unique suite of products for Reviews, Referrals, Quizzes, Loyalty, and Surveys is trusted by 19,000+ Shopify brands to turn one time shoppers into revenue-driving Superfans.

Position Summary

As an Enterprise Onboarding Manager, you will set Okendo's most strategic brands up for long-term success. You will own each launch from the moment the deal closes to the handoff to Customer Success: turning the brand's goals into a clear launch plan, guiding them through setup, integrations, and go-live, and making sure they see value quickly.

This is an individual contributor role. You will pick up the momentum Sales has built, and you will work hand in hand with Solutions Engineering, Support, Customer Success, and Account Executives. The first impression you create sets the tone for the whole relationship.

How you'll create impact:

Own the enterprise launch from kickoff to go-live

  • Be the dedicated lead for each new enterprise brand, from sales handoff to go-live, keeping the plan, timeline, and expectations clear
  • Turn each brand's goals into a launch plan across Reviews, Loyalty, Referrals, Quizzes, and Surveys, tailored to their business, tech stack, and retail calendar
  • Run several complex launches at once, clearing blockers early so brands go live on time and on brand

Design programs that deliver value fast

  • Advise each brand on how to set up their programs, and guide them through data migration, theme customization, and integrations with their tech stack, including Shopify, Klaviyo, TikTok Shop, Google, Meta, and Attentive
  • Work with Solutions Engineering on custom builds and APIs, writing clear requirements so the work lands right
  • Train brand teams to run their programs with confidence, and make sure every brand reaches first value by the go-live date

Partner across the business

  • Work with Sales before close on scope and timelines, and join late-stage calls where trust in our onboarding matters
  • Hand off each brand to Customer Success with a clear summary of goals, stakeholders, and next steps, and flag growth opportunities across the suite
  • Give Product feedback on gaps you see during enterprise launches, and partner with Marketing on customer stories

Keep raising the bar on how we onboard

  • Build templates, checklists, and playbooks for enterprise launches, so what works for you becomes how the team works
  • Become a deep expert on the Okendo platform and the ecommerce tools brands use alongside it, and share what you learn with the team

What we need from you:

  • 5+ years in customer onboarding, implementation, or project management at a B2B SaaS company, ideally with ecommerce brands or marketing and retention tools
  • A track record of leading complex, multi-stakeholder launches for larger customers, on time and to a high standard
  • Strong project management and organisation: you can plan, track, and prioritise many moving parts across many launches at once
  • Technical comfort: the words CSV, HTML, and APIs do not scare you, they excite you
  • Knowledge of ecommerce tech stacks and metrics, such as conversion, AOV, and repeat rate
  • Confidence working with senior marketing and ecommerce stakeholders, and the assertiveness to drive action plans to completion
  • Excellent written and verbal communication, and a resourceful, positive, resilient approach when launches get complicated
  • Bonus: familiarity with Shopify (especially Shopify Plus), Klaviyo, Google Shopping, and headless or custom storefront setups

1-Month Success Markers

  • You've completed onboarding, earned your Okendo Product Expert certification, and can confidently demo all five Okendo products
  • You've shadowed enterprise launches from kickoff to go-live and are running your first launches with support
  • You understand the ecommerce industry and the brands we work with well enough to hold a credible conversation

6-Month Success Markers

  • You've led multiple enterprise launches from kickoff to go-live, on time and to a high standard
  • Every launch has a clear plan, named stakeholders, a go-live date, and a clean handoff to Customer Success
  • You've built strong working relationships with Solutions Engineering, Account Executives, and Customer Success, and contributed templates the team is using

1-Year Success Markers

  • You consistently launch enterprise brands on time, and those brands describe the experience as smooth and well run
  • The brands you launched are healthy, growing accounts, with clear growth plans handed to Customer Success
  • You're the go-to resource inside Okendo for complex enterprise launches, and your playbooks are part of how the team works

Job title: Principle Regulatory Affairs Specialist – DACH

Department: Regulatory Affairs

Location: This role can be based remotely in Germany, with occasional travel to our Darmstadt office

Working hours: Full time

A brighter future awaits you

CooperVision is one of the world’s leading manufacturers of soft contact lenses with a presence in over 100 countries. Being part of CooperVision means helping improve the way people see each day. It’s more than making contact lenses, it’s about giving lens wearers freedom and confidence to move about their daily lives. We’re all about bright futures – for our people and those who wear our contact lenses.

Job summary – What to expect:

The Principal Regulatory Affairs Specialist will provide expert level regulatory support and direction across our D-A-CH cluster ( including some Eastern Europe locations), for products from concept to launch, and beyond into post market, as well as regulatory processes. This role is responsible for delivering high‑quality regulatory partnership and ensuring market access across a the cluster. Operating as a strategic regulatory partner to Cluster Leadership Teams, the Principal Regulatory Affairs Specialist drives regulatory strategies that enable business growth and safeguard CooperVision’s license to operate. This role is accountable for developing and executing regulatory strategies, driving high‑quality regional submissions, ensuring compliance with EU MDR and regional regulations, and maintaining accurate, audit‑ready regulatory documentation.

Responsibilities include:

1. Regulatory Strategy & Leadership

  • Develop and execute regulatory strategies for assigned cluster markets aligned to commercial priorities and lifecycle needs.
  • Serve as the primary regulatory partner to Cluster Leadership Teams, providing expert, actionable guidance.
  • Lead creation and improvement of regional regulatory processes, SOPs and best practices.
  • Represent RA in cross‑functional meetings, providing clear regulatory direction and risk‑based decision‑making.

2. Cluster Partnership & Commercial Collaboration

  • Participate in Cluster Leadership Team activities, influencing commercial planning, forecasting, and launch decisions.
  • Provide regulatory impact assessments for cluster business strategies, promotions, NPLCOs and private label initiatives.
  • Partner with Global Packaging/Labelling to ensure compliant labelling aligned to market needs.

3. Registration & Market Access

  • Prepare, review and approve regulatory submissions for assigned EMEA markets, covering new registrations, renewals, amendments, and notifications.
  • Maintain accurate, complete, and audit‑ready submission documentation and databases
  • Support interactions with Competent Authorities, Notified Bodies and regulatory agencies.

4. Monitoring & Intelligence

  • Monitor regional and national regulatory changes and assess business impact.
  • Communicate relevant regulatory intelligence to cluster and regional leadership promptly.
  • Establish and maintain productive relationships with government, industry groups and regulatory bodies.

5. Labelling, Advertising & Product Compliance

  • Review and approve product labelling and cluster‑specific artwork.
  • Provide RA input into Regulatory Affairs Impact Documents (RAIDs).
  • Ensure adherence to MDR, market‑specific requirements, and CooperVision policies.
  • Support Own Brand/Private Label customers and associated regulatory obligations.

6. Technical Documentation & Audit Activities

  • Review and assess technical documentation for compliance with MDR and other applicable regulations.
  • Contribute to technical audits and inspection readiness within assigned markets.
  • Support responses to Notified Body queries, audit findings, and corrective actions.

7. Cross‑Functional & Regional Contribution

  • Mentor and guide junior specialists working on cluster‑related submissions or activities.
  • Contribute to continuous improvement initiatives across EMEA RA.

A full job description is available upon request.

About you:

Skills & Abilities

  • Understanding of ISO 13485, MDR, and regional EMEA regulations.
  • Ability to analyse technical information and develop robust regulatory strategies.
  • Excellent organisation, prioritisation, and communication skills.
  • Ability to partner effectively across commercial and technical functions.
  • Skilled in regulatory submissions, technical documentation, and labelling review.
  • Comfortable operating in multicultural and matrixed environments.
  • Skilled at influencing stakeholders and leading without authority.

Experience & Education:

Required:

  • 6–10 years regulatory experience within the medical device industry.
  • Demonstrated experience preparing and submitting regulatory filings in EMEA.
  • Experience supporting audits and technical documentation reviews.
  • Track record of high‑quality stakeholder partnership, ideally with commercial teams.

  • Experience in electronic document management systems.

Preferred:

  • Advanced degree and/or Regulatory Affairs Certification desirable.

What we offer:

You’ll receive competitive compensation and a fantastic benefits package and access to our Wellness Platform to support you in mental health and wellbeing, a discounted contact lens scheme and much more!

We are committed to our employees’ personal and professional development and offer extensive training to support your career growth and help every individual to reach their full potential. To help us achieve our goals, we’ll give you everything you need to help you achieve yours.

We also provide access to LinkedIn Learning to help you develop in your career and grow with CooperVision.

What you can expect:

As a CooperVision employee, you’ll be welcomed into a diverse and progressive global business. We appreciate how important fostering an inclusive culture is and how different perspectives add value and contribute to our success.

If you like what you see, take the first step towards your Brighter Future and apply today! All suitably qualified applicants will receive equal consideration and opportunities from CooperVision.

Please view our careers page at to view all other opportunities.

raw.description:
Position Summary

The evolv Consulting team is seeking an accomplished FS&I Leader (Managing Director) to own and grow our Financial Services & Insurance vertical. This is a senior commercial leadership role with full accountability for the vertical’s strategy, revenue, P&L, and client portfolio.

The FS&I Leader expands relationships with existing clients, partners with Business Development to bring on new clients, and leads a team of Client Partners aligned to FS&I accounts. The ideal candidate is a seasoned consulting executive with deep financial services and insurance expertise, a record of profitable growth, and the executive presence to advise clients at the C-suite level.

This is a hands-on, execution-focused leadership role that requires a leader who is willing to get into the details and take an active role in building and growing the business. We are seeking someone who can operate at both strategic and tactical levels, drive business development, establish scalable processes, and remove obstacles to accelerate growth. Success requires a leader who takes full ownership, leads from the front, and executes with urgency, accountability, and a relentless focus on aggressively driving revenue growth and establishing FS&I as evolv’s flagship vertical.

Key Responsibilities

Vertical Ownership & Growth

  • Set and execute the FS&I vertical strategy across banking, insurance, capital markets, and fintech, in alignment with firm leadership.
  • Expand existing client relationships by identifying new needs, increasing account penetration, and pursuing add-on work within active engagements.
  • Partner with Business Development to target, pursue, and onboard new FS&I clients.
  • Define the vertical’s service offerings and industry point of view, drawing on evolv’s data, AI, and cloud capabilities.
  • Represent evolv at industry events, executive forums, and through published thought leadership to build brand visibility and pipeline.

P&L Accountability

  • Own the full P&L for the FS&I vertical, including revenue, gross margin, and contribution targets.
  • Build the annual plan and forecast in partnership with Finance, and report performance to executive leadership.
  • Drive pricing, rate, and staffing decisions that balance growth with profitability.
  • Monitor account-level financial health and act early on margin, utilization, or delivery risk.

Sales Leadership

  • Own the FS&I pipeline and annual bookings targets, from opportunity identification through proposal, negotiation, and close.
  • Lead executive-level pursuits and coach Client Partners on deal strategy and account growth.
  • Shape proposals and solutions with delivery and practice leaders to win complex, multi-year engagements.
  • Maintain disciplined pipeline management and accurate forecasting.

Client Partner Leadership

Client Partners report directly to the FS&I Leader. Each is aligned to one or more FS&I clients and is accountable for revenue and margin, the client relationship, and high-level oversight of client delivery.

  • Recruit, develop, and retain a high-performing team of Client Partners.
  • Set clear revenue, margin, and client-satisfaction goals for each Client Partner and hold the team accountable.
  • Serve as executive sponsor on key accounts and step in on escalations.
  • Run a consistent operating cadence across the portfolio, including account, pipeline, and financial reviews.
  • Partner with delivery leadership to ensure quality, measurable client outcomes, and the right talent on every engagement.

*Other duties as assigned.

The Ideal Candidate

We are looking for a revenue-driven leader who is passionate about building the FS&I vertical and holds a high bar for performance. The ideal candidate is:

  • Revenue-driven:Motivated by growth, with a clear commitment to meeting and exceeding the vertical’s revenue goals.
  • Strategic and hands-on:Equally comfortable setting long-term direction and rolling up their sleeves to close deals and solve problems.
  • Focused and adaptable:Able to prioritize effectively and balance vertical ownership, P&L, sales, and team leadership at the same time.
  • A hunter and a coach:Leads new business development alongside Business Development, while coaching Client Partners on how to show up at client sites and grow existing accounts.
  • A decisive leader:Sets clear direction, communicates expectations, and holds the team accountable for results.

Qualifications

Required

  • 12+ years of consulting experience serving financial services clients, including meaningful time in a strategic leadership role.
  • Deep domain expertise in financial services and insurance, with the credibility to advise C-suite stakeholders.
  • Proven P&L ownership of a practice, vertical, or business unit, with a record of growing revenue while protecting margin.
  • Track record of originating and closing complex, multi-year engagements and expanding existing client accounts.
  • Experience leading senior client-facing leaders (Client Partners, Account Leads, or equivalent), including hiring, coaching, and performance management.
  • Experience with data, AI, or cloud strategy in a financial services context.
  • Executive presence and exceptional communication skills, with the ability to influence internally and externally.
  • Thrives operating in a fast-paced, matrixed, entrepreneurial environment.

Preferred

  • Based in, or willing to relocate to, the Dallas–Fort Worth area.
  • Established executive network within the FS&I market.
  • Background at a top-tier consulting firm (Big 4, MBB, or equivalent) and/or operator-side experience at a major financial institution or insurer.
  • Experience growing a vertical within a mid-market consulting firm.

With endless opportunities at every turn, and a company culture built to empower and develop our people to be the best they can be, Multiview is THE Software Company for you to learn, grow, create, connect, and lead. We do this by taking care of our employees first.

We strongly believe that a great job should keep you happy both at work and in life and we encourage that by offering:

raw.title: Senior AI Engineer
raw.excerpt: Grip is changing how global brands produce content - from manual, tool-driven workflows to intelligent systems that generate high-quality visual output at scale.
raw.description:
Grip is changing how global brands produce content - from manual, tool-driven workflows to intelligent systems that generate high-quality visual output at scale.

As a Senior AI Engineer, you build the intelligence behind that shift: LLM agents that understand what a brand looks like, retrieval systems that ground every generation in real brand knowledge, and automated pipelines that turn messy client material into structure machines can work with.

The hard problem in generative AI is no longer generation. It's control, consistency, and trust — making unpredictable models behave reliably for brands that care deeply about how they show up in the world. That's the problem you'll own.

What You'll Work On

  • LLM agents - designing focused, reliable agents that translate brand intent into precise creative direction

  • Prompt engineering & orchestration - crafting, testing, and versioning the prompts that steer agents and generation, and building the system that assembles them - prompting as an engineering discipline, not trial and error

  • Retrieval & RAG - grounding generation in each brand's rules, assets, and visual language, with strict isolation between clients

  • Evaluation & experimentation - systematic measurement (RAGAS or similar), A/B testing, and regression gates, so quality is proven rather than assumed

  • Data extraction & OCR - pipelines that pull structure out of documents, decks, scans, and imagery; OCR and vision models for reading, understanding, and tagging whatever a client hands us

  • Automation - end-to-end pipelines that run without babysitting: classify, extract, propose, verify - humans review outcomes instead of doing the work by hand

  • Model training - fine-tuning LLMs and neural networks where prompting hits its ceiling, running models locally or hosted depending on what the job needs

  • Client-facing impact - your pipelines run against real client data and real production volume, and the results are visible in everything that ships

Requirements

Who You Are

You build systems that make AI predictable, controllable, and production-ready — especially in visual domains.

You Have:

  • Strong experience with LLM-based systems in production (agents, RAG, orchestration)

  • Hands-on work with evaluation frameworks and structured experimentation — quality you can prove, not claim

  • Solid programming skills across TypeScript and Python, with experience shipping working systems

  • Experience training or fine-tuning models and managing their lifecycle

  • Exposure to generative image pipelines and what it takes to make their output usable (not theoretical interest — actual contact)

You Think:

  • In systems, not prompts — how components interact, fail, and scale

  • In constraints — how to guide models toward predictable outputs

  • In data — extraction, classification, and structure as the foundation everything else stands on

  • Pragmatically — you ship working solutions and refine based on results

Your Skills Are:

  • Translating abstract creative direction into structured AI workflows

  • Turning messy, unstructured material into clean, reliable data pipelines

  • Debugging LLM and retrieval behavior across multiple layers of a pipeline

  • Communicating across engineering and creative teams

Why Join Grip?

The Platform Position.
Grip is infrastructure for enterprise creative production—powering global brands to generate content at scale with control and consistency.

The Market Timing.
AI-generated content is moving from experimentation to production. The challenge is no longer generation—it’s control, reliability, and scale.

The Technical Moat.
You’ll work with ComfyUI-based workflows, multi-tenant architecture, and a stack spanning TypeScript, Python, Elixir, and C#—built for production, not demos.

The Work.
You will define how AI is actually used in real-world creative systems—turning unpredictable models into dependable pipelines.

The procedure

If you’re ready to bring your powers to a role where you can make a difference, we want to hear from you. Send your resume and portfolio in English via the link provided. If you have questions, contact our Recruitment Department at .

INDG Grip handles and uses personal data of job applicants in line with its Recruitment Privacy Policy.

raw.title: Enablement Consultant
raw.excerpt: Who we areSamsara (NYSE: IOT) is the pioneer of the Connected Operations™ Cloud, which is a platform that enables organizations that depend on physical operations to harness Internet of Things (IoT) data to develop actionable insights and improve their operations.
raw.description:
Who we are

Samsara (NYSE: IOT) is the pioneer of the Connected Operations™ Cloud, which is a platform that enables organizations that depend on physical operations to harness Internet of Things (IoT) data to develop actionable insights and improve their operations. At Samsara, we are helping improve the safety, efficiency and sustainability of the physical operations that power our global economy. Representing more than 40% of global GDP, these industries are the infrastructure of our planet, including agriculture, construction, field services, transportation, and manufacturing — and we are excited to help digitally transform their operations at scale.

Working at Samsara means you’ll help define the future of physical operations and be on a team that’s shaping an exciting array of product solutions, including Video-Based Safety, Vehicle Telematics, Apps and Driver Workflows, and Equipment Monitoring. As part of a recently public company, you’ll have the autonomy and support to make an impact as we build for the long term.

About the role:

Your role will be cross-functional in nature, working alongside and connecting Sales, Support, Sales Engineering and Product, enabling you to experience multiple aspects of a fast growing company from within.
This role requires exceptional customer-facing communication skills, the ability to quickly understand a customer's business, and comfort explaining technology products to both executives and day-to-day users. In addition to this, you will champion, role model, and embed Samsara’s cultural principles (Focus on Customer Success, Build for the Long Term, Adopt a growth mindset, be inclusive and win as a team) as we scale globally and across new offices.

This is a remote position open to candidates residing in Mexico.

You should apply if:

  • You want to impact the industries that run our world: Every phone call you answer and every email you send can affect whether truck drivers deliver goods on time and without accidents, whether students get dropped off safely from school, or whether power gets restored quickly after a natural disaster.
  • You thrive the most when solving problems: Our constantly expanding technology and the complexities faced by our customers provide an exciting range of challenges for our Customer Success teams. With a growth mindset and a desire to learn, you will strategically partner with our customers to find unique solutions to help keep their operations safe, efficient, and sustainable.
  • You are a natural relationship builder: Whether the relationship is with our customers or with cross-functional teams in Samsara, you are in constant communication and collaboration with key stakeholders to win as a team.
  • You are the architect of your own career: If you put in the work, this role won’t be your last at Samsara. This Customer Success team is still shaping its future and you will have plenty of autonomy and opportunities to master your craft in a hyper growth environment.
  • You want to be with the best: At Samsara, we win together, celebrate together and support each other. You will be surrounded by the best and brightest professionals out there.

In this role, you will:

  • Be on the front-lines and ensure our customers increase the safety, efficiency, and sustainability of their operations with our IoT platform
  • Manage the deployment of Samsara technology to customers, enabling customers to achieve quick time to value in their investment
  • Create launch plans and a roadmap to increase product usage
  • Track implementation progress, participation, product adoption, and account health
  • Run training sessions, demonstrate Samsara’s technology, and work through challenges with customers and day-to-day users of the system across numerous use cases
  • Juggle multiple customer engagements in parallel and work cross-functionally to deliver an exceptional experience for our customers
  • Deeply understand the Samsara platform’s capabilities and explain them to customers of all types
  • Champion, role model, and embed Samsara’s cultural principles (Focus on Customer Success, Build for the Long Term, Adopt a Growth Mindset, Be Inclusive, Win as a Team) as we scale globally and across new offices

Minimum requirements for the role:

  • 2+ years of experience in a senior Customer Success, account management, or consulting role. SaaS experience preferred
  • Bilingual (Spanish and English) is required
  • Strong spoken and written language skills for working with multiple teams and publishing documentation
  • This is a demanding position with high internal visibility, that requires strong priority management and high emotional intelligence
  • Experience supporting or working with technical products
  • Diplomacy, tact, and poise under pressure when working through customer issues
  • Bachelor’s degree from a 4-year institution
  • Candidate must be based in Monterrey, N.L., or willing to relocate

An ideal candidate also has:

  • Strong bias for action, the ability to think big, with insistence on high standards
  • Experience facilitating workshops with senior stakeholders and operational teams.
  • Strong executive presence and ability to influence cross-functional leaders.
  • Excellent communication, facilitation, and stakeholder management skills.
  • Proven track record of building trust and communicating effectively with a wide variety of stakeholders: Executives, Day-to-day users of our software
  • Experience serving a large and complex customer base in B2B SaaS
  • Thrives in an unstructured, fast-paced, and change-heavy environment
  • Experience working with different countries of the LATAM regions preferred, but not required
  • Experience working in Tech Touch Engagements
  • Experience using Customer Success Platforms

Total Rewards

At Samsara, we build for the people who keep the global economy moving. We want owners, not passengers, which is why our rewards are designed to fuel high-impact builders. Our compensation program delivers above-market total compensation through a combination of base salary, performance-based bonus/variable pay, and equity (for eligible roles) in a high-growth public company. We meaningfully differentiate pay for our top performers, who have the opportunity to earn above-market compensation that can outpace the broader market over time.

Beyond compensation, we provide the foundations that enable long-term success: a flexible, employee-led remote model, a professional development stipend, comprehensive health and parental leave plans, and more. If you’re ready to build for the long term and own the outcome, your journey starts here.

Flexible Working

At Samsara, we embrace a flexible working model that caters to the diverse needs of our teams. Our offices are open for those who prefer to work in-person and we also support remote work where it aligns with our operational requirements. For certain positions, being close to one of our offices or within a specific geographic area is important to facilitate collaboration, access to resources, or alignment with our service regions. In these cases, the job description will clearly indicate any working location requirements. Our goal is to ensure that all members of our team can contribute effectively, whether they are working on-site, in a hybrid model, or fully remotely. All offers of employment are contingent upon an individual’s ability to secure and maintain the legal right to work at the company and in the specified work location, if applicable.

Belonging at Samsara

At Samsara, we welcome everyone regardless of their background. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, national origin, sex, gender, gender identity, sexual orientation, protected veteran status, disability, age, and other characteristics protected by law. We depend on the unique approaches of our team members to help us solve complex problems and want to ensure that Samsara is a place where people from all backgrounds can make an impact.

Accommodations

Samsara is an inclusive work environment, and we are committed to ensuring equal opportunity in employment for qualified persons with disabilities. Please email or click here if you require any reasonable accommodations throughout the recruiting process.

Our Commitment to Authenticity

We use Tofu, a fraud detection tool, to validate the authenticity of applications and protect against identity fraud. This ensures we are connecting with real people and allows us to prioritize genuine candidates. Please see Samsara’s Candidate Privacy Notice for more information.

Fraudulent Employment Offers

Samsara is aware of scams involving fake job interviews and offers. Please know we do not charge fees to applicants at any stage of the hiring process. Official communication about your application will only come from emails ending in @samsara.com, @us-greenhouse-mail.io or @mail3.guide.co. For more information regarding fraudulent employment offers, please visit our blog post here.

Any communication not provided directly through an @barrenabranding.com email address is not affiliated with us. Careersbarrenabranding.com is NOT affiliated with Barrena Branding & Marketing, and communications from anyone identifying themselves as “Brian Dansie,” “Richard Glover,” or “Jackson Webb” are not authorized by our company. If you receive one of these communications, please do not provide personal, financial, or identification information.

About Barrena Branding & Marketing

Barrena Branding & Marketing is a full-service marketing and branding agency focused on helping companies build world-class brands and scalable marketing strategies. We provide strategic guidance and execution support across brand, content, and demand generation, often acting as an extension of our clients’ teams.

Our work spans brand strategy and positioning, website design and development, content creation, email marketing, paid media, SEO, and lead generation. We primarily partner with B2B companies in industries like technology and healthcare, while also supporting select consumer brands.

At Barrena, we believe great brands are built by passionate, creative, and driven people. We value strong communication, attention to detail, and a collaborative approach, and we’re always excited to connect with individuals who are eager to make an impact.

About the Role

We’re looking for an experienced B2B Copywriter & Messaging Strategist to develop strategic messaging and high-quality copy for our clients, with a strong focus on B2B technology companies and website projects.

This role combines copywriting with strategic positioning and messaging. You will be responsible for understanding complex businesses, products, and audiences and translating them into clear, compelling messaging that differentiates the brand and drives action.

A significant portion of this role will involve writing copy for B2B websites, including companies in technology, SaaS, cybersecurity, AI, healthcare, and other complex industries.

This is not just a content writing role. You should be comfortable developing the strategy behind the messaging, not simply writing from an existing brief or messaging framework.

What You’ll Do

  • Write website copy for B2B companies, including homepages, product and service pages, industry pages, solution pages, landing pages, and other website content
  • Develop brand positioning and strategic messaging frameworks
  • Create value propositions, messaging pillars, differentiators, key messages, and audience-specific messaging
  • Translate complex technical products and services into clear, compelling, benefit-driven copy
  • Participate in client discovery and stakeholder interviews to understand the business, audience, competitive landscape, and objectives
  • Conduct competitive and messaging research to identify opportunities for differentiation
  • Develop messaging for different buyer personas and stages of the buying journey
  • Write headlines, calls to action, and conversion-focused website copy
  • Collaborate with strategists, designers, developers, SEO specialists, and other members of our team
  • Incorporate SEO strategy and target keywords naturally into website copy when appropriate
  • Edit and strengthen existing copy for clarity, consistency, differentiation, and brand voice
  • Ensure all copy is polished, accurate, on-brand, and ready for client delivery

Who We’re Looking For

B2B Copywriting Experience

  • 5+ years of professional copywriting, content, or messaging experience
  • Demonstrated experience writing website copy for B2B companies
  • Strong preference for experience with technology, SaaS, cybersecurity, AI, healthcare, professional services, or other complex industries
  • Ability to translate sophisticated or technical subject matter into clear, engaging copy
  • Strong understanding of how B2B messaging differs from consumer-focused copy

Website Copywriting Experience

  • Demonstrated experience writing complete, multi-page B2B websites
  • Strong understanding of website hierarchy, user journeys, calls to action, and conversion
  • Ability to develop consistent messaging across an entire website
  • Experience collaborating with designers, strategists, SEO specialists, and developers

Positioning & Messaging Experience

  • Hands-on experience developing brand positioning and strategic messaging
  • Experience developing value propositions, messaging pillars, differentiators, audience messaging, and brand narratives
  • Ability to identify what meaningfully differentiates a company from its competitors
  • Comfortable conducting client discovery and turning research into a clear messaging framework

Strategic & Creative Thinker

You don't simply take a brief and start writing. You ask questions, understand the audience and business objectives, identify messaging gaps, and think strategically about what the company needs to communicate and why.

Strong Editorial Judgment

You have an exceptional command of grammar, structure, tone, and storytelling and can recognize when messaging is generic, overly technical, or unclear.

Client-Facing Communication

You are comfortable participating in client discovery calls, asking thoughtful questions, presenting messaging recommendations, and incorporating feedback.

Collaborative & Detail-Oriented

You work effectively with remote teams, communicate proactively, manage deadlines, and consistently deliver polished work that is ready for client review.

AI-Aware, Human-Led

You understand how to use AI tools appropriately for research, ideation, and efficiency while maintaining original thinking, strategic judgment, and high-quality human-written copy.

Compensation

  • Hourly or project-based compensation, depending on experience and scope
  • We are committed to fair compensation based on your skill level and the value you bring
  • This is a contractor role with the potential to evolve into a longer-term or full-time opportunity based on performance and business needs

How to Apply

Please submit:

  • Your resume
  • A brief note about your experience writing for B2B companies
  • Examples of B2B website copy you have written, preferably for technology companies
  • At least one example of a complete or multi-page website where you were responsible for the copy
  • Examples of positioning, messaging frameworks, value propositions, or strategic messaging work you have developed
  • A brief explanation of your role in the examples provided, including whether you developed the underlying messaging strategy or worked from an existing framework

If you’re looking for a special place to build or grow your career, you’ve found it. Whether you’re an experienced professional, a recent college graduate or somewhere in between, IDEX is a place where you can apply your existing skills and learn new ones in an environment where you can make an impact.

With interesting opportunities in engineering, marketing, sales, supply chain, operations, HR, finance, and more across more than 40 diverse businesses around the globe, chances are, we have something special for you.

VP Strategy - Fire & Safety


Fire and Safety is a global platform within IDEX, serving mission critical customers across fire suppression, emergency response, rescue, industrial safety and related highly engineered solutions. The platform includes a diverse portfolio of businesses and brands serving municipal fire, industrial, OEM, emergency rescue, specialty vehicle, and critical infrastructure customers.


The VP, Strategy — Fire & Safety will serve as the platform’s strategist, growth architect, and thought partner. This leader will sit on the Fire & Safety leadership team and collaborate closely with the president, business unit leaders, commercial leaders, functional leaders, and corporate development to shape where Fire & Safety plays, how it wins, and how the platform delivers sustained profitable growth.



Summary Role Overview

Reporting to the FSDP and FMT Segment, VP of Strategy, the VP Strategy - Fire & Safety will build and lead a best-in-class strategy capability that enables sustainable, profitable growth across the global platform. This leader will be responsible for developing a clear, differentiated Fire & Safety strategy that guides portfolio choices, where-to-play/how-to-win decisions, commercial focus, innovation priorities, inorganic growth, and execution across business units and regions.



The VP Strategy - Fire & Safety will function as the strategic architect and execution partner to the President and the Fire & Safety leadership team. They will define and embed the platform strategy, shape long-term direction, identify major go-to-market shifts, and prioritize the highest-value organic and inorganic growth bets. The role will partner closely with business unit leaders to ensure strategy is not a stand-alone planning exercise, but a practical operating system that informs resource allocation, commercial focus, product vitality, M&A priorities, and measurable business outcomes.


This leader will also play a critical role in strengthening Fire & Safety’s external and internal strategic narrative ensuring the platform has a compelling, data-driven story supported by strong market intelligence, customer insight, competitive understanding, and clear value creation logic.



Responsibilities


  • Define and embed a clear Fire & Safety platform strategy that identifies where to play, how to win, and the capabilities needed to achieve sustained profitable growth.
  • Partner with business unit leaders to align strategic priorities, resource allocation, and execution plans across the Fire & Safety portfolio.
  • Lead portfolio assessment work to identify growth opportunities, adjacency plays, margin expansion opportunities, whitespace, underpenetrated markets, and areas requiring strategic repositioning.
  • Identify and prioritize the highest-value organic growth opportunities across Fire & Safety, including customer segments, applications, geographies, product platforms, services, and solution-led offerings.
  • Partner with commercial and business leaders to shape go-to-market strategy, channel priorities, customer segmentation, solution selling opportunities, and differentiated value propositions.
  • Strengthening innovation strategy by linking product vitality, customer needs, market trends, and growth priorities to measurable revenue and margin outcomes.
  • Establish clear governance, KPIs, and value tracking for strategic initiatives, innovation programs, AI-enabled use cases, and commercial growth bets.
  • Build a robust market intelligence capability for Fire & Safety, including credible insight into market size, growth rates, customer needs, competitive dynamics, technology shifts, regulatory trends, and emerging adjacencies.
  • Partner with business units to raise the quality of strategic planning through stronger analytics, sharper choices, and more actionable execution plans.
  • Translate strategy into a disciplined execution roadmap with clear owners, milestones, KPIs, and value tracking.
  • Partner with business and functional leaders to ensure top strategic initiatives deliver measurable impact on revenue, margin, return on investment, and enterprise value.
  • Own synergy goals in partnership with business leaders, identifying opportunities to leverage common capabilities, customers, channels, technologies, sourcing, operations, and commercial practices across the platform.


Qualifications


  • Bachelor’s degree in business, Engineering, Economics, Finance, or a related field required, MBA or relevant advanced degree preferred.
  • Approximately 8+ years of experience in strategy, corporate development, general management, commercial strategy, or related leadership roles.
  • Experience in industrials, manufacturing, engineered products, mission-critical equipment, safety, emergency response, fluid management, or complex B2B environments strongly preferred.
  • Proven track record developing and executing growth strategies that deliver above-market performance.
  • Strong experience with portfolio strategy, market assessment, competitive analysis, commercial strategy, and business case development.
  • Strong financial and analytical skills, with the ability to connect market insights, strategic choices, and business outcomes.
  • Experience building or elevating strategy capabilities, processes, teams, or governance models across a business platform.

Attributes and Skills


  • Strategic thinker who simplifies complexity, frames clear choices, and brings focus to the highest-value opportunities.
  • Strong business acumen with the ability to connect customer needs, market dynamics, competitive insight, financial performance, and operational capability.
  • Highly analytical and comfortable working with data, financials, market intelligence, and business performance metrics.
  • Demonstrated ability to translate strategy into disciplined execution, clear governance, accountability, and measurable outcomes.
  • Growth-minded, curious, proactive, and comfortable navigating ambiguity, change, and transformation.
  • Talent champion who builds capability, develops team members, and fosters a culture of accountability, collaboration, and execution.

Are you ready to join a different kind of company where our people, our culture, and our commitments are centered around providing trusted solutions that improve lives around the world?

The compensation range for this position is $134,700.00 - $202,100.00, depending on experience. This position may be eligible for performance based bonus plan.

raw.description:
Estamos à procura de um(a) Designer de Interiores experiente para colaborar, em regime remoto e dedicação praticamente exclusiva, no desenvolvimento integral de um projeto de interiores para um espaço corporativo.

Trata-se de um projeto com duração prevista entre 1 e 2 meses, cujo objetivo é criar um conceito de design contemporâneo, funcional e diferenciador, desenvolvendo toda a documentação necessária para a sua implementação.

Procuramos um profissional criativo, com forte capacidade técnica e atenção ao detalhe, capaz de transformar uma ideia num projeto completo e preparado para execução.

Principais Responsabilidades

O profissional será responsável pelo desenvolvimento integral do projeto de interiores, incluindo:

Estudo e Planeamento do Espaço

  • Análise funcional do espaço;
  • Estudo da circulação e organização das diferentes áreas;
  • Definição de layouts;
  • Propostas de otimização do espaço;
  • Desenvolvimento do conceito de design.

Projeto de Design de Interiores

Desenvolvimento completo do projeto, incluindo:

  • Seleção de mobiliário;
  • Iluminação;
  • Materiais;
  • Pavimentos;
  • Revestimentos;
  • Carpintarias;
  • Elementos decorativos;
  • Soluções de armazenamento;
  • Elementos acústicos;
  • Cores e acabamentos;
  • Ambientes e identidade visual do espaço.

Modelação e Visualização 3D

Desenvolvimento de modelos tridimensionais e imagens realistas de todas as áreas do projeto, incluindo:

  • Modelação 3D;
  • Renderizações fotorrealistas;
  • Diferentes perspetivas dos espaços;
  • Ajustes e iterações sempre que necessário.

Especificação Técnica

Preparação de toda a documentação necessária para implementação do projeto, incluindo:

  • Identificação detalhada de todos os produtos utilizados;
  • Marcas e fabricantes;
  • Modelos;
  • Referências;
  • Cores;
  • Materiais;
  • Quantidades;
  • Valores estimados de aquisição;
  • Sugestão de fornecedores e alternativas quando aplicável.

O objetivo é entregar um projeto que permita posteriormente solicitar orçamentos e negociar diretamente com fornecedores e fabricantes.

Entregáveis

No final do projeto deverão ser entregues:

  • Layout final do espaço;
  • Modelo 3D completo;
  • Imagens fotorrealistas de todos os ambientes;
  • Manual de especificações dos materiais e produtos;
  • Lista completa de mobiliário, iluminação, decoração e restantes elementos utilizados;
  • Documento com marcas, modelos, referências e valores estimados;
  • Organização de todos os ficheiros editáveis e documentação técnica.

Requisitos

Obrigatórios

  • Formação em Design de Interiores, Arquitetura de Interiores ou área equivalente;
  • Experiência comprovada em projetos de interiores corporativos, comerciais ou residenciais de elevada qualidade;
  • Excelente capacidade de organização e atenção ao detalhe;
  • Domínio de ferramentas de modelação e visualização 3D;
  • Capacidade para trabalhar de forma autónoma e cumprir prazos.

Valorizamos

  • SketchUp;
  • 3ds Max;
  • V-Ray;
  • Corona Renderer;
  • Enscape;
  • Lumion;
  • AutoCAD;
  • Revit;
  • Photoshop;
  • Illustrator.

Regime de Trabalho

  • Trabalho 100% remoto;
  • Dedicação praticamente exclusiva durante 1 a 2 meses;
  • Horário compatível com Portugal;
  • Reuniões periódicas através de Google Meet;
  • Comunicação diária com a equipa do projeto;
  • Partilha de documentação através de Google Drive.

Perfil Procurado

Procuramos um(a) profissional apaixonado(a) por design de interiores, com forte sentido estético e capacidade para desenvolver projetos completos, bem documentados e preparados para implementação.

Valorizamos profissionais que consigam equilibrar criatividade, funcionalidade e rigor técnico, apresentando soluções inovadoras e exequíveis, sempre com atenção aos custos e à qualidade dos materiais especificados.

Se gosta de criar espaços únicos, domina ferramentas de modelação 3D e tem experiência na seleção criteriosa de materiais, mobiliário e iluminação, gostaríamos de conhecer o seu trabalho.

Processo de Seleção

Os candidatos pré-selecionados poderão ser convidados a realizar um pequeno desafio técnico remunerado, que permitirá avaliar a qualidade das propostas, o nível de detalhe da documentação produzida e a capacidade de transformar um briefing num projeto de interiores completo e pronto para execução.

raw.excerpt: About ImprovadoImprovado is an AI-powered marketing data platform built for mid-market and enterprise teams.
raw.description:
About Improvado

Improvado is an AI-powered marketing data platform built for mid-market and enterprise teams. We help companies automate complex marketing data workflows, unify data at scale, and surface insights through BI and AI. Brands like Genentech, T-Mobile, Activision, and H&R Block rely on us to simplify analytics and improve marketing performance.

We’re a fast-growing Series A startup backed by $34M in funding and driven by a team that moves fast, stays curious, and cares about high-quality execution.

About the role

Improvado is a marketing data platform for enterprise brands and agencies. You will own how our revenue runs and how it is measured. That covers Salesforce and the GTM tools, the path from signed contract to paid invoice, the revenue data model, and the reports leadership decides from. You work closely with the analytics team: you don’t have to build the data models yourself, but you must read them, spot what is wrong and say what to change. You work through AI agents daily, doing the work of a bigger team.

What you will do

Salesforce and GTM stack

  • Own Salesforce configuration, release process and user access, plus the integrations around it (Gong, Clay, Lemlist, enrichment, e-signature, lead routing).
  • Keep CRM data clean with guardrails that block mistakes. Manage licences and vendor renewals.
  • Maintain the Salesforce manual and RevOps SOPs, and train new hires.

Contract to cash

  • Own ARR and bookings logic (new, upsell, downsell, churn, renewals) and keep agreement, opportunity, and invoice consistent.
  • Run the closed-deals and billing check with Finance. Fix errors at the source and add a control so they don’t repeat.
  • Audit invoices, track and chase unpaid ones, and prepare quarterly commission and quota reports.

Revenue analytics and data model

  • Own the quarterly sales analytics pack, the CRO report, the forecast and pipeline coverage (including CS renewal inputs).
  • Track funnel conversion, explain why deals move, stall or slip, and keep attribution correct with Marketing.
  • Query ClickHouse daily, trace any number to its source, and write specs for model changes. Give each metric one documented definition and add data quality checks.
  • Build leadership dashboards, retire unused ones, and end every analysis with a recommendation, a number and an owner.

AI and automation

  • Use coding agents (Claude Code, Codex) for queries, scripts and Salesforce automation, and always verify their output.
  • Automate manual work (invoice and payment checks, CRM hygiene, deal-risk alerts, call analysis) and measure hours saved and errors avoided.

Ownership

  • Be the single RevOps contact for Sales, CS, Marketing, Finance and Product. Turn each request into a task with an owner, date and success metric.

Requirements

  • 4-6+ years in RevOps, Sales Ops or GTM systems in B2B SaaS, with hands-on admin of a live Salesforce org.
  • Strong SQL and comfort in a modeled warehouse (layers, lineage, one definition per metric). dbt is a plus.
  • Deep knowledge of the B2B SaaS revenue cycle: funnel, pipeline, forecast, ARR, churn, renewals.
  • Experience running the money side: contracts, invoicing, collections, kept in sync with the CRM.
  • Proof you build with AI agents: something you shipped that others use.
  • Fluent English and clear written updates without being asked.

Nice to have

  • Salesforce Administrator or Advanced Administrator certification.
  • ClickHouse or another columnar warehouse, and any BI tool.
  • Salesforce development (Apex, triggers, API).
  • Gong, Clay, Lemlist, or workflow automation tools.
  • Billing, CPQ, or accounting systems.
  • HubSpot to Salesforce migration.
  • Attribution or CS health score data.
  • Martech or analytics company background.

What We Offer

  • Remote-first environment
  • Strong product/market fit: marketing data product for US-based enterprises
  • 20 working days of PTO per year
  • US holidays and additional days off
  • Professional development reimbursement
