raw.title: Sr Business Analyst (Pharmacovigilance & AI Systems)
raw.excerpt: ESSENTIAL DUTIES AND RESPONSIBILITIESRequirements Engineering• Elicit, document and maintain URS and FRS for each platform module, using structured workshops, process walkthroughs, system demonstrations and review of current SOPs, work instructions and conventions.
raw.description:
ESSENTIAL DUTIES AND RESPONSIBILITIES

Requirements Engineering

  • Elicit, document and maintain URS and FRS for each platform module, using structured workshops, process walkthroughs, system demonstrations and review of current SOPs, work instructions and conventions.
  • Produce the supporting artefacts: as-is and to-be process maps, data-flow diagrams, user stories with acceptance criteria, business rules, data dictionaries, interface specifications and non-functional requirements (performance, availability, security, auditability, data retention).
  • Build and maintain the Requirements Traceability Matrix from URS to FRS to design, test cases and validation evidence, so every requirement can be implemented and tested.
  • Run requirement reviews with PV operations, Quality, IT Security, Data Privacy and Engineering; manage change control on approved requirements.
  • Prioritize with the Product Owner, write release-level scope statements and support sprint planning and backlog refinement.

Domain coverage

You will specify requirements across the following modules, working with the respective PV subject-matter experts:

  • Global and local literature search strategy management, database connectors (MEDLINE/PubMed, Embase and others), de-duplication, AI-assisted relevance screening and ICSR identification, full-text handling, reviewer workflow, hit-level audit trail, reconciliation and KPIs; alignment with GVP Module VI and local literature requirements.
  • Multi-channel intake (email, portal, call centre, partner feeds, literature, social media), duplicate detection, AI-assisted data extraction from unstructured sources, MedDRA and WHODrug coding support, seriousness and expectedness assessment, narrative generation with human review, E2B(R3) submission, follow-up management, and integration with safety databases (e.g. Argus, LifeSphere, Veeva Vault Safety).
  • Data sources (safety database, EudraVigilance, FAERS, literature), disproportionality and signal detection methods, signal validation, prioritisation, assessment and tracking workflows, signal-to-risk linkage, and documentation aligned to GVP Module IX.
  • Data retrieval and reconciliation, line listings and summary tabulations, AI-assisted section drafting with locked source-to-text traceability, author and reviewer workflow, version control, schedule and submission tracking, aligned to 21 CFR 314.80 and ICH E2C(R2).
  • Source and channel configuration, listening rules, AI classification of posts for potential adverse events, identifiability and validity criteria, PII handling, reviewer workflow and conversion to case intake, aligned to GVP Module VI and FDA guidance on internet and social media.
  • PSMF support, audit-trail reporting and query, compliance dashboards (timeliness, quality, backlog), deviation and CAPA linkage, document and training evidence retrieval, and the ability to reproduce any AI-assisted decision on request.

Agentic AI specifics

  • Define, for every agent in the platform, its role, inputs, tools, permitted actions and decision authority, and the human-in-the-loop checkpoints where a qualified person must review, approve or override.
  • Specify AI output acceptance criteria with the SMEs: target precision and recall for screening and classification tasks, confidence thresholds for auto-routing versus human review, and how performance is measured and monitored in production.
  • Write requirements for explainability and auditability of AI decisions: rationale capture, source citation, prompt and model version logging, reproducibility, and retention of the evidence an inspector would ask for.
  • Specify guardrails: what agents must never do without human approval (e.g. submit an ICSR, close a signal, finalise a report), handling of low-confidence or out-of-distribution inputs, and fallback behaviour when a model or tool is unavailable.
  • Define requirements for model lifecycle governance: evaluation datasets, change control for prompts and models, regression testing, periodic review, and restrictions on use of client data for model training.

Regulatory, quality and privacy compliance

  • Translate the following into explicit, testable requirements and work with Quality on validation strategy:
    • 21 CFR Part 11 and EU GMP Annex 11: electronic records, electronic signatures, audit trails, access control, data integrity (ALCOA+), system security, record retention and retrieval.
    • GDPR and other applicable data-protection laws: lawful basis, data minimisation, pseudonymisation, data-subject rights, cross-border transfer, retention and deletion, privacy by design; support Data Protection Impact Assessments.
    • GVP Modules (notably I, II, IV, VI, VII, IX) and ICH E2B(R3), E2C(R2), E2D, E2E as they apply to each module.
    • Computerised system validation: GAMP 5 (second edition), risk-based and Computer Software Assurance approaches; author or contribute to validation plans, functional risk assessments, test strategies and traceability.
    • Quality Management System requirements for product development: SDLC procedures, change control, deviation and CAPA management, supplier qualification, documentation standards; alignment with ISO 9001 and information-security frameworks (ISO 27001, SOC 2).
    • Emerging AI-specific regulation and guidance (EU AI Act, FDA and EMA positions on AI in pharmacovigilance and GxP): assess applicability, track developments and reflect them in requirements.
  • Act as the requirements-side point of contact during internal audits and client or regulatory inspections of the platform.

Stakeholder and delivery

  • Work day-to-day with PV operations leads, medical reviewers, Quality Assurance, Data Privacy, IT Security, product management, UX, data scientists and engineers.
  • Support UAT: author or review test scripts against the FRS, coordinate business testers, triage defects and confirm requirement coverage.
  • Prepare release notes, user-facing functional documentation and training inputs for operations teams.
  • Contribute to client-facing material describing how the platform meets regulatory expectations.

MINIMUM KNOWLEDGE, SKILLS AND ABILITIES

  • Bachelor's degree in life sciences, pharmacy, nursing, medicine, computer science or a related field.
  • 6+ years in pharmacovigilance or PV systems, with at least 3 years in a business analyst, systems analyst or product requirements role on GxP software.
  • Demonstrated experience authoring URS and FRS (and ideally validation documentation) for PV or other regulated life-sciences systems.
  • Working knowledge of at least four of the six domain areas above, gained in operations, a safety-system implementation or a technology vendor; hands-on familiarity with at least one commercial safety database (Argus, LifeSphere, Veeva Vault Safety or equivalent).
  • Solid understanding of 21 CFR Part 11, EU GMP Annex 11, data-integrity principles and GDPR, and of how they translate into system requirements.
  • Experience working within a QMS and formal SDLC (change control, CSV/CSA, traceability, deviation handling).
  • Practical understanding of how LLMs and AI agents work, their failure modes, and what it takes to make their output acceptable in a regulated setting. Prior involvement in an AI or automation project in PV is strongly preferred.
  • Strong analytical writing: you can produce a requirement that an engineer can build, a tester can test and an auditor can verify, without ambiguity.
  • Comfortable with Agile delivery and tools such as Jira, Confluence or Azure DevOps.

Preferred

  • Experience with E2B(R3) implementation, MedDRA and WHODrug coding, and EudraVigilance or FAERS data.
  • Experience specifying NLP, machine-learning or GenAI features (classification, extraction, summarisation) including evaluation metrics and acceptance criteria.
  • Familiarity with GAMP 5 second edition and the FDA Computer Software Assurance approach.
  • Awareness of the EU AI Act and of EMA/FDA reflection papers on AI in the medicinal-product lifecycle.
  • Prior participation in regulatory inspections or client audits of PV systems.
  • Certifications such as CBAP, PMI-PBA, or ISPE/GAMP training.

OUR CULTURAL BELIEFS:

Patient Minded I act with the patient’s best interest in mind.
Client Delight I own every client experience and its impact on results.
Take Action I am empowered and empower others to act now.
Grow Talent I own my development and invest in the development of others.
Win Together I passionately connect with anyone, anywhere, anytime to achieve results.
Communication Matters I speak up to create transparent, thoughtful and timely dialogue.
Embrace Diversity I create an environment of awareness and respect.
Always Innovate I am bold and creative in everything I do.

Our team is aware of recent fraudulent job offers in the market, misrepresenting EVERSANA. Recruitment fraud is a sophisticated scam commonly perpetrated through online services using fake websites, unsolicited e-mails, or even text messages claiming to be a legitimate company. Some of these scams request personal information and even payment for training or job application fees. Please know EVERSANA would never require personal information nor payment of any kind during the employment process. We respect the personal rights of all candidates looking to explore careers at EVERSANA.

From EVERSANA’s inception, Diversity, Equity & Inclusion have always been key to our success. We are an Equal Opportunity Employer, and our employees are people with different strengths, experiences, and backgrounds who share a passion for improving the lives of patients and leading innovation within the healthcare industry. Diversity not only includes race and gender identity, but also age, disability status, veteran status, sexual orientation, religion, and many other parts of one’s identity. All of our employees’ points of view are key to our success, and inclusion is everyone's responsibility.

Follow us on LinkedIn | Twitter

At EVERSANA, we are proud to be certified as a Great Place to Work across the globe. We’re fueled by our vision to create a healthier world. How? Our global team of more than 7,000 employees is committed to creating and delivering next-generation commercialization services to the life sciences industry. We are grounded in our cultural beliefs and serve more than 650 clients ranging from innovative biotech start-ups to established pharmaceutical companies. Our products, services and solutions help bring innovative therapies to market and support the patients who depend on them. Our jobs, skills and talents are unique, but together we make an impact every day. Join us!

Across our growing organization, we embrace diversity in backgrounds and experiences. Improving patient lives around the world is a priority, and we need people from all backgrounds and swaths of life to help build the future of the healthcare and the life sciences industry. We believe our people make all the difference in cultivating an inclusive culture that embraces our cultural beliefs. We are deliberate and self-reflective about the kind of team and culture we are building. We look for team members that are not only strong in their own aptitudes but also who care deeply about EVERSANA, our people, clients and most importantly, the patients we serve. We are EVERSANA.

raw.description:
We are a plucky, independent, fully remote video game studio primarily based in the UK, and makers of the widely praised and highly rated Galacticare and War for the Overworld. The core team has joined together from all over the world because of a shared passion for building brighter universes. Our goal is to continue creating genre-twisting 3D simulation and management games; and if we can do it with a quirkily British sense of humour, then all the better!

Role Overview

We're looking for an Art Lead to own the visual identity of Brightrock Games, with immediate focus on our current production, Kaiju Cleanup.

You'll be joining a small, tight knit team of developers helping us push and blend the boundaries of traditional game genres. As an Art Lead, you're responsible for leading art across every discipline - concept, character, environment, VFX, UI/UX and technical art and for making sure that direction holds up against a real production schedule.

We're looking for someone who has led art on a shipped title, can build a visual language from scratch, is comfortable mentoring artists across disciplines and seniority levels, and knows composition, colour and lighting well enough to also know what's realistic on an indie budget.

Key Responsibilities

1 - Define and Own the Art Vision

Success looks like:

  • Set the visual style for Brightrock's titles: art bibles, mood boards, and reference standards that keep every discipline pointed the same direction.
  • Keep concept art, characters, environments, VFX, and UI reading as one world, not five.
  • Sign off on key art milestones, and say no when quality and schedule are actually in conflict.

2 - Lead and Develop the Art Team

Success looks like:

  • Direct and mentor artists across disciplines, with feedback specific enough to act on.
  • Hire and onboard as the team grows, and shape the art pipeline and tools as you go.
  • Keep the team collaborative: craft matters more than title here, same as everywhere else at the studio.

3 - Liaise Across the Studio

Success looks like:

  • Work with Creative and Game Design to turn concepts and gameplay needs into a visual direction that reads clearly on screen.
  • Work with Production on scheduling and priority calls, flagging risk early rather than at the deadline.
  • Work with the Technical team to keep the art performant, and with Marketing/Community on trailers, store pages, and other external art.

Requirements

  • A portfolio showing art direction on at least one shipped PC/console title, with a visual language you can point to and explain.
  • Working knowledge across concept, character, and environment art and VFX. You don't need to be the best in the studio at each, but you need to be able to critique and guide all of them.
  • Comfortable with Photoshop and either Blender or 3ds Max, plus the Substance suite; enough Unity knowledge to know what's technically realistic.
  • A strong eye for composition, colour, and lighting, and the ability to say why something works, not just that it does.
  • Experience managing or mentoring artists, with feedback that improves the work without wrecking morale.
  • A fit for a small indie team, where collaboration counts for more than a title.

Desirable:

  • Happy to jump in and fix or build an asset yourself, not just direct from a distance.
  • Understands performance limits: draw calls, LODs, lighting budgets - and how they shape art decisions.
  • Knows Houdini or similar, and likes building modular/trim-sheet workflows that save the team time.
  • Has a keen interest in emergent technologies and their potential applications.
  • Has produced or directed key art, trailers, or store assets before.

Please Note: This is a full-time, remote-working position, open to anyone within the UK & Europe.

Benefits

Our benefits include a 2-week company summer break and a 2-week winter break to rest and recharge, in addition to your normal holiday allowance.

raw.description:
All roles at JumpCloud® are Remote unless otherwise specified in the Job Description.

About JumpCloud®

JumpCloud® is the AI-powered unified IT management platform designed to secure the modern workforce. By consolidating identity, device, and access management, JumpCloud provides intelligent, secure IT that scales from human users to autonomous AI agents. We help organizations around the globe eliminate complexity and turn AI risk into an optimized advantage, ensuring the right people and agents have secure access to the right resources at all times.

JumpCloud is Intelligent, Secure IT.

About the role:

JumpCloud is looking for a Senior Technical Program Manager (TPM) to operate the Security organization's program management function. This is a hands-on role for a classically trained program manager who has already integrated AI deeply into their working life and uses it to operate at a higher level than traditional PM scale allows. You will own the day-to-day program management of the security organization's projects and run a hybrid program management capability where AI handles continuous structured work, while you provide the judgment, prioritization and relationship work where humans excel.

About the team:

Our Security organization spans SecOps, GRC, and DevSecOps. As our scope grows, we are actively investing in modern, AI-augmented operations. As the Senior TPM reporting to the Director of Security, you will own program management across the entire org. You will partner closely with security leadership, engineers, and our AI team, collaborating to design, refine, and drive the AI-assisted program management systems that power our daily work.

What you will be doing:

  • Operating Standard Enforcement: Apply a single operating standard across every security project. Drive project hygiene at scale: ownership, dates, scope, plans, status. Review and act on AI-generated drafts that flag gaps, propose fixes and surface stale work to project owners.

  • Intake and Triage: Own the front door for security requests across Slack channels, ticket forms and direct asks. Classify, route, set expectations with requestors and capture demand as data. Train the AI classification system through your corrections and feedback.

  • Status and Reporting: Produce per-person, per-project and program-level status briefs and the reports the security org commits to (weekly operating reviews, monthly engineering-relevant metrics, quarterly roadmap progress). Edit AI-drafted reports for narrative, framing and the relationship context the data does not capture.

  • Capacity and Commitment: Maintain a working model of team capacity and project commitments. Flag slippage early. Surface overcommitment to leadership before dates slip. Apply judgment for factors the data does not see (team morale, growth needs, strategic context).

  • Interruption Work Tracking: Inventory and measure the categories of interruption work the team handles (elevation requests, threat model processing, team requests, secret rotations, vulnerability alerts and others). Propose new projects to reduce unplanned work and improve processing efficiency.

  • Prioritization: Place new work in the priority queue using stated criteria of impact, urgency, dependencies and capacity. Apply judgment for political and strategic context.

  • AI System Partnership: Work directly with the AI engineering function as an internal customer. File feature requests, validate output quality, define what good looks like and shape the system over time. You are the product owner for the program management capability that supports your work.

  • Operating Standard Evolution: Refine the operating standard as edge cases surface. Propose updates, build team buy-in and roll out changes consistently.

  • Cross-Company Representation: Represent the security organization's program management practice to peers, stakeholders, and leadership across the company. Ensure all program reporting provides an accurate, transparent, and objective view of current progress and risks.

Necessary skills:

  • 6 years of program or project management experience, ideally including time in technical or engineering organizations

  • Demonstrated experience using AI to scale your program management practice. You can describe specific examples of how AI has saved time, reduced cost, automated routine work or enabled you to operate at a higher level

  • Deep fluency with Jira and Confluence, including epic and project structure, JQL, dashboards and reporting

  • Excellent written communication. You can draft a clear executive update, a precise project brief and an honest status report

  • Comfort working without complete information. You exercise judgment and make calls without waiting for permission

  • Ability to push back constructively, including upward, when commitments are at risk or scope is creeping

  • Experience operating in a remote-first organization

  • Bonus: prior experience in security, infrastructure or platform engineering organizations

Personal characteristics we are looking for:

  • Passionate about AI as a force multiplier, not the primary focus. You have already integrated AI into how you work and can describe what it has and has not done for you

  • Operates from first principles. You understand what actually needs to get done and you do not let tooling distract from the work

  • Emotionally mature. You can hold a high standard, deliver honest feedback and stay constructive when commitments slip or decisions are contested

  • High level of integrity. You report what is true, not what is flattering

  • Ownership and accountability. The program is yours

  • Clear, direct communication

  • Creative problem solver

  • Service-minded. You understand program management is a service function and the team you support is the customer

  • Bonus: passionate about security

Where you’ll be working/Location:

JumpCloud® is committed to being Remote First, meaning that you are able to work remotely within the country noted in the Job Description.
This role is remote in the country of Mexico. You must be located in and authorized to work in Mexico to be considered for this role.

Language:

JumpCloud® has teams in 15+ countries around the world and conducts our internal business in English. The interview and any additional screening process will take place primarily in English. To be considered for a role at JumpCloud®, you will be required to speak and write in English fluently. Any additional language requirements will be included in the details of the job description.

Why JumpCloud®?

If you thrive working in a fast, SaaS-based environment and you are passionate about solving challenging technical problems, we look forward to hearing from you! JumpCloud® is an incredible place to share and grow your expertise! You’ll work with amazing talent across each department who are passionate about our mission. We’re out of the box thinkers, so your unique ideas and approaches for conceiving a product and/or feature will be welcome. You’ll have a voice in the organization as you work with a seasoned executive team, a supportive board and in a proven market that our customers are excited about.

The Manager / Technical Lead is a hands-on technical delivery leader responsible for both leading the team and actively delivering the solution.


This is not an oversight-only role. The expectation is that this person will personally configure, customize, troubleshoot, and implement the system alongside the team, while providing technical direction, mentoring team members, and increasing the team's overall capability.

.

Key Responsibilities


Hands-On Solution Delivery

  • Actively configure and customize the platform as a member of the delivery team.
  • Build and implement complex solution components, integrations, extensions, automation, and other technical capabilities as required.
  • Troubleshoot technical and performance issues and personally assist with their resolution.
  • Participate directly in development, configuration, testing, deployment, and stabilization activities.
  • Take ownership of technically challenging work rather than simply assigning it to others.
  • Use Copilot and approved AI tools to accelerate development, configuration, testing, troubleshooting, and documentation while validating the quality of AI-assisted work.

Technical Leadership

  • Translate business requirements into practical solution designs and implementation approaches.
  • Establish architecture, patterns, development standards, and engineering practices.
  • Perform design and code reviews and ensure technical quality.
  • Make pragmatic technical decisions that balance delivery timelines with scalability, performance, security, and maintainability.
  • Lead through hands-on participation and demonstration, not just technical direction.

Team Development

  • Work side-by-side with team members to develop their technical capabilities.
  • Coach team members through real configuration, customization, development, and troubleshooting scenarios.
  • Upskill the team so that knowledge and capability are distributed rather than concentrated with the Technical Lead.
  • Delegate appropriately while remaining willing and able to step in and execute.
  • Encourage effective use of Copilot and AI-assisted engineering practices across the team.
  • Create reusable patterns, examples, prompts, and accelerators that allow the team to become increasingly self-sufficient.

Delivery Ownership

  • Own technical delivery from design through implementation and stabilization.
  • Partner with functional and project leadership on scope, estimates, dependencies, risks, and priorities.
  • Identify technical blockers early and actively work to resolve them.
  • Maintain accountability for technical quality and delivery commitments.
  • Clearly communicate technical risks, tradeoffs, and recommendations to clients and delivery leadership.

The Expectation: Player + Coach


The Manager / Technical Lead is expected to be both:

  • Player: Personally configure, customize, develop, troubleshoot, and deliver.
  • Coach: Teach others how to do the work and increase the team's capability.
  • Technical Leader: Set direction, standards, architecture, and quality expectations.
  • Delivery Leader: Own outcomes, remove blockers, and ensure the solution gets delivered.
  • AI Leader: Demonstrate how Copilot can improve day-to-day delivery and help the team incorporate those practices into how they work.

The key principle is: Don't just tell the team how to build it. Build it with them, teach them while doing it, and leave the team stronger than you found it.

Fondée par une figure de référence du leadership et de l'entrepreneuriat francophone, cette entreprise accompagne depuis plus de 20 ans des entrepreneurs, dirigeants et équipes dans leur croissance, en alliant stratégie business et développement personnel. Acteur incontournable de l'organisation d'événements en leadership et entrepreneuriat francophones, elle forme et accompagne chaque année des dizaines de milliers de personnes.

Avec plusieurs millions de followers tous réseaux confondus (YouTube, Instagram, TikTok, LinkedIn, Facebook), l'entreprise souhaite structurer et intensifier sa présence organique pour en faire un vrai moteur de leads. Pour porter cette ambition, nous recrutons un(e) Social Media Strategist.

En une phrase : vous pilotez ET exécutez la stratégie de contenu organique de l'entreprise, de l'idéation à la publication, pour faire grandir son audience, renforcer l'autorité digitale de son fondateur et générer des leads qualifiés. Ce n'est ni un poste purement théorique ni un poste de simple publication.

🎯 Vos missions:

En tant que Social Media Strategist, vous serez en charge de :

Stratégie et ligne éditoriale

  • Construire une véritable structure éditoriale marketing : définir les piliers de contenu, une trame hebdomadaire par plateforme, et relier chaque type de contenu à un objectif marketing précis et à l'entonnoir de conversion (audience vers lead vers client).

  • Définir et tenir le calendrier éditorial multi-plateformes (LinkedIn, Instagram, YouTube, TikTok).

  • Benchmarker les meilleurs comptes de notre niche business à l'international (notamment US) : identifier les références, décoder ce qui fonctionne chez eux (accroches, formats, cadence, angles, monétisation) et en tirer des recommandations concrètes et actionnables.

  • Amener en continu des idées de contenus, de formats et de formes nouvelles (interviews, vlogs, séries, démonstrations, frameworks, contenus courts et longs), les tester, mesurer et les faire évoluer selon les résultats.

  • Assurer une veille constante des tendances et du marché (notamment US) pour irriguer la ligne éditoriale.

  • Coordonner les différents formats de contenu et garantir la cohérence de la ligne éditoriale.

Production et exécution

  • Écrire les posts et scripts (copywriting / ghostwriting) en respectant la voix du CEO et la charte éditoriale.

  • Diriger la production vidéo et les monteurs : cadence, formats, qualité.

  • Sélectionner les meilleurs passages des longues interviews et les confier aux monteurs (logique de clipping), et participer à la montée en puissance de l'équipe de monteurs.

  • Tenir le planning de montage, vérifier les livrables et les rapprocher des factures des monteurs, et s'assurer que les vidéos sont bien montées, téléchargées et rangées.

  • Assurer le graphisme et l'identité visuelle des contenus (carrousels, visuels, miniatures).

Community management

  • Assurer opérationnellement la gestion des réseaux sociaux : animation, modération, réponses en DM et commentaires, publication.

  • Faire remonter les leads chauds détectés en DM au Setter, via un système de transmission clair.

Conversion et coordination

  • Implémenter et développer les lead magnets pour convertir l'audience en leads, en lien avec le Directeur Marketing Opérationnel.

  • Coordonner avec le Directeur Marketing Opérationnel pour aligner organique et payant.

raw.description:
TheOrder Output Manageris responsible for driving predictable order execution, improving operational resilience, and strengthening cross-functional alignment across a complex global manufacturing environment. Working closely with Planning, Operations, Supply Chain, Manufacturing, Quality, and other partner functions, this role provides end-to-end visibility into order status, production constraints, material readiness, and delivery risks.

The Order Output Manager proactively identifies risks and bottlenecks that could impact customer commitments, coordinate cross-functional recovery actions, and ensures timely escalation and resolution of critical issues. This role establishes clear ownership, priorities, and timelines while driving disciplined follow-through to support on-time delivery and overall execution performance.

In addition, the Order Output Manager identifies recurring barriers and process gaps and helps implement operating mechanisms that improve execution consistency, accountability, and predictability over time.

What You’ll Do

  • Drive
    end-to-end order execution, from order acceptance and material readiness through manufacturing, testing, shipment, and delivery.
  • Coordinate cross-functional responses to disruptions or constraints that may impact
    customer commitments, delivery performance, or production continuity.
  • Provide timely visibility into order status, material shortages, capacity constraints, production risks, and other emerging issues through structured monitoring and reporting.
  • Lead active issue management by aligning stakeholders, establishing recovery plans, assigning ownership, and facilitating escalation when required.
  • Monitor
    order output, production performance, and operational trendsto identify risks early and enable proactive intervention.
  • Ensure clear ownership, accountability, priorities, timelines, and follow-through for critical actions affecting order execution.
  • Partner with Planning, Operations, Supply Chain, Manufacturing, Quality, and other functions to maintain production flow and recover orders at risk.
  • Communicate operational status, delivery outlook, key risks, mitigation plans, and decision requirements to stakeholders and leadership.
  • Establish and maintain
    order execution metrics and operating cadencesto improve visibility, predictability, and accountability.
  • Identify recurring issues, process gaps, and systemic barriers and drive corrective actions that improve operational resilience and execution consistency.
  • Support continuous improvement initiatives focused on
    lead-time reduction, material readiness, production output, and on-time delivery.
  • Promote a culture of transparency, urgency, accountability, and continuous improvement across a global, matrixed organization.
Salary: $140,000 - $160,000

raw.description:
Discover What’s Possible at BetMGM

Ready to make your career legendary? Join us as we bring the magic of Vegas to our players. The BetMGM team has over 1,400 talented members, revolutionizing sports betting and online gaming in the United States and Canada. We’re a brand with technology at our hearts and the most driven and focused talent in the business.

  • Medical, Dental, Vision, Life, and Disability Insurance

  • Swag, ticket giveaways, and more!

At BetMGM, we recognize that every individual plays a meaningful role in our success. That’s why we’re committed to building a respectful, inclusive workplace. It’s the strategy behind every win. By meeting people where they are, we create a culture of belonging where everyone can thrive and a workplace that reflects our values, our people, and our drive to win.

The Opportunity

We are looking for an exceptional analytical leader to join our Sports Analytics team as a Principal Sports
Analyst. As the most senior individual contributor on the team, the Principal Analyst will set the strategic
direction for Sports Analytics, serve as the definitive organizational authority on sports wagering data,
and drive enterprise-wide analytical frameworks that shape commercial, product, and trading strategy.
This role is responsible for transforming analytics from a reporting function into a true strategic
differentiator for BetMGM's Sports vertical.
The ideal candidate is a visionary analytical leader who combines deep technical mastery — including
machine learning, predictive modelling, and advanced experimentation — with the executive presence
and communication skills to influence at the highest levels of the organisation. They will champion a
culture of data-driven decision making, mentor and develop the broader analytics community, and
ensure that every insight generated drives measurable business value.
This is a highly cross-functional role requiring deep partnership with trading, product, operations,
finance, and compliance teams. The Principal Analyst will originate new analytical opportunities,
manage a portfolio of high-impact workstreams, and maintain trusted-adviser relationships with
executive stakeholders across the business.

• Develop and own the analytics strategy for Sports, ensuring full alignment with BetMGM's

corporate strategy and business goals, and driving all analytics workstreams to focus on business

value rather than reporting

• Define and govern the methodological standard for the Sports Analytics team, establishing best

practices for advanced modelling, statistical experimentation, measurement frameworks, and

analytical quality that scale across the broader Data team

• Lead the design and delivery of the team's most complex and high-impact analytical models,

including next-generation propensity and predictive models, advanced segmentation

frameworks, and sophisticated bonus and promotional evaluation models that quantify margin

and ROI performance

• Innovate with leading-edge analytical techniques — including machine learning, Bayesian

inference, causal modelling, survival analysis, and real-time streaming analytics — and oversee

the development of new analytical tools and frameworks that extend the team's capability

• Serve as the definitive organizational authority on sports wagering data structures, market logic,

and bet type classification, providing expert guidance that engineering, trading, compliance, and

product teams rely on for critical decisions

• Drive enterprise-wide data quality initiatives in close partnership with data engineering and

architecture teams, leading workstreams on cataloguing, metadata, lineage tracking, and

scalable ETL/ELT optimisation across the sports and wagering data estate

• Scale insights holistically across the organisation — ensuring that analytical outputs are not

siloed but operationalised across trading, product, finance, operations, and compliance — and

actively drive changes across teams and technology based on recommendations

• Establish and champion the company-wide approach to statistical experimentation and impact

measurement, advocating for advanced causal modelling and econometrics, and developing

advanced impact models to quantify the ROI of business initiatives

• Lead the analysis of strategic commercial priorities including high-value player economics,

revenue concentration, VIP retention sensitivity, and the incremental impact of promotional

mechanics and pricing changes

• Originate new analytical opportunities beyond the scope of existing projects, managing a

portfolio of workstreams with full executive stakeholder accountability — from statement of

work through to post-delivery relationship management

• Present findings and strategic recommendations to SLT and executive audiences with strong

presence and authority, translating the most complex quantitative work into compelling

commercial narratives that drive organisational decisions

• Act as the senior analytical adviser to commercial, product, trading, and finance leadership,

proactively shaping how data informs strategic decisions and advocating for analytics-led

change at the highest levels

• Lead and develop analysts across seniority levels, shaping the direction of the analytics team,

mentoring on advanced techniques, and driving transformational impact on the Data Analytics

community

• Take a portfolio approach to ongoing work across the Sports domain, maintaining trusted-

adviser relationships with executive stakeholders post-project completion and identifying future

opportunities

• Lead change management initiatives within the data department, overseeing the adoption of

new tools, methodologies, and processes, and ensuring continuous improvement and

adaptability across the analytics function

• Build and scale automation solutions and self-serve analytical capabilities that drive team

efficiency and democratise data access across the organisation


Qualifications


• 8+ years of commercial experience in analytics, data science, or business intelligence, with a

demonstrable track record of leading enterprise-scale, cross-functional analytical programmes

independently and with executive accountability

• Mastery of SQL, Python (or R), and data visualisation tools, with extensive experience building,

deploying, and operationalising production-quality analytical models at scale

• Proven track record of developing and executing analytics strategy aligned to business goals,

actively shaping the strategic direction of an analytics function and influencing organisational

decision-making at the executive level

• Demonstrated ability to lead and deliver a portfolio of complex, high-impact projects

simultaneously, managing timelines, stakeholder relationships, and scope across multiple

workstreams with minimal oversight

• Expert statistical foundation, including experimental design (A/B and multivariate), causal

inference methods (difference-in-differences, propensity score matching), regression modelling,

clustering, forecasting, and econometrics

• Proven experience designing and deploying advanced segmentation, propensity, predictive, and

causal models in a commercial environment, with a track record of these models driving

measurable business impact

• Demonstrated ability to operate as the most senior individual contributor in an analytics

function — setting the analytical agenda, defining best practices, influencing at the executive

level, and driving enterprise-wide decisions through insight

• Exceptional communication skills with strong executive presence, including the ability to present

complex quantitative work with clarity and authority to SLT audiences and to lead senior leader

discussions without support

• Deep expertise in advanced modelling techniques including machine learning (supervised and

unsupervised), Bayesian inference, survival analysis, and reinforcement learning applied to

customer or wagering data

• Broad and deep knowledge of major professional sports leagues, betting markets, US sports

wagering regulations, and the competitive iGaming landscape, with a track record of translating

this expertise into commercial advantage

• Demonstrated experience mentoring and developing analysts across multiple seniority levels,

shaping team capability, and driving transformational impact on the broader Data Analytics

community without a formal management remit

• Strong working knowledge of cloud-based data platforms (Snowflake, DBT) and experience

leading data quality, governance, and pipeline optimisation initiatives in partnership with data

engineering teams

• Prior experience in a regulated sports betting or iGaming environment is preferred

• Business standard use of the English language

Applicants must possess legal authorization to work for our company in the U.S. without the need for immigration sponsorship. At this time, this role is not eligible for immigration-related employment authorization sponsorship including H-1B, O-1, E-3, TN, OPT, etc.

141,500.00--188,700.00

BetMGM is revolutionizing sports betting and online gaming in the United States and Canada. We are a partnership between two powerhouse organizations—MGM Resorts International and Entain Group. Originating in 2015 as the doctoral research of CEO George Netscher—and inspired by his own family's experience with Alzheimer's disease—SafelyYou was spun out of UC Berkeley’s Artificial Intelligence Research Lab, one of the top five AI research groups in the world. And today, our company is solving critical challenges in senior living, from resident falls and ER visits to staffing concerns, length of stay, and NOI. All helping ensure that communities can focus on improved care for residents while still reaching their financial goals.

SafelyYou is one of five most innovative fall technologies referenced in the Senate Falls Report (2019), a winner of the McKnight’s Tech Partner of the Year, and has been named to Fortune’s Impact 20 list, which recognizes companies making people’s lives better through innovation.

Your Role at SafelyYou
Our product works; how we build hasn't kept up. Our product and technology teams own customer outcomes, built on shared platforms. As VP of Product, you lead the product management team and own the portfolio: one committed roadmap, where investment goes, and which bets get funded, changed, or stopped. The CPTO sets overall direction and the VP of Engineering owns delivery; you own product execution You'll inherit a capable team ready for a stronger operating model, and part of the job is deciding what to keep, rebuild, and stop. Operators are choosing their technology partners for the next decade, and you'll have a seat at the leadership table as we earn that choice. Every improvement you ship reaches residents, families, and caregivers. You'll work daily with the CPTO and VP of Engineering, and closely with Sales, Marketing, Customer Success, our clinical team, Operations, and Strategy.


Key Responsibilities:

The Numbers You'll Own

  • Customer NOI. Own SafelyYou's impact on operator NOI per resident, proven with outcome data in each care setting.

  • Wellness AI and staffing intelligence. Build both into scaled product lines alongside Safety AI.

  • Throughput. Double the rate of committed features launched to customers within the next year, measured by release to market and adoption, not tickets closed.

What You'll Own

  • One roadmap. A single customer-facing roadmap tied to company objectives. Sales sells what's committed.

  • The portfolio. Allocate investment across customer-facing teams, shared platforms (AI, data and integrations, devices, hardware), and longer-horizon bets, and make stage-gate calls on evidence.

  • The operating model.With the VP of Engineering, run annual strategy, quarterly planning, and published decision rights. Build the operations support PMs need to focus on outcomes.

  • The ecosystem. Drive partner adoption so SafelyYou insights reach caregivers inside the EHR and eCall systems they already use.

  • Trusted AI. Clear accuracy and false-alarm standards, privacy by design, and evidence before anything reaches the field.

  • The market. Be in the room with our largest operators, shape pricing and packaging with Sales and Marketing, and represent product at industry events and with investors.

  • The team. Coach, level, and hire product managers, and build a bench of future leaders.

The Ideal Candidate:

  • The hard requirement:you've led product managers through an operating-model change, such as functional teams to outcome and platform teams, on products that combine hardware, AI/ML, and cloud software.

  • 10+ years in product, including 5+ years leading PMs across multiple product areas.

  • AI/ML, hardware, and platform or partner-ecosystem products shipped to market, including stage-gated development, certification, and field reliability.

  • Enterprise B2B credibility. You've carried a product number, not just supported one.

  • A decisive player-coach and clear writer who earns engineering's respect.

  • Strongly preferred, and learnable:healthcare or senior living experience, and regulated products (HIPAA, life-safety).

Salary Range:$260,000 - $280,000 USD commensurate with experience

Why Join Us? You Can Make a Difference!

SafelyYou offers a competitive compensation package, including but not limited to:

  • A mission-driven company culture

  • Fully remote

  • Competitive salary & benefits, including fully paid employee premiums for Medical, Dental, and Vision

  • 401k Program

  • Monthly Education, Well-being & WFH stipends

  • Non-accrual PTO

  • Growth Potential

  • Company Retreats

  • Medical & Family/Parental Leave

At SafelyYou, we believe that a diverse, equitable, and inclusive workplace makes us a more relevant, competitive, and resilient company. We are committed to creating a diverse and inclusive workforce that celebrates diversity. We do not discriminate based on race, color, ancestry, religion, national origin, sexual orientation, age, citizenship, marital or family status, disability, gender identity or expression, veteran status, or any other legally protected status.

We value all the perspectives our team members bring to the table, and that is why we don’t look for culture fit, but culture add. We want to hear from YOU! We encourage you to apply even if you do not fit 100% of the technical requirements.

About LastPass
LastPass delivers Secure Access Essentials, helping individuals and organizations manage and protect access to AI, applications, and credentials straight from the browser. Trusted by more than 100,000 businesses and millions of users worldwide, LastPass blends strong security with everyday simplicity. From discovering unapproved AI and applications to reducing login friction and securing credentials across the business, LastPass delivers on its mission to give everyone seamless access to everything they need to work, move fast, and stay protected as their environments evolve.

Curious about our products? Visit our website and try it free!

We welcome new ideas, support your growth, and recognize your value, if this aligns with what you are looking for in your next career move, Join Us!

LastPass is looking for a Staff GTM Process Analyst:

In this role, you will own the systems behind our inbound and product-led growth. You will shape how demand is captured, scored, and routed, helping LastPass deliver on its mission to give everyone seamless access to everything they need to work, move fast, and stay protected.

About the team:

Marketing Operations is the connective tissue between Marketing, Sales, and Data at LastPass. Sitting at the intersection of systems, analytics, and execution, the team helps go-to-market groups uncover real strategic value. This role is the primary owner for our marketing technology stack and reports to the Director of RevOps Technology and Process.

If you are passionate about complex problem solving and motivated by scale, then this is the role for you!

Who will you work with?

You will partner with Demand Generation and Web on top-of-funnel capture and campaigns, and with Sales and Revenue Operations on lead handoff, routing, and funnel performance. You will also work with Data and Analytics on pipeline reporting and segmentation, and with IT, Business Systems, and vendors on integrations, permissions, and tool evaluation.

What are some of the exciting challenges you will be working on?

  • Own configuration, troubleshooting, and optimization of Marketo, including workflows, lifecycle automation, and event-based logic that supports inbound and product-led growth
  • Own lead and PQL scoring models and routing logic so the right leads reach the right sales teams quickly and accurately
  • Own core integrations between Marketo, Salesforce, and other GTM tools, ensuring data accuracy, field mapping, and sync health across web, product, form, and behavioral signals
  • Partner with Demand Generation and Web teams to capture and activate top-of-funnel signals, and build audiences, segmentation, and funnel experiments that improve conversion from first touch to sales-ready demand
  • Monitor inbound funnel and handoff metrics (conversion rates, speed to lead, response time, acceptance rates), name the root cause behind movements, and drive continuous improvement
  • Translate marketing, data, and privacy requirements into functional specifications and user stories, and lead initiatives end to end, from discovery and backlog management through UAT and go-live
  • Run fit-gap analysis on current-state processes, recommend scalable solutions, and balance run-the-business work with roadmap projects, including effort estimates, dependencies, and sequencing
  • Manage a large and evolving GTM technology stack, including tool setup, permissions, and vendor coordination, while testing automation and AI-powered approaches that reduce manual work and improve speed, accuracy, and scale

What does it take to work at LastPass?

  • Experience in Marketing Operations, Marketing Systems, or GTM Operations supporting inbound, demand generation, or PLG motions in a B2B SaaS environment
  • Hands-on expertise administering Marketo, including workflows, lifecycle stages, scoring, routing, campaign management, and Salesforce integration
  • Strong working knowledge of Salesforce CRM concepts and how data flows across GTM systems, with strong SQL skills for analysis, validation, and issue resolution
  • Ability to independently own techno-functional deliverables across requirements, design, testing, and deployment, including functional specs and user stories
  • Solid understanding of lifecycle marketing, audience segmentation, and marketing automation workflows, with a background in Business, Marketing, Computer Science, Engineering, or a related field, or equivalent experience
  • Viewed as a trusted advisor who translates business strategy into clear technical requirements for senior stakeholders
  • Curious and practical in applying AI and automation, with a track record of testing ways to improve process speed, accuracy, or scale
  • Highly organized and execution-focused, thriving in fast-moving, ambiguous environments while owning outcomes end to end

Our compensation reflects the cost of labor across several US geographic markets. Pay is based on several factors including market location and may vary depending on job-related knowledge, skills, and experience.

US Pay Range
$131,200—$147,000 USD

Why LastPass?

  • The leader in secure access
  • High-growth, collaborative environment with inclusive teams
  • Remote-first culture
  • Competitive compensation
  • Flexible Paid Time Off policies, including but not limited to: Quarterly Self-Care Days (4 extra paid days off annually) and Volunteer Days
  • Parental leave
  • Comprehensive health coverage, including dependents
  • Home office setup support
  • LastPass Families free account for up to 5 members
  • Continuous learning and development opportunities, including an annual learning stipend to invest in your growth
  • Peer-to-peer recognition through Quantum Workplace
  • Employee Assistance Program for well-being support
  • Remote work stipend to support your home office needs
  • Short-Term or Remote-Centric Work Arrangements for added flexibility

Unlock your potential with us - your skills, experience, and unique perspective matter more than just checking the boxes. Apply today, and let's build the future together!

We’re building an inclusive community that reflects the people of all races, genders, sexual orientations, national origins, backgrounds, and perspectives who share our world.

Job Title: Chief Transformation Officer (CTO)

Role Summary

The Chief Transformation Officer leads enterprise-wide transformation initiatives, driving large-scale change across strategy, operations, technology, and culture. This role is accountable for delivering measurable business outcomes through transformation programs, ensuring alignment with strategic objectives and sustainable value creation.

Key Responsibilities

1. Transformation Strategy & Execution

Define and execute enterprise transformation strategy aligned with business goals

Lead large-scale change programs (digital, operational, organizational)

Translate strategy into actionable transformation roadmaps and milestones

2. Program Leadership & Governance

Establish governance frameworks for transformation initiatives

Oversee program management, timelines, budgets, and delivery outcomes

Ensure cross-functional alignment and accountability

3. Operational Excellence & Process Optimization

Drive process reengineering, efficiency improvements, and cost optimization

Implement lean, Six Sigma, or continuous improvement methodologies

Enhance productivity and operational performance

4. Digital & Technology Transformation

Partner with CIO, CTO (Engineering), and CDO (Digital/Data) to enable transformation

Drive adoption of digital platforms, automation, and emerging technologies

Ensure integration of technology into business processes

5. Change Management & Culture

Lead organizational change management initiatives

Build a culture of agility, innovation, and continuous improvement

Manage stakeholder engagement and communication at all levels

6. Performance & Value Realization

Define KPIs and success metrics for transformation initiatives

Track and report ROI, benefits realization, and business impact

Ensure sustainability of transformation outcomes

7. Stakeholder & Executive Alignment

Work closely with CEO, Board, and executive leadership

Align transformation initiatives with corporate strategy

Influence decision-making and secure buy-in across the organization

Qualifications & Experience

Bachelor's degree in Business, Engineering, Technology, or related field (MBA preferred)

15–20+ years of experience in transformation, consulting, operations, or strategy roles

Proven track record of leading large-scale transformation programs

Experience in digital transformation, process optimization, and change management

Background in consulting (e.g., Big 4, strategy firms) is often preferred

Key Competencies

Strategic thinking and execution excellence

Strong program and change management skills

Data-driven decision-making

raw.description:
Department: Marketing

Reports To: Head of Growth

Employment Type: Full-Time

Location: Remote

Base Salary: $170,000–$190,000 + bonus

About Bask & Lather

Bask & Lather is a rapidly growing beauty and haircare company dedicated to helping consumers achieve healthier hair and feel confident in their natural beauty. Rooted in a scalp-first philosophy, product efficacy and authentic storytelling, we serve customers across DTC, Amazon, TikTok Shop and national retail. Our mission is to help customers grow it and keep it too.

About the Role

We are seeking a Director of Creative Performance to lead our paid acquisition creative function. You will turn customer insights and performance data into compelling ads, build a disciplined testing and learning process, and develop a reliable pipeline of creative that can sustain profitable spend.

Reporting to the Head of Growth, you will own creative strategy, briefs, production coordination, quality assurance, and creative performance analysis. This is a hands-on leadership role requiring analytical depth, creative judgment, and strong execution.

Key Responsibilities

  • Creative strategy and testing: Build a prioritized roadmap for Meta, TikTok, YouTube, and other active acquisition channels. Define customer audiences, objections, product benefits, hooks, formats, and hypotheses for each test.
  • Production and delivery: Translate strategy into clear briefs, scripts, demonstrations, and channel-specific assets. Manage the production calendar, feedback, approvals, and delivery against agreed deadlines.
  • Creative learning and iteration: Review results with Growth, identify why concepts perform, and turn findings into the next briefs. Expand winning concepts and diagnose weaker executions before deciding whether to revise or retire them.
  • Creators and partners: Manage performance creative agencies, UGC partners, freelancers, and production vendors. Improve quality, turnaround time, and cost efficiency while building dependable production capacity.
  • Team and resources: Lead assigned creative resources, establish clear ownership, and manage approved production budgets. Recommend staffing, partner, and capacity changes to the Head of Growth.

Cross Functional Collaboration

You will own the paid acquisition creative roadmap and production priorities within approved resources. Growth owns media budgets, campaign execution, and spend allocation; you will jointly define testing conditions, evaluate results, and recommend which concepts merit additional investment.

Partner with Brand and Design to uphold brand standards, and with Product Development and the appropriate reviewers to ensure product education and claims are accurate. Coordinate with Integrated Marketing, Ecommerce, and Retention around launches, offers, customer insights, and reusable assets. Organic social, brand campaigns, and lifecycle creative are partner functions with separately agreed priorities.

Creative Operations and Accountability

  • Maintain a searchable asset library with consistent naming, concept tagging, performance history, usage rights, and approval records.
  • Plan production capacity against the testing roadmap and budget. Flag delivery risks early, resolve bottlenecks, and maintain backup partners for critical needs.
  • Establish a consistent review process for product accuracy, demonstrations, brand alignment, platform specifications, and creator permissions before launch.
  • Use AI and workflow automation where they improve research, ideation, briefing, reporting, or production efficiency, with human review for accuracy and quality.
  • Run a weekly creative review covering results, lessons, fatigue, production status, budget, next tests, owners, and deadlines. Bring recommendations supported by evidence and clear hypotheses.

How Success Will Be Measured

During onboarding, you and the Head of Growth will establish baselines, consistent metric definitions, and numerical targets. The scorecard will track:

  • Creative effectiveness: The share of original concepts that meet agreed acquisition or profitability targets at a defined spend threshold, the spend sustained by winners, and their useful lifespan.
  • Testing and learning: Original concepts tested, meaningful hypotheses validated, and the speed at which learning becomes new creative. Track original concepts separately from asset variations.
  • Operating performance: Brief-to-launch time, on-time delivery, cost per tested concept, budget adherence, and production capacity against the approved roadmap.
  • Diagnostic metrics: Channel-appropriate hook and hold rates, CTR, conversion, CPA, ROAS, and fatigue indicators. Interpret these in the context of spend, audience, placement, attribution, and offer.

Acquisition and profitability outcomes are shared with Growth. Creative output volume alone will not define success.

Required Experience and Capabilities

  • 8+ years of relevant experience in performance creative, creative strategy, or growth marketing, including leadership of creative teams or external production partners.
  • A demonstrated record of developing ads that supported profitable acquisition for a consumer product brand. Beauty, personal care, or wellness experience is strongly preferred.
  • Deep working knowledge of Meta and TikTok creative, with experience adapting concepts for YouTube and other acquisition channels.
  • Strong analytical judgment and the ability to distinguish a creative insight from an attribution, media, audience, or offer issue.
  • Hands-on skill in briefing, scripting, product demonstrations, UGC, editing feedback, and translating customer objections into effective creative.
  • Experience managing production budgets, agencies, creators, timelines, and competing priorities. You set clear expectations, surface risks early, and follow through.

Portfolio and Results Standard

Be prepared to walk through examples showing the original hypothesis, your contribution, testing approach, spend supported, performance results, and subsequent iterations. We want to understand what you built, how you measured it, and what you learned. Share team and budget scope where possible, using anonymized information when needed.

Compensation and Benefits

Base salary of $170,000–$190,000, plus annual performance bonus tied to agreed role and organizational goals. Comprehensive benefits and paid time off.

Equal Employment Opportunity

Bask & Lather is an equal opportunity employer. We make employment decisions based on qualifications, merit, and business needs, without regard to race, color, religion, sex, pregnancy, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, national origin, age, disability, genetic information, military or veteran status, or any other characteristic protected by applicable law. We provide reasonable accommodations to qualified applicants and employees with disabilities and for other legally protected needs. Applicants who need an accommodation during the hiring process may request assistance from our recruiting team.

Salary: $170,000–$190,000 + bonus

ABOUT THE TEPA COMPANIES


Established in 2005 and owned by the Paskenta Band of Nomlaki Indians, The Tepa Companies deliver comprehensive and sustainable solutions to federal, state, local, and private-sector clients throughout the United States. The tribally owned companies work independently and collaboratively to provide wide-ranging construction, engineering, environmental, industrial, staffing, and technology services.


When you join Tepa Companies, you have the opportunity to expand your entrepreneurial skill set while growing professionally alongside the best in the industry. You will have the opportunity to impact your team, the organization as a whole, and subsequently, our Tribe.


We seek out top talent to provide the best services for our clients. We focus on being a responsible company for our employees and their families by creating a culture that reflects our core values and offering competitive pay and benefits package. Our benefits package includes comprehensive medical, dental, vision, generous paid time off and holidays, 401(k) plan with company match, life insurance, flexible spending and health savings account, mental health support and resources, short and long-term disability, and tuition reimbursement.

LOCATION: This is a remote and traveling position requiring frequent travel to different project sites in support of Tepa's Industrial Services Division.


ABOUT THE JOB

The Tepa Companies are seeking a General Superintendent to support Project Managers through scheduling of field management personnel and providing technical assistance and direction for the execution of complex project tasks. Supervises Federal project field management personnel. Carries out supervisory responsibilities in accordance with the organization's policies and applicable laws. Responsibilities include interviewing, hiring, and training employees; planning, assigning, and directing work; appraising performance; rewarding and disciplining employees; addressing complaints and resolving problems.


Job Functions:


  • Provide direct supervision of Project Field Managers
  • Coordinate and manage the orientation period for new field supervisors
  • Identify training requirements for individuals to foster continuous improvement within the company
  • Assess the talents of employees based on expectations for various roles. Identifies and facilitates the development of future managers
  • Focus on the phase specific development of employees though training and mentoring
  • Conduct effective employee evaluations by identifying individual contributions, improvement opportunities, setting goals and reinforcing company expectations Assist as Company liaison on the job site. Professionally interact with owners, consulting engineers, inspectors, and government agencies to ensure a quality product is produced according to specifications
  • Interact internally with peers, project management, safety, accounting, payroll, shipping, purchasing, and engineering to ensure a quality product is produced according to schedule and budget
  • Initiate, implement, delegate, and monitor projects involving construction methods and processes to improve the quality, productivity, and safety of the organization
  • Contribute to and support company’s strategic plan, goals and ideas communicating the core values of the company through leadership and example
  • Ensure safety policies, procedures, and applicable OSHA guidelines are properly followed
  • Assist with training employees in proper performance of tasks and use of personal protective equipment
  • Interact with Project Manager, safety and quality managers and field crews to ensure high quality work is produced in a safe, efficient manner
  • Enforce company expectations for all employees regarding safety, quality, attendance, attitude, effort, employee relations and responsibility for self and others
  • Oversee or assist on complex projects as needed
  • Ensure individuals are accountable for assigned tasks/projects through active involvement with Project Field Managers
  • Work to ensure that sufficient plans and preparation have been made to allow quality work to be completed in a safe and efficient manner
  • Interact with Site Superintendents and project management regarding shipping requirements
  • Inspect work in progress to ensure that workmanship conforms to drawings, specifications, Company standards, procedures, and quality expectations
  • Must be able to travel to and between project sites and other business locations, including overnight and out-of-town travel, as required to support projects and operational needs.

WHAT WE'RE LOOKING FOR

  • Bachelor’s degree in construction or engineering practice plus 4 years progressive site/project management experience or a High School diploma or GED plus 8 years progressive site/project management experience
  • 5 years in DoD fueling systems repair, maintenance, or construction
  • Experience and understanding of construction site quality control
  • Petroleum tank and piping construction and repair experience
  • Proficient with Microsoft Word and Excel computer programs
  • Ability to communicate effectively in English, verbally and in writing, as necessary to perform job responsibilities.
  • Excellent verbal and written communication skills
  • Ability to read and write technical documents
  • Ability to read technical drawings
  • Knowledge of American Society of Mechanical Engineering welding codes, American Petroleum Institute (API) 570/650/653 standards, and DoD Unified Facilities Guide Specifications and Unified Facilities Criteria requirements
  • Knowledge of OSHA and USACE EM 385-1-1 policies as they pertain to construction projects
  • Ability to tightly control and manage project schedules, scopes of work, contract changes, internal staff resources and subcontractors
  • Strong interpersonal, analytical thinking, and problem-solving skills
  • Ability to effectively prioritize and manage concurrent responsibilities to meet multiple project deadlines.
  • Must be able to pass a drug screen and background check in compliance with federal regulation
  • Must be able to pass a background check required to access US military installations



Equal Opportunity Employer/Veterans/Disabled

raw.title: Payroll Specialist
raw.excerpt: About UsAt Prenuvo, we are on a mission to flip the paradigm from reactive “sick-care” to proactive health care.
raw.description:
About Us

At Prenuvo, we are on a mission to flip the paradigm from reactive “sick-care” to proactive health care. Our award-winning whole body scan is fast (under 1 hour), safe (MRI has no ionizing radiation), and non-invasive (no contrast). Our unique integrated stack of optimized hardware, software, and increasingly AI, coupled with the patient-centric experience across our domestic and global clinics, have allowed us to lead the change against “we caught it too late again".

We are seeking a Payroll Specialist to support payroll, benefits, and retirement operations for our U.S. and Canadian employees. Working closely with the Senior Payroll Specialist and benefits team, you will manage assigned payroll activities, resolve routine discrepancies, and escalate complex issues for guidance.

This role does not provide visa sponsorship. Applicants must be legally authorized to work in the United States at the time of hire and must not require employer sponsorship for a work visa (current or future).

This position requires working Pacific Time business hours year-round, observing PST/PDT, regardless of your location.

Help reshape the world through proactive healthcare while working with cutting-edge technology and high performing teams with deep expertise - join us to make a difference in people’s lives!

What You'll Do

Payroll execution

  • Process assigned biweekly and semimonthly payrolls for salaried and hourly employees across multiple U.S. states, Canadian provinces, and legal entities.
  • Validate timecards, overtime, bonuses, commissions, employee changes, and deductions; calculate retroactive adjustments, off-cycle payments, and final pay.
  • Reconcile payroll registers and prepare funding requests and supporting records for review and approval.
  • Prepare Canadian Records of Employment and assist with year-end reporting, including W-2 and T4 reviews.
  • Provide backup coverage for other payroll team members payroll as needed.

Compliance and employee support

  • Review assigned payroll notices, track deadlines, and gather information for timely responses.
  • Follow established payroll requirements and internal controls, escalating complex tax, wage, and compliance questions.
  • Maintain accurate records and procedures, and recommend improvements when recurring issues arise.
  • Respond clearly and promptly to employee questions about pay, deductions, and leave payments.

Benefits administration and leave pay

  • Calculate salary continuation and employer top-ups coordinated with U.S. state leave programs, disability benefits, and Canadian Employment Insurance.
  • Confirm approved leave dates, benefit amounts, payment offsets, and return-to-work changes with the benefits team.
  • Support U.S. and Canadian benefits administration through eligibility reviews, enrollment updates, and deduction maintenance.
  • Reconcile benefits deductions and carrier invoices, coordinating resolution with the benefits team and providers.

Retirement plan funding and audit support

  • Prepare 401(k) contribution files, reconcile employee deductions and applicable employer contributions, and coordinate funding with Finance and the plan provider.
  • Verify deposits and promptly escalate missing, rejected, or incorrect contributions.
  • Compile participant data, payroll records, and reconciliations for the annual 401(k) plan audit.
  • Assist with contribution limit reviews, corrections, and annual testing under leadership guidance.

What You’ll Bring

  • Typically 3–5 years of hands-on payroll experience, including multistate U.S. and multiprovince Canadian payroll for salaried and hourly employees.
  • Knowledge of U.S. state paid family and medical leave and disability programs, with direct experience calculating related payments and coordinating employer top-ups.
  • Knowledge of Canadian employee benefits, including health, dental, life, and disability coverage, eligibility requirements, and payroll deductions.
  • Experience with 401(k) including: contribution files, funding coordination, deposit verification, and reconciliation, annual 401(k) plan audit through record preparation and information requests.
  • Working knowledge of payroll fundamentals, including overtime, taxable earnings, statutory deductions, and year-end reporting.
  • Strong Excel skills, including lookups, pivot tables, and data reconciliation.
  • Excellent attention to detail, organization, and judgment, with the ability to meet deadlines and recognize when additional review is needed.
  • Clear communication skills and discretion when handling confidential information.
  • Experience with Rippling payroll, time and attendance, and reporting is preferred.
  • Experience supporting multiple entities or clinic locations is preferred.
  • Familiarity with Canadian Records of Employment and retirement plan deductions is an asset.
  • A payroll certification, such as FPC, CPP, or the Canadian Payroll Compliance Professional designation is an asset.
  • Pride in excelling at your craft, excellent attention to detail, a drive to be a problem solver and adaptability.

Our Values

First: we are Pioneers

  • Transforming healthcare requires divergent thinking, bias for action, disciplined experimentation, and consistent grit and determination to maintain momentum. This journey is as challenging as it is rewarding.

Second: we are Platform-Builders

  • We’re always building foundations that allow us to achieve tomorrow more than we did today. We never lose sight of what’s ahead – in a mindset of ownership and duty to our mission.

Above all: we are Patients

  • We could all be the next person who walks through our very doors, seeking clarity or peace of mind. We are proud of our impact on our patients’ lives, and we won’t stop till everyone can benefit from our work.

What We Offer

  • An avenue to make a positive impact on people's lives and their health
  • We believe in preventative healthcare for everyone, including our team - Prenuvo provides free, whole-body scans to each team member
  • Growth opportunities are at the heart of our people journey, we’re doing big things with bright minds - there is no single path to success, it can be shaped along the way
  • Building strong relationships is at the core of everything we do - our team gets together each week to connect, share, and socialize
  • Recognizing time away to restore is vital to our wellbeing - we have a flexible vacation policy and we will encourage you to use it

Stripe is a financial infrastructure platform for businesses. Millions of companies - from the world’s largest enterprises to the most ambitious startups - use Stripe to accept payments, grow their revenue, and accelerate new business opportunities. The administrative business partner (ABP) team works with Stripe's executive leaders to strategically manage their day-to-day administrative and operational needs, while also contributing significantly to projects and initiatives that help drive the company's strategic priorities
