raw.description:
Job Description

NANA Management Services is seeking a Remote Security Officer to support Maniilaq Housing in Kotzebue, Alaska. This position is responsible for remotely monitoring housing properties, coordinating responses to incidents with on-site staff and emergency services, and maintaining detailed records of all security activities.

The ideal candidate will have security or law enforcement experience, strong communication skills, cultural awareness, and an understanding of rural Alaska communities. This role plays a vital part in protecting residents, preserving property, and supporting the overall safety and well-being of the Kotzebue community from a remote operations setting.

Responsibilities

  • Monitor and patrol assigned buildings, grounds, and areas, either visually or electronically.
  • Control access to the property, allowing entry only to properly authorized individuals.
  • Inspect premises, including doors, windows, and gates, to ensure they are secure.
  • Document and report incidents such as property damage, safety hazards, or unusual occurrences.
  • Warn violators of rule infractions and, when necessary, escort them from the property.
  • Notify on-site staff when visitors or service providers arrive.
  • Assist in responding to emergencies or disasters to protect life, property, and community safety.
  • Check the heating, lighting, sprinklers, ventilation, and fire safety systems to ensure proper function.
  • Provide transportation services using a variety of vehicles, including passenger cars, and passenger vans.
  • Administer emergency medical aid, including CPR, AED use, and safe patient movement.
  • Reporting any safety or sanitation concerns to a supervisor promptly.
  • Perform other duties as assigned to support the department’s and community’s success.

Qualifications

  • High school diploma or GED equivalent.
  • Valid driver’s license with an acceptable driving record for the past three (3) years (per NMS vehicle insurance policy).
  • Ability to obtain an Alaska Guard License (fee of $97.00, paid by applicant) prior to employment.
  • Basic computer skills, including Microsoft Office and contract-specific software.
  • Must pass all pre-employment contract requirements, which may include:
    • Hair follicle drug test
    • Physical and fit-for-duty assessment
    • Hearing test
    • Applicants not located near a testing facility are responsible for travel expenses to the nearest facility.
  • Ability to work respectfully and effectively in a multicultural environment, with an understanding of Alaska Native cultures and rural community life.
  • Ability to make sound decisions in real time with minimal supervision.
  • Ability to stand and be on your feet for 12 hours per shift, according to the scheduled rotation.
  • Contract requires the ability to speak, read, write, and understand English.
  • Must meet and adhere to all safety guidelines and regulations set by the company and client.

CANDIDATES RESIDING OUTSIDE ANCHORAGE AREA:

Candidates residing in the Lower 48 for any contract: For the purposes of pre-employment testing, Anchorage will be considered the point of hire (with the exception of drug testing, which will be conducted near the candidate’s place of residence). Employee is responsible for any travel expenses and needed accommodations related to pre−employment tasks that need to be completed in Anchorage, AK. This includes, but is not limited to, any safety training requirements, required pre−employment testing and/or training such as physical, DOT physical/medical card, fit for duty, audiogram, and/or other testing required by contract/company (such as NSTC, APICC training, security licensing requirements, etc.

Candidates residing in Alaska for Alyeska and Hillcorp contracts: pre-employment testing will be scheduled near the candidate’s area of residence within the state. The only exception is when the candidate lives in a region without the necessary service providers to complete all requirements.

Flights to Remote Locations: All employees are responsible for all expenses related to reporting to point of hire (Anchorage, AK) for scheduled trips paid for by the company for remote locations.

Working Conditions and Physical Requirements

Weather: Indoors and outdoors, frequently exposed to arctic weather conditions.

Noise level: Moderate.

Description of environment: Environment will vary based on the facility assigned to.

Physical requirements: Employee is required to lift and/or move up to 50 lbs. Frequently to constantly required to sit, stand, walk, use hands/fingers to handle or feel, climb, stoop, kneel, crouch or crawl, talk/hear, see, taste/smell, and carry weight/lift.

Fit For Duty Test Fit For Duty light requirement

  • Lift: Lift 20 lbs. from floor to knuckle x 2,
  • Lift: Lift 20 lbs. from floor to waist x 2,
  • Carry: Carry 20 lbs. with two hands for a minimum distance of 20 feet, self-paced but continuous,
  • Kneel: Kneel on one knee and stand. Return to kneel on opposite knee. Repeat alternate kneeling sequence x 3 for each knee, self-paced but continuous,
  • Stand from Supine Position Test: From a supine, recumbent position, while wearing arctic gear, test recipient must be able to stand without assistance x 3, self-paced (this task must be accomplished safely without significant loss of balance or falling and without assistance). Allow one re-test when there is a loss of balance considered unsafe or a fall.)
  • Stoop & Twist: Perform alternate cross over toe touches x 5 each side, self-paced but continuous,
  • Walk: Walk on a treadmill at 3 MPH for 10 minutes with good balance
  • Stairs: Climb up and down 10 steps x 2 for a total of 20 steps, self-paced.

Competencies

  • Customer Service – Provides outstanding customer service; manages difficult or emotional situations; responds promptly to customer needs; responds to requests for service and assistance; meets commitments in a timely manner.
  • Interpersonal Skills – Focuses on solving conflict; maintains confidentiality; listens to others without interrupting; keeps emotions under control; remains open to other ideas.
  • Oral Communication – Speaks clearly and persuasively in positive or negative situations; listens and gets clarification; responds well to questions; demonstrates group presentation skills; participates in meetings.
  • Written Communication – Writes incidents, logs and other reports clearly; able to read and interpret written information.

Syneos Health® is a leading fully integrated biopharmaceutical solutions organization built to accelerate customer success. We translate unique clinical, medical affairs and commercial insights into outcomes to address modern market realities.

Every day we perform better because of how we work together, as one team, each the best at what we do. We bring a wide range of talented experts together across a wide range of business-critical services that support our business. Every role within Corporate is vital to furthering our vision of Shortening the Distance from Lab to Life®.

Discover what our 29,000 employees, across 110 countries already know.

WORK HERE MATTERS EVERYWHERE

Why Syneos Health

  • We are passionate about developing our people, through career development and progression; supportive and engaged line management; technical and therapeutic area training; peer recognition and total rewards program.
  • We are committed to our Total Self culture – where you can authentically be yourself. Our Total Self culture is what unites us globally, and we are dedicated to taking care of our people.
  • We are continuously building the company we all want to work for and our customers want to work with. Why? Because when we bring together diversity of thoughts, backgrounds, cultures, and perspectives – we’re able to create a place where everyone feels like they belong.

Job Responsibilities

The role could be remote based from the following locations: Canada, US, UK, Serbia


This Sponsor dedicated role will involve partnering closely with Clinical Scientist and will be focused on Protocols and Protocol Amendments.


  • Leads the clear and accurate completion of medical writing deliverables, ensuring scientific information is presented clearly and accurately. Manages medical writing activities associated with individual studies, coordinating medical writing activities within and across departments with minimal supervision. Leads the resolution of comments from the client.
  • Completes a variety of documents that may include clinical study protocols and clinical study protocol amendments; clinical study reports; patient narratives; annual reports; investigator brochures; informed consents; annual reports; plain language summaries; periodic safety update reports, clinical development plans; IND submissions; integrated summary reports; NDA and eCTD submissions; journal manuscripts; and abstracts, posters, and presentations for scientific meetings.
  • Adheres to established regulatory standards, including, but not limited to, ICH E3 guidelines, as well as company standard operating procedures, client standards, and company and/or client approved-templates, authorship requirements, and style and formatting guides, when completing medical writing projects, on time and on budget.
  • Coordinates quality and editorial reviews. Ensures source documentation is managed appropriately. Leads team document reviews, and reviews documents as needed.
  • Acts as peer reviewer for internal team to ensure document scientific content, clarity, overall consistency, and proper format.
  • Reviews statistical analysis plans and table/figure/listing specifications for appropriate content, and for grammar, format, and consistency. Provides feedback to further define statistical output required and document needs.
  • Interacts and builds good working relations with clients, department head, and peers in data management, biostatistics, regulatory affairs, and medical affairs, as necessary, to produce writing deliverables.
  • Performs online clinical literature searches and complies with copyright requirements.
  • Identifies and proposes solutions to resolve issues, escalating as appropriate. Provides technical support, training, and consultation to department and other company staff. May contribute to development of internal materials and presentations or changes to internal process, standard practices, and capabilities.
  • Mentors and leads less experienced medical writers on complex projects, as necessary.
  • Develops deep expertise on key topics in the industry and the regulatory requirements and guidelines that affect medical writing.
  • Aware of budget specifications for assigned projects, working within the budgeted hours and communicating status and changes to medical writing leadership.
  • Completes required administrative tasks within the specified timeframes.
  • Performs other work-related duties as assigned.
  • Minimal travel may be required (less than 25%).

Qualifications:

  • 3-5 years of relevant experience in medical writing, with proven experience in Protocol writing
  • Experience working in the biopharmaceutical, device, or contract research organization industry required.
  • Experience with late development
  • Experience with Oncology/Hematology/Cell therapy.
  • Strong understanding of FDA and ICH regulations, other regulatory guidelines, and/or good publication practices strongly required.
  • Experience writing relevant document types required.
  • Experience in working with Veeva/CARA.
  • Extensive knowledge of English grammar and ability to communicate clearly; strong familiarity with AMA Manual of Style.

We are always excited to connect with great talent. This posting is intended for a [possible] upcoming opportunity rather than a live role. By expressing your interest, you'll be added to our talent pipeline and considered should this role become available.

Get to know Syneos Health

Over the past 5 years, we have worked with 94% of all Novel FDA Approved Drugs, 95% of EMA Authorized Products and over 200 Studies across 73,000 Sites and 675,000+ Trial patients.

No matter what your role is, you’ll take the initiative and challenge the status quo with us in a highly competitive and ever-changing environment. Learn more about Syneos Health.

raw.description:
Company Description

Zayo provides mission-critical bandwidth to the world’s most impactful companies, fueling the innovations that are transforming our society. Zayo’s 141,000-mile network in North America and Europe includes extensive metro connectivity to thousands of buildings and data centers. Zayo’s communications infrastructure solutions include dark fiber, private data networks, wavelengths, Ethernet, and dedicated Internet access. Zayo serves wireless and wireline carriers, media, tech, content, finance, healthcare and other large enterprises.

Zayo is seeking a Fiber Engineer to be responsible for the solution and design of physical fiber paths across the Zayo network in support of providing fiber-based services. Projects may encompass high volume large projects including Small Cell (hub and spoke) and various ring designs, fiber inventory management, Greenfield builds, technical splicing solutions, network relocations, and capacity augments/grooms. The Fiber Engineer works with large data sets and formal project planning over a long-term period of months, or years. Manages the inventory of the Zayo fiber network through database tracking of fiber enclosures, fiber optic cable, conduit, building data, and more. The Fiber Engineer will report to the Fiber Engineering Manager, with regular interaction from the Outside Plant Team, Network Inventory Specialists, Sales Engineering, and other Network Engineers.


Location Preference: Ideal candidates will be located in the western U.S.


Work Authorization Requirement: Applicants must be currently authorized to work in the United States on a full-time basis. This position is not eligible for employer-sponsored work authorization, such as OPT, TN, H1B or any other type of work visa, now or in the future.

Responsibilities:

  • Design routes for fiber-based services including Point to point, Ring, and path diverse routing.
  • Research existing databases, files, and records for purposes of network design, fiber optimization, and relocation of fiber facilities.
  • Delivers design solutions of fiber path and complicated splicing schematics to be performed for high volume fiber projects.
  • Ensures fiber plant database is current and accurate by inputting physical fiber asset data as well as fiber inventory and circuit assignments into the data management system, specifically OSPI, Network Manager Telecom, NetCracker, QGIS and Salesforce.
  • Ensures inventory of fiber utilization is accurate by maintaining inventory management database and maintaining both internal and external customer information as changes occur.
  • Assigns cable names, splice ID’s, and manages our Splice Activity & Order processes in alignment with our company and database standards.
  • Oversee and train A&E's to design and create the necessary Splicing Packages (FEP) and DLR's as well as receiving Splicing As-Builts and updating our records
  • Interface between various engineers and Zayo stakeholders as needed to validate project specifications, network growth, and delivery timelines.
  • Establishes and maintains effective communications and professional working relationships with customers both internal and external.
  • Organizes workday efficiently to maximize productivity by utilizing proper time management techniques.
  • Assists in the accomplishment of company objectives by performing other related duties as assigned.
  • Responsible for all emergency and trouble response by participating in an On-Call Rotation.

Qualifications:

  • Four-year college Degree in Engineering or equivalent Telecom Network Experience required.
  • Minimum of three (3) years fiber design experience that includes ring configurations, FTT projects, and various high volume site deliveries required.
  • Well qualified candidate will have proven aptitude to prioritize tasks and timelines while cross functioning in a fast-paced environment independently.
  • Proficiency in the MS Office suite of tools, in particular MS Visio and Excel. Knowledge of Salesforce.com platform is a plus.
  • Must have prior experience in telecom and fiber plant install.
  • Knowledge of GIS-based platforms and fiber inventory systems. QGIS experience preferred.
  • Must have Google Earth experience - understands how to produce a professional and detailed KMZ file and can interpret outside plant construction KMZ's.
  • Ability to correspond effectively with a variety of functional teams and strong interpersonal skills for supporting cross functional teams.
  • Proficient analytical, organizational, and time management skills, including the ability to effectively multi-task assignments.
  • Well qualified candidates will possess a work ethic that includes extreme attention to detail and strong organizational skills; including project management, effective communication skills while handling high volume projects, and proven ability to execute in fast-paced environments.
  • Successful candidates have ability to work quickly and efficiently without sacrificing data quality.

Estimated base salary range: $68,100 - $104,700 USD/annually.

The base pay range shown is a guideline and reasonable estimate for this role. It takes into account the wide variety of factors that are considered in making compensation decisions. Actual compensation offered may vary from the posted range based upon geographic location, work experience, skill level, certifications, and other business and organizational needs. Non- sales roles may be eligible to participate in a discretionary annual incentive plan. Sales roles may be eligible to participate in a sales incentive plan.


Additionally, this position may be eligible for certain benefits, such as health insurance, life insurance, disability retirement plans, paid time off.


The posting will be active for a minimum of 3 days. The active posting will continue to extend by 3 days until the position is filled.


Benefits, Rewards & Wellness

  • Excellent Health, Dental & Vision Insurance
  • Retirement 401(k) Savings Plan
  • Generous paid time off policy including paid parental leave

Zayo is an equal opportunity employer to all protected groups, including protected veterans and individuals with disabilities. If you are an individual with a disability and would like to request a reasonable accommodation as part of the employment selection process, please contact us.

raw.title: Head of Revenue Operations
raw.excerpt: Steer offers a suite of software tools for today's automotive repair shop.
raw.description:
Steer offers a suite of software tools for today's automotive repair shop. We combine a mix of software tools that a repair shop needs to run a highly profitable shop, in one user-friendly, cost-effective platform. Through the Steer suite, we allow the shop owner to get back to focusing on what matters, and to stop worrying about marketing and customer retention.

Steer began as an online directory for drivers to find a local mechanic. Fast forward to today, Steer has launched a complete Customer Relationship Management (CRM) marketing suite, complete with text messaging, email automation, direct mail integration, reputation management, appointment reminders, declined/recommended services, and many other features. We are always innovating and we are proud to be a leader in the automotive repair industry. In August 2024 Steer acquired AutoOps - the leader in modern, intelligent, and fully integrated scheduling software for auto repair shops. AutoOps allows customers to smoothly schedule through a shop's website and Google Business Profile.

About the Role

As Head of Revenue Operations, you will build, optimize, and scale the operational, data, and technology foundation across our entire go-to-market organization—including Sales, Marketing, Customer Success, Finance, and Partnerships. Reporting directly to executive leadership, your mission is to transform our systems, billing infrastructure, reporting, and GTM strategy into a clear, high-performing growth engine.

You will lead a small but high-impact RevOps team (2 direct reports) while personally owning the architecture and execution of our RevTech stack (including HubSpot and Chargebee), lead management, funnel optimization, enablement and ramp, and AI deployment. This is not a traditional admin role—we are looking for a builder, strategic systems architect, and AI-forward operator who rationalizes existing tools before adding new ones, replaces manual reporting with automated signal, and shortens new-hire time-to-productivity as a core business metric.

This role is 100% remote and available to US-based candidates.

You Are

  • An Operational Builder & AI-Forward Architect: Highly organized and system-minded, you thrive on taking complex, disconnected processes and building simple, scalable workflows. You actively identify, test, and deploy AI tools and automated knowledge systems to eliminate manual work and boost team productivity.
  • A Strategic Systems Thinker: You look beyond basic CRM administration to understand broader business goals, connecting executive priorities to billing infrastructure, tech stack rationalization, and RevOps strategy.
  • A Hands-On Problem Solver: You balance executive strategy with technical execution—equally comfortable presenting to leadership or personally building automations, forecasting models, and CRM workflows.
  • A Growth & Ramp Driver: You view new-hire time-to-productivity as a business metric, using automated measurement, early success signals, and modern systems to ramp revenue teams faster.
  • A Collaborative Leader: You manage, mentor, and elevate a team of RevOps professionals while bridging the gap between technical data systems and business leadership to align GTM operations.

You Will

  • Own Revenue Systems, Billing Infrastructure & AI Innovation: Lead full ownership and architecture of core revenue systems (HubSpot, Chargebee, and broader RevTech). Continuously inspect, consolidate, and optimize current platforms before evaluating new spend. Build advanced automation workflows across Marketing, Sales, CS, Finance, and Partnerships, and deploy AI tools (such as living AI knowledge bases/Claude skills libraries) to streamline operations.
  • Drive Enablement, Ramp & Team Productivity: Own new-hire ramp time with a clear, measurable path to reduction. Design onboarding, coaching, and exception-based reporting workflows that run through systems rather than headcount. Partner with Sales leadership on structural changes (comp design, team placement) that raise pipeline productivity per rep.
  • Optimize Funnel Performance & Revenue Intelligence: Diagnose pipeline leaks and conversion bottlenecks across all channels. Build executive dashboards, forecasting models, and predictive analytics to improve speed-to-lead, decision-maker contact rates, expansion efficiency, and retention outcomes. Ground all recommendations in data first.
  • Lead Data Strategy & Governance: Define how data is captured, structured, and managed across the customer lifecycle, improving CRM hygiene, billing accuracy, reporting integrity, and system interoperability.
  • Manage & Develop the RevOps Team: Lead, hire, and mentor 2 direct reports. Build a culture of innovation, systems thinking, accountability, and technical excellence, raising team competency across AI, automation, and systems architecture.
  • Partner Cross-Functionally: Collaborate closely with Sales, Marketing, CS, Finance, Product, and Executive Leadership to support product-led growth (PLG) motions, upgrade paths, monetization strategies, and long-term GTM infrastructure.

You Have

Must Have

  • RevOps Leadership Experience: 5–8+ years of experience in Revenue Operations, Sales Operations, GTM Systems, or Revenue Enablement, with proven experience leading teams or major strategic initiatives.
  • Systems & Tech Stack Mastery: Deep expertise configuring and managing HubSpot, along with strong experience in billing/subscription management platforms (Chargebee or similar) and operational architecture.
  • AI & Automation Curiosity: Hands-on track record implementing modern automation tools and proactive experience deploying AI solutions (including AI-powered knowledge or enablement systems).
  • Enablement & Ramp Ownership: Experience owning, measuring, or influencing new-hire ramp time and onboarding outcomes as core operational metrics.
  • Data & Analytics Proficiency: Strong analytical background with direct experience querying raw data, building forecasting models, and designing board-level/executive dashboards (SQL, BI tools, or advanced analytics platforms).
  • Stack Rationalization Skills: Proven track record evaluating, consolidating, or replacing major GTM and business software platforms.

Nice to Have

  • Billing Operations: Direct experience with Chargebee, subscription management, and revenue recognition workflows.
  • Product-Led Growth (PLG): Experience supporting PLG motions, automated upgrade paths, and expansion loops.
  • Early-Stage / High-Growth Scaling: Experience scaling a RevOps function in a fast-growing SaaS tech company.
  • Multi-Segment GTM: Background supporting multi-segment environments (SMB, Mid-Market, and Enterprise).
  • Marketing Attribution & Demand Gen: Deep understanding of marketing attribution models and demand generation tech stacks.

Interview Process

  • Initial Screen: 30 min with the Lead Recruiter
  • Hiring Manager Interview: 45 min with the CRO
  • Problem Solving Interview & Executive interview : 60 min with the Director of People & 45 min with the CEO
  • Case Study Presentation: 60 min with the CRO & CFO

We Offer

  • 100% remote work environment
  • Medical, Dental, and Vision insurance within 30 days (100% employer-paid medical)
  • Equity package
  • Flexible PTO with a 15-day minimum
  • Generous Parental Leave
  • FSA and HSA options
  • 401(k)
  • Growth & Wellness Stipend
  • WFH Equipment stipend
  • Chance to work with the latest technology and AI tools
  • A collaborative, high-ownership culture with clear opportunities for career growth

Why Join Steer?At Steer, we align our mission of transforming the auto repair experience for shop owners and their customers with your passion for growth, innovation, and excellence.

Here, you’ll find opportunities to expand your skills, take on career-shaping challenges, and contribute to the future of the auto repair industry, all while enjoying comprehensive benefits and flexible work arrangements to support your well-being.

Join Steer to be part of a forward-thinking, flexible, and collaborative culture where you are empowered to do meaningful and impactful work.

We value diversity and believe that forming teams in which everyone can be their authentic self is key to our success. We welcome applications from those with diverse backgrounds and industries.

Our hiring process looks beyond just credentials. The school you went to at 18 doesn't define your potential to thrive and enrich our culture. Even if you don't meet every requirement, we invite you to apply.

raw.excerpt: Where Human Connection Fuels Possibility ​At Maritz, decades of innovation and perseverance have built more than just a strong reputation — they’ve shaped a culture where human connection and collaboration are at the heart of everything we do.
raw.description:
Where Human Connection Fuels Possibility ​

At Maritz, decades of innovation and perseverance have built more than just a strong reputation — they’ve shaped a culture where human connection and collaboration are at the heart of everything we do. ​

Joining Maritz means becoming part of a workplace grounded in a critical truth; people and their potential is our greatest resource.

​

Maritz helps companies achieve their business goals by inspiring people to perform their best. We design experiences, incentives, and recognition programs that spark action and deliver measurable impact.​

And we’ve brought this human-first design inward – intentionally building teams that care for each other and collaborate powerfully. In our most recent employee survey, nearly 90% of respondents said that their managers care about their concerns and 82% said they feel genuinely appreciated. We know that when employees feel seen, supported, and celebrated for who they are, they thrive and so does our business. ​

That’s why we’ve created a flexible, environment that empowers you to do your best work without sacrificing what matters most to you. In fact, in that same survey, nearly 90% of respondents said they have the flexibility they need to balance work and personal life and nearly 80% said Maritz does a great job prioritizing employee well being.​

We have a passion for excellence and genuine care for the people making it possible.

The Creative Presale Manager role combines strategy, creativity, content development and project leadership. The Creative Presale Manager (CPM) helps transform sales opportunities into compelling presentation experiences by connecting client insights, Maritz strategy, SME expertise and messaging into one cohesive story.

In addition to working with cross-functional teams in presentation development, CPMs also support Growth Marketing and internal company initiatives that support Maritz Business Event Solutions growth and culture.

What You'll Be Doing

80% PRESALE MESSAGING STRATEGY & PROJECT MANAGEMENT:

  • Works with a team of subject matter experts to identify a dynamic agenda flow and write/edit standout messaging for presentation-stage responses that bring Maritz services and value center stage, including our experience design methodology.
  • Conduct research from the proposal stage and come ready to ask thoughtful questions, listen for what matters most and translate those insights into sharp themes and storylines that help win new client business.
  • Serve as the bridge between what we want to say and how we bring it to life. Partner closely with our Marketing Designer team to support the creative vision for the presentation response.
  • Dream up unexpected presentation elements that create moments of distinction and leave a lasting impression.
  • Act as a catalyst to produce new ways to tell the Maritz brand story. Schedule and lead team calls, manage timelines and deliverables and ensure presentation assets are organized and easily accessible electronically.
  • Coordinate multimedia, presentation materials and final delivery details, keeping the team connected and on track through presentation execution and post-delivery debrief.

20% MARKETING SUPPORT:

  • Shape sales enablement around the value of our products, services and solutions across the Corporate and Association, Tradeshow & Live Event (AT&L) markets by researching and writing content for design.
  • Create stories, messaging and supporting assets that build internal understanding and help sales teams confidently communicate our capabilities to clients.
  • Develop and evolve case studies, product overviews, email campaigns and capabilities presentations while partnering with Marketing Designers to maintain a unified suite of internal and external marketing materials. Keep our capabilities content current and ready to support both new business pursuits and expansion opportunities.

You'll Thrive If You Are


  • Confident: You’re comfortable taking the lead, facilitating cross-functional teams and driving clarity and alignment. You know how to keep conversations productive and teams moving forward.
  • A proactive problem solver: You anticipate what’s needed, identify potential gaps and aren’t afraid to recommend a different approach when it could make the work stronger.
  • Highly organized and accountable: You naturally bring structure to complex, fast-moving projects. You keep priorities, timelines, people and deliverables aligned while making sure important details don’t fall through the cracks.
  • Adaptable and collaborative: You thrive in a fast-moving environment, shift priorities when needed and build strong partnerships across teams.
  • Strategic storyteller: You bring Maritz services to life and connect what we do to what matters most to the client. You think beyond the words to the creative strategy behind them.
  • Curious and open-minded: You welcome new ideas, tools and perspectives and enjoy finding better ways to solve challenges.

What You'll Bring


  • Minimum of bachelor’s degree or equivalent related experience required.
  • 7 plus years of experience in related professional field required. Experience in a project management role dealing with services is preferred; or similar Maritz experience.
  • Strong understanding of Maritz Business Events Solutions products, services, operations and overall approach to business preferred.
  • Excellent organizational and project management skills with an ability to work, at times, under short deadlines.
  • Professional written and oral communications skills with proven ability to present strategic recommendations.
  • Proficient in Microsoft Office Suite.

DISCLAIMER: This job description is designed to indicate the general nature and level of work performed by associates within this classification. It is not designed to confirm or be interpreted as a comprehensive summary of all duties, responsibilities and qualifications required of associates assigned to this job.

raw.description:
Lumen is the trusted network for the AI‑powered world, connecting people, data, and applications through our expansive fiber network and connected ecosystem. We enable secure, high‑performance connectivity across cloud, edge, and AI workloads for enterprises, governments, and communities.

At Lumen, you’ll work on infrastructure customers rely on today and build for what’s next, where performance, security, and resilience matter.

This is a high accountability environment where bold ideas drive real innovation for our customers, partners, and industry. The work is challenging, expectations are clear, and trust is built into how we operate. If you’re ready to take ownership, deliver meaningful impact, and help shape the future of AI‑ready connectivity, join us today.

The Role

The Senior Lead Marketing Data Platform Architect is responsible for defining, governing, and evolving Lumen's marketing data platform architecture. This role provides technical leadership for the design and implementation of scalable data products, modern analytics capabilities, AI-ready data structures, and agentic operational frameworks that support the organization's marketing strategy.

As the lead architect for the marketing data ecosystem, this individual will establish the long-term platform vision, define architectural standards, and guide modernization initiatives that enable advanced analytics, personalization, audience activation, measurement, and AI-driven decision-making. The role requires close partnership with engineering, analytics, Adobe, Salesforce, and business stakeholders to ensure the platform remains scalable, governed, secure, and aligned with evolving business needs.

This position is ideal for a forward-thinking architect who is passionate about building AI-native data platforms, enabling intelligent automation, and creating modern data foundations capable of supporting both current and future marketing use cases.

The Main Responsibilities

  • Own the architectural vision, governance, performance, and long-term evolution of Lumen's marketing data platform.
  • Lead the design, implementation, and operational strategy of Databricks as the strategic platform for marketing data and intelligence.
  • Define and maintain scalable data architectures that support analytics, reporting, customer intelligence, personalization, activation, and AI-driven use cases.
  • Establish platform standards for data modeling, ingestion, orchestration, observability, testing, security, and environment promotion.
  • Design and govern reusable data products that enable trusted, consistent access to marketing data across the organization.
  • Drive modernization initiatives that improve platform scalability, simplify architecture, reduce technical debt, and accelerate delivery.
  • Define governance standards for metadata management, lineage, schema control, data quality, and lifecycle management.
  • Design for AI-native and agentic operations, including automated quality controls, monitoring, validation, testing, deployment, and operational intelligence.
  • Partner with Adobe, Salesforce, analytics, engineering, and business teams to ensure seamless integration across the marketing technology ecosystem.
  • Evaluate emerging technologies and architectural patterns that improve platform performance, automation, and business value.
  • Provide technical leadership and architectural guidance to engineers, analysts, and cross-functional stakeholders.
  • Lead architecture reviews, establish design standards, and document technical decisions that support long-term platform sustainability.

What We Look For in a Candidate

  • Required Qualifications
    • 8+ years of experience in data engineering, platform architecture, data solutions architecture, or related disciplines.
    • Deep hands-on expertise with Databricks, including Delta Lake, Spark, data engineering, governance, orchestration, and platform architecture.
    • Strong experience designing and implementing modern lakehouse architectures and enterprise-scale data platforms.
    • Advanced data modeling, SQL, and data architecture expertise.
    • Experience designing AI-driven or AI-native data solutions and implementing automation, testing, quality controls, and deployment practices.
    • Strong understanding of metadata management, lineage, observability, data governance, and platform operations.
    • Advanced understanding of Adobe's digital ecosystem, including Web SDK, Launch/Tags, Customer Journey Analytics, and Adobe Experience Platform.
    • Advanced understanding of Salesforce architecture, standard and custom object models, and customer data ecosystems.
    • Demonstrated success translating business requirements into scalable, secure, governed technology solutions.
    • Excellent communication and stakeholder management skills with the ability to influence technical and business audiences
  • Preferred Qualifications
    • Experience modernizing or transforming enterprise data platforms.
    • Experience designing agentic or AI-assisted operational frameworks.
    • Experience with MCP, Copilot, or similar AI orchestration technologies.
    • Experience implementing machine learning or generative AI capabilities within enterprise data environments.
    • Experience with DataOps, DevOps, infrastructure-as-code, CI/CD, and automated testing frameworks.
    • Familiarity with marketing platforms including Marketo, Demandbase, ZoomInfo, Dun & Bradstreet, and Quantum Metric.
    • Experience supporting customer data platforms, data warehousing, and advanced marketing analytics environments.
    • Azure platform expertise, including Key Vault, Azure Monitor, networking, and cloud governance.
    • Relevant Databricks, Microsoft Azure, Adobe, or Salesforce certifications.

raw.description:
Kinetic, a business unit of Uniti (NASDAQ: UNIT), is a premier insurgent provider of multi-gigabit fiber internet, whole-home Wi-Fi, internet security, and voice services in 1,400 markets across 18 states in across the U.S.  Additional information about Kinetic is available at www.GoKinetic.com

About the Role:

The Manager – Held Order Management leads a team that manages consumer fiber orders returned from the field when issues prevent the installation team from completing the install. This is an order management and resolution role, not an inbound customer-care or call-center role. The manager ensures every held order is categorized and entered in the system within a 48-hour SLA, then project manages each order to the correct disposition—released to the field, completed, or cancelled. Expert, hands-on knowledge of order visibility and modification in DCRIS and Kinetic Salesforce is essential.

Work in this role moves across several connected systems every day. The manager and team use DCRIS and Kinetic Salesforce as the primary tools to research, view, modify, and re-sequence orders, and MIROR to track workforce and order activity. They review OFS dispatch results and not-done reasons to understand why an install failed, check EPM for build status, notes, and forecast dates, and confirm completed construction or outstanding field work in Jobtrac. Status, aging, and trend data are pulled from Snowflake and Power BI and shared through Excel, PowerPoint, and Teams. The manager makes sure the information in each system matches before an order is released, completed, or cancelled, and escalates conflicts between systems to the right owner. This position can be filled remotely anywhere within the country.

What You’ll Do:

  • Intake & SLA: Own daily intake of returned orders; ensure each is reviewed, categorized by root cause, and accurately entered in DCRIS/Salesforce within 48 hours
  • Order Resolution: Project manage held orders through disposition and closure; prioritize and escalate aging orders; keep customers informed of order status
  • Cross-Functional Accountability: Partner with Field Operations, Construction, Engineering, contractors, and the Operations Control Center to clear blockers
  • Reporting & Improvement: Report held-order volume, aging, and SLA results; identify repeat causes and build standard procedures to reduce held orders
  • People Leadership: Hire, coach, schedule, and develop the team; manage performance, attendance, timekeeping, and policy compliance with HR

Do You Have?

  • Bachelor's degree or equivalent experience; 5+ years in telecom order management or service delivery; 2+ years leading people
  • Expert, hands-on knowledge of order visibility and modification in DCRIS and Kinetic Salesforce
  • Proficiency with Microsoft Office (Excel, PowerPoint, Teams) and order management/workforce systems such as DCRIS, Kinetic Salesforce and MIROR
  • Strong organization, problem-solving, and communication skills; able to manage high volume against strict SLAs

Even Better:

  • Familiarity with OFS, EPM, and Jobtrac (can be learned on the job); reporting tools such as Snowflake and Power BI
  • Fiber-to-the-home, buried drop, or MDU delivery experience; PMP or Lean Six Sigma certification

Performance Measures:

  • 48-hour SLA attainment
  • Held order volume and aging
  • Time to resolution
  • Order accuracy
  • Employee engagement and retention
  • Future-state (to be established): release-to-field, completion, repeat-hold, and cancellation rates.

Working Conditions:

Primarily office/remote-based with extended computer use; occasional travel and after-hours support during volume spikes. Uniti provides equal employment opportunity to all qualified applicants and employees.

Minimum Requirements:

College degree and 4-6 years professional level experience with 1-3 years supervisory experience; or 8+ years professional level related experience with 1-3 years supervisory experience; or an equivalent combination of education and professional level related experience required.

POSITION OVERVIEW:
As a Business Development Account Manager, you will work as the account manager for target customers to lead innovative programs and applications in additive manufacturing from early concept to full-scale production. You will work closely with manufacturing and engineering teams at target accounts to be their dedicated Velo technical engineer and resource. You will also work with Velo Applications Engineering and Field Management on difficult part production challenges and execution logistics to expedite the target account’s production adoption of Velo3D’s end-to-end solution manufacturing process.

NEAR-TERM DELIVERABLES – First Year

  • Demonstrate the ability to manage and guide the target account through a noticeable increase in demand generated on Sapphire systems.
  • Demonstrate the ability for the target account to view you as their go-to Velo technical engineer for current and future programs and applications

Essential Functions

  • Work in a fast-paced, growing company to lead target accounts into manufacturing production using Velo3D’s end-to-end manufacturing solution.
  • Take ownership of target accounts through education and project/program management of all aspects for critical programs and applications from the early design phase and then from the prototype phase into full-scale production.
  • Ability to leverage previous experiences in design and manufacturing engineering to help target accounts visualize a manufacturing path forward to the final desired production manufacturing plan.
  • Design, modify, and analyze complex geometries in CAD and use Velo’s print preparation software to obtain estimated print times and costing quotes to present to target accounts.
  • Advanced problem solving and conflict resolution of complex and multi-entity situations, including but not limited to internal engineering teams, external engineering/manufacturing teams, and external customers/Contract Manufacturers (CMs) operating a Velo Sapphire.
  • Ability to document statement of work and customer acceptance criteria to communicate externally and internally
  • Educate customers on known Velo3D part design allowables, including understanding physical and economic implications that could present themselves with printing vs. incumbent mfg. process.
  • Consult customers on potential design optimization and challenges for desired part geometries and effectively communicate this both visually and verbally.
  • Work with Applications Engineering on parts and applications that are not part of the current design allowables by effectively communicating the problem statement.
  • Work closely and effectively with teams across multiple departments on technical projects.
  • Maintain strong organizational skills concerning documentation, software analysis, and project management.

Education

  • Required: Bachelor’s degree in Mechanical or Aerospace Engineering, Material Science, or related field.

Experience

  • The experience needed involves...
    • Required:
  • Industry experience in design engineering and manufacturing processes (AM, casting, machining, forging, etc.)
  • Completion of projects that started from early phase development and moved into production
  • Ability to self-motivate and manage complex projects to conclusion
  • Efficient and effective sales and account management skills
  • Customer-facing and project/program management skills.
  • CAD software design (Solidworks, Siemens NX, AutoCAD, CATIA)
    • Desired:

Other Requirements

  • Driven by Results and Impact to Customer
  • Takes ownership and responsibility
  • High Bandwidth

He/she will have a high level of initiative, motivation, and displays drive, energy and enthusiasm for getting things done with an excellent attention to detail.

The responsibilities of this role also include, but may not be limited to, the following:

  • Responsible for the electrical engineering design work on assigned projects
  • Provide mentorship for the other electrical engineers in our High Voltage/Power team
  • Working with Project Engineer and Project Manager on developing design schedules and budgets for electrical engineering work activities
  • Performing Power system studies and system protection settings coordination on various project
  • Generate basis of design documentation for protection settings and relay configurations
  • Supporting projects during construction, start-up, and commissioning
  • Reviewing engineering work performed by peers
  • Attending client meetings
  • Occasional travel to client and/or project sites (including data gathering and field walks)

Corporate Profile:

SyBridge Technologies is at the forefront of technology-enabled design, prototyping, and manufacturing solutions for complex, high-precision parts. As North America's largest injection molding tooling platform and the leading private on-demand digital manufacturer, we are driven by cutting-edge AI/ML technology. Founded in 2004, Crestview is a value-oriented private equity firm focused on the middle market with approximately $10 billion in capital commitments. Based in New York, Crestview focuses on
industrials, media, and financial services.

Position Summary:

We are seeking an experienced Network & Security Engineer to design, implement, manage, and secure enterprise network infrastructure across multiple locations. The ideal candidate will have strong hands-on experience with Layer 3 networking, enterprise firewalls, cybersecurity technologies, and IT security best practices. This role will be responsible for maintaining secure and reliable connectivity between sites, cloud environments, remote users, and manufacturing or business operations.

The successful candidate must be proactive, security-focused, and capable of independently troubleshooting complex network and security issues in a remote work environment.

Candidates must demonstrate hands-on experience with both wired and wireless enterprise networking environments and be capable of independently designing, implementing, securing, and troubleshooting Layer 3 and Wi-Fi network infrastructures. Preference will be given to candidates with experience supporting manufacturing facilities, warehouses, and multi-site operations.

Key Responsibilities

Network Engineering:

  • Design, deploy, and maintain enterprise Layer 3 network infrastructure. Configure and manage routing protocols including BGP, EIGRP (preferred), Static Routing.
  • Implement and manage VLANs, inter-VLAN routing, subnetting, IP addressing plans, and network segmentation.
  • Troubleshoot complex LAN, WAN, SD-WAN, and VPN connectivity issues.
  • Manage network switches, routers, wireless infrastructure, and edge connectivity.
  • Design, deploy, and manage enterprise Wi-Fi across multiple sites, including site surveys, RF and coverage optimization, troubleshooting, controllers, access points, guest networks, and security policies.
  • Optimize network performance, redundancy, and high availability.

Security Engineering:

  • Manage remote-access and site-to-site VPNs, firewalls, and security appliances.
  • Maintain firewall policies, NAT rules, VPN configurations, security zones, and remediate vulnerabilities.
  • Monitor and respond to security events using Zero Trust and least-privilege principles.

Cybersecurity Operations:

  • Deploy and administer EDR, SIEM, vulnerability management, MFA, IAM, email security, and PAM tools.
  • Participate in incident response and forensic investigations.
  • Support cybersecurity audits, compliance assessments, and security reviews.
  • Develop and maintain security documentation, standards, and procedures.

Required Qualifications:

Education:

  • Bachelor's degree in Information Technology, Computer Science, Network Engineering, Cybersecurity, or related field.
  • Preferred Certifications: CCNP, CISSP, CISM, Security+

Experience:

  • 5+ years in enterprise networking and 3+ years in cybersecurity or security engineering.
  • Proven experience designing and supporting Layer 3 networks, multi-site enterprise Wi-Fi, firewalls, and VPNs.
  • Experience supporting multi-site environments, remote users, and secure wireless access.
  • Experience supporting manufacturing or industrial environments, securing OT/IT networks.

Technical Skills:

Networking:

  • Layer 3 networking: OSPF, BGP, VLANs, STP, VRRP/HSRP, TCP/IP, DNS, DHCP, LAN/WAN, and SD-WAN.
  • Multi-site enterprise Wi-Fi design, deployment, and troubleshooting, including Wi-Fi 5/6/6E, site surveys, RF planning, coverage optimization, controllers, access points, guest networks, and security policies.
  • Enterprise wireless platforms (Cisco Meraki/Catalyst, Aruba, Extreme, Ruckus, or Ubiquiti) and secure authentication using WPA2/WPA3 Enterprise, 802.1X, RADIUS, and NAC.

Security:

  • Firewall administration, IDS/IPS, VPN technologies, and Network Access Control (NAC).
  • Security hardening, network segmentation, and endpoint security solutions.

Cybersecurity Platforms:

  • Experience with one or more of, Microsoft Defender Suite, CrowdStrike, SentinelOne, Microsoft Sentinel, Splunk, Tenable, Rapid7, Qualys

Firewall Platforms:

  • Experience with one or more of: Sophos, Palo Alto Networks, Fortinet FortiGate, Cisco Firepower, Check Point, SonicWall

Cloud:

  • Microsoft Azure, AWS, Microsoft 365 Security

Competitive compensation in USD (Dollar Pledge).
100% remote role from anywhere from India OR Pakistan
Supportive and inclusive work environment.
Career growth opportunities in a rapidly expanding global organization.

Merlin is a venture backed aerospace startup building a non-human pilot to enable both reduced crew and uncrewed flight. Backed by some of the world’s leading investors, Merlin is scaling alongside our customers to begin leveraging autonomy today to solve some of aviation’s biggest challenges.

About you:You are an experienced flight controls engineer passionate about autonomous flight who wants to contribute to making airplanes fly themselves. You are familiar with fixed wing aircraft and the classical and modern methods used to control them automatically. You know how to use industry standard tools for this work, and you are excited to work on novel applications.

Responsibilities:

  • Design and implement flight controls for our aircraft automation system.
  • Decompose system requirements into low level flight controls requirements
  • Help create and use the simulation tools needed for development and testing including
  • Simulink control law modeling, analysis using MATLAB and Python.
  • Participate in flight testing for system identification and verification of control law performance on multiple aircraft types.
  • Own the flight control system from end-to-end and be responsible for product delivery to programs and customers
  • Collaborate across Merlin to develop novel, certifiable systems to solve the toughest problems in aviation and autonomy.

Qualifications:

  • BS in Aerospace/Mechanical/Electrical Engineering
  • 5+ years of experience developing control systems for fixed wing aircraft, with demonstrated understanding of fixed wing aircraft dynamics, classical and modern control design / analysis
  • Experience decomposing systems requirements into high level requirements for both outer loop and inner loop control design
  • Experience working in Model Based Development and certification of flight control systems, including proficiency in MATLAB/Simulink or another model-based development toolset
  • Experience designing, implementing, and testing software for real-time systems
  • Experience with linear model development, linear analysis and frequency domain gain tuning techniques

Nice to Haves:

  • MS/PhD in Aerospace Engineering and/or Controls
  • Experience developing never-before-flown control systems
  • Experience extracting linear state space models from flight test data
  • Experience working directly with customers and being a company representative
  • Pilot license
  • Proficiency in C/C++ or Python
Merlin Labs offers an innovative, entrepreneurial, and team-focused startup environment. We also offer a top-notch benefits package (health, dental, life, unlimited vacation, and 401k with match) and work/life integration. Being part of the Merlin team allows you to become part of a small team that supports professional development while working together to achieve our mission.
Merlin Labs is an equal opportunity employer and values diversity. We do not discriminate on the basis of race, religion, color, national origin, genetic information, sex (including pregnancy), gender, gender identity and expression, sexual orientation, age, marital status, military service or obligation or disability status, or any other characteristic protected by law. All job offers are contingent upon the candidate passing background and reference checks.
At this time, we are unable to provide visa sponsorship or consider candidates who require visa transfers. Applicants must be authorized to work in the United States without the need for visa sponsorship now or in the future.
In compliance with federal law, all persons hired will be required to verify identity and eligibility to work in the United States and to complete the required employment eligibility verification form upon hire.

raw.description:
Who we are

Our mission is to bring clarity and control to the world's most complex codebases. AI is accelerating code creation, but the infrastructure to understand, oversee, and evolve that code hasn't kept pace. Sourcegraph gives engineering organizations full visibility across their systems, precise context for their agents, and the ability to execute coordinated code changes at scale. As agentic development becomes the dominant engineering paradigm, we provide the context layer teams need to take control of their codebase.

With Code Search, Deep Search, MCP, and Agentic Batch Changes, we deliver on that mission today -giving engineering teams and their AI tools the cross-repo context to navigate massive codebases with confidence, and the ability to make changes across hundreds of repositories at once.

Companies like Stripe, Uber, and Dropbox rely on Sourcegraph to ship faster and with higher quality. We're backed by a16z, Sequoia, and Redpoint, and proud to operate as a globally distributed team that values high agency, direct communication, and customer love.

If you want to build the infrastructure that lets every engineering team - and every agent they deploy - operate on their codebase with confidence, join us.

Hours & location

🌎 While we hire almost anywhere in the world, we have a preference for someone to reside in the following locations for this role. However, if you feel qualified, we welcome you to apply regardless of location. No matter what, working hours must overlap with Pacific Time for at least 25 hours/week.

Preferred locations:

  • USA - West

Why this job is exciting

We are hiring a Sr. Product Marketing Manager to help us tell the Sourcegraph story and scale the go-to-market for one of the most critical pieces of engineering infrastructure for the largest enterprises building the future.

In this role, you will report to our Head of Marketing, and sit at the intersection of our go-to-market and technical teams to drive thought leadership, product leadership, and market leadership. Our customers are developers and engineering leaders at the largest and most successful companies in the world who rely on us to help them write better code, understand their codebases, secure their products, and adopt the newest and most impactful technology. You will translate deep technical capability into clear market narratives, turn product direction into launches that land, and ensure go-to-market is aligned, credible, and effective.

Sourcegraph is a $50m ARR business, growing fast, with customers like Stripe, OpenAI, X, Uber, JP Morgan, Morgan Stanley, Capital One,, and many more. We are doubling down on our core Search technology, including Deep Search, Code Search, Sourcegraph MCP and APIs for agents, and critical code migration and workflow engines, like Agentic Batch Changes for large-scale changes at scale. You will be responsible for the technical product marketing that will bring that story to life in the market, as well as ensuring alignment with and results from our Demand Gen and DevRel teams.

We move fast and hold ourselves to an extremely high bar for product quality and Developer authenticity. If you’ve made a mark in product marketing for developers, talk to us.

📅 Within one month, you will…

  • Ramp up quickly on the product, our audience, and the market landscape
  • Build trust with the GTM and EPD teams
  • Identify clear product marketing gaps and quick wins

📅 Within three months, you will…

  • Establish clearly defined messaging frameworks
  • Take the lead on product releases and launches
  • Create and deliver sales enablement assets
  • Establish strong operating rhythm with GTM and EPD teams

📅 Within six months, you will…

  • Make product launches and releases repeatable and predictable
  • Drive high-impact initiatives that directly influence pipe generation and deal velocity
  • Partner closely with Demand Generation and DevRel on high-impact campaigns

📅 Within one year, you will…

  • Clearly attribute activities to revenue impact
  • Shape GTM strategy
  • Raise the bar for PMM across the organization

About you

You have a track record of success in driving and owning product marketing initiatives end-to-end. You’re equally comfortable shaping narratives that connect with our technical enterprise audience, enabling sales, and shipping launches that move the business forward. You understand the software development lifecycle and are excited about how AI is reshaping developer tools and workflows.

Must-haves:

  • 5+ years of work experience in product marketing, developer marketing, product management, or related technical marketing roles in a B2B enterprise setting.
  • Strong familiarity with developer tools and modern developer workflows, with a deep interest in AI-driven software development.
  • Proven ownership of end-to-end technical product launches, spanning positioning, field enablement, and launch execution.
  • Demonstrated ability to partner closely with technical teams to define what sets Sourcegraph apart and translate that differentiation into clear, credible, and memorable stories across channels.
  • Experience supporting enterprise sales motions and navigating complex buying cycles.
  • Strong sales enablement muscle, building and maintaining high-impact collateral and assets that scale and move enterprise deals forward.
  • Experience delivering integrated campaigns in partnership with Demand Generation, Field Marketing, and DevRel across webinars, videos, web content, and events.
  • Customer-first mindset, translating real customer feedback into messaging, positioning, and product direction.
  • Strong technical aptitude, with a deep understanding of how modern software is built, shipped, and adopted.
  • Bias toward action, moving quickly and putting bold ideas into motion.
  • Excellent written, verbal, and presentation skills.

Nice-to-haves:

  • Background in software engineering or software development.
  • Experience with account-based marketing (ABM) in enterprise or strategic account motions.

Level

📊 This job is an IC4. You can read more about our job leveling philosophy in our Handbook.

Compensation

💸 We pay you an above-average salary because we want to hire the best people who are fully focused on helping Sourcegraph succeed, not worried about paying bills. As an open and transparent company that values competitive compensation, our compensation ranges are visible to every single Sourcegraph teammate.

Your salary is determined by your pay band for the IC4 job level. For determining pay bands, we use a number of market and data-driven salary sources, along with your location zone, and target the high-end of the range to ensure we’re always paying above market regardless of where you live in the world. Both U.S. and international locations are divided into one of four zones, determined by the cost of labor index for each area. The salary for a successful candidate will be based on level, job-related skills, experience, qualifications, and location zone. Please note that the salaries below may be adjusted in the future.

💰 The target compensation for this role is based on the IC4 pay band for your zone. The start of the IC4 pay band for each zone is listed below:

  • Zone 1: $180,000
  • Zone 2: $144,000
  • Zone 3: $108,000
  • Zone 4: $72,000

📈 In addition to our cash compensation, we offer equity (because when we succeed as a company, we want you to succeed, too) and generous perks & benefits.

Interview process

Below is the interview process you can expect for this role (you can read more about the types of interviews in our Handbook). It may look like a lot of steps, but rest assured that we move quickly and the steps are designed to help you get the information needed to determine if we’re the right fit for you… Interviewing is a two-way street, after all!

We expect the interview process to take 4.75 hours in total.

👋 Introduction Stage - we have initial conversations to get to know you better…

  • [30m] Recruiter Screen
  • [45m] Hiring Manager Screen

🧑‍💻 Team Interview Stage - we then delve into your experience in more depth and introduce you to members of the team, including cross-functional partners…

  • [60m] Resume Deep Dive
  • [60m] Working Session
  • [45m] Cross-functional Collaboration Interview

🎉 Final Interview Stage - we move you to our final round, where you gain a better understanding of our business and values holistically…

  • [30m] Values
  • [15m] Leadership
  • We check references and conduct your background check

Please note - you are welcome to request additional conversations with anyone you would like to meet, but didn’t get to meet during the interview process.

Learn more about us

You can learn more about what it is like to work at Sourcegraph by reading our handbook.

We are an ambitious team who are collectively working hard to build the most influential company in the world. You can read more about our culture, competitive compensation and benefits here.

Sourcegraph is an equal opportunity workplace; we welcome people from all backgrounds.

Sourcegraph participates in E-Verify for U.S. Employees.

raw.description:
ABOUT THE ROLE

Fandango is looking for a SENIOR PLATFORM ENGINEER to build our next big thing in platform growth across Fandango, Rotten Tomatoes, Fandango at Home.

In this role, you'll join the Platform Operations team and report to the Sr. Director of Platform Operations, contributing to the foundational infrastructure and tools that power how we enable developer productivity while delivering platform enhancements. As a Platform Engineer, you will focus on building and maintaining the core platform layers that support our engineering organization.

If you enjoy solving complex problems, building for scale, and making a measurable impact – we'd love to meet you.

WHAT YOU'LL DO

As a Senior Platform Engineer on our team, you will:

  • Build and maintain core platform infrastructure that serves as the foundation for engineering teams across the organization
  • Drive and participate in solution architecture and delivery across diverse domains, offering expertise in AWS cloud infrastructure and resources, containers (ECS/Kubernetes) and cloud-native architectures
  • Develop, enhance, and operate platform capabilities including CI/CD pipelines, infrastructure as code, reusable patterns, and automation solutions that enable rapid, reliable, and secure deployments
  • Design and implement standardized, reusable cloud infrastructure patterns and templates that help teams adopt best practices while maintaining security and compliance requirements
  • Demonstrate, enable, and promote consistent adoption of software delivery practices and solutions that optimize for fast feedback, observability, and operational excellence
  • Proactively collaborate with product and engineering teams, taking technical leadership in areas of cross-functional projects while sharing knowledge and best practices
  • Evaluate existing standards and practices, identify gaps, and implement improvements to strengthen Development, Security, and Operational practices across the organization
  • Demonstrate excellent communication skills through proactive status updates, clear documentation, knowledge sharing, and effective collaboration when facing technical challenges
  • Partner closely with engineering teams to understand their needs, refine requirements, and deliver solutions that enhance developer productivity while meeting project objectives
  • Work with emerging technologies around AI, MCP, and RAG
  • Costoptimization - Monitor and optimize cloud spend, implementing cost governance strategies and right-sizing recommendations.
  • Servicereliability Maintain SLOs/SLIs/SLAs, improve uptime targets, and help implement reliability engineering practices.
  • Mentorship - Mentor junior and mid-level engineers, conduct design reviews, and raise the technical bar across the platform team.

WHAT WE'RE LOOKING FOR:

  • AWS Expertise: 6+ years of hands-on experience with AWS, with a focus on Infrastructure as Code
  • Linux Proficiency: Minimum of 4 years of experience managing and maintaining Linux systems
  • Automation/Scripting: 3+ years of experience with Python for automation and scripting
  • Git and GitOps: Practical experience and comfortable using Git and automated workflows
  • AWS Security Knowledge: Familiarity with AWS security best practices, including DNS, secure VPCs, and database security (e.g., PostgreSQL, MySQL)
  • Communication & Collaboration: Strong written and verbal communication skills with the ability to explain complex technical concepts to technical and non-technical audiences
  • Problem-Solving Mindset: Eagerness to learn, grow, and tackle challenges in a fast-paced environment
  • Troubleshooting&debugging - Proven ability to troubleshoot complex distributed systems issues across networking, compute, storage, and application layers. Comfortable with packet captures, log analysis, performance profiling, and diagnosing intermittent failures in production.\
  • Terraform / Infrastructure as Code: 3+ years of hands-on experience with Terraform, including module development, state management, and multi-environment workflows. Comfortable writing, reviewing, and maintaining IaC that provisions and manages cloud infrastructure at scale.
  • Networkingfundamentals — VPCs, load balancers, DNS, CDNs, service mesh, network troubleshooting.
  • Monitoring/Observability — Datadog, Prometheus, Grafana, CloudWatch, ELK stacks.
  • Incidentmanagementexperience — PagerDuty, on-call rotations, post-mortem culture.

BONUS POINTS FOR:

  • AWS Certifications: Relevant certifications such as AWS Certified Cloud Practitioner, AWS Certified Solutions Architect – Associate
  • Background in building or maintaining systems that support scalable application environments and event-driven architectures
  • Understanding of container security and orchestration (Docker, Kubernetes)
  • Fundamentals of running AI-related services
  • Experience contributing to open-source projects or internal platform tools
  • Multi-account AWS strategy (Organizations, Control Tower, Landing Zones
  • Chaos engineering / game days
  • Platform-as-a-product thinking (internal developer portals, Backstage)

As part of our selection process, external candidates may be required to attend an in-person interview with a VERSANT Media employee at one of our locations prior to a hiring decision. raw.description:
COMPANY OVERVIEW

Hanwha Energy USA, headquartered in Houston, Texas, is part of the Hanwha Group—a FORTUNE Global 300 company and one of South Korea’s most respected business enterprises. With over a decade of experience delivering high-quality, utility-scale energy projects across North America, Hanwha Energy USA has evolved into a comprehensive energy solutions provider. Our portfolio now spans utility-scale renewables, natural gas generation, retail electricity, and strategic partnerships that power America’s growing data center industry.

Our expertise covers the entire energy value chain—from project development and engineering to construction, operations, and maintenance. By integrating advanced technologies, proven processes, and strong partnerships, we deliver reliable, customized solutions that meet the dynamic needs of local energy markets.

Hanwha Energy USA is actively advancing strategic initiatives in natural gas generation and data center development, including hyperscaler solutions on both sides of the meter. We are proud to serve as the parent company of:

  • Hanwha Renewables – specializing in utility-scale solar and battery energy storage systems (BESS)
  • Chariot Energy – providing retail electricity services for residential, commercial, and industrial customers in deregulated markets

POSITION OVERVIEW

The Director, Corporate Partnership Engagement position is responsible for sourcing, structuring, and executing offtake opportunities with corporate and industrial (C&I) energy buyers. As part of this role, you will work in cross-functional teams to formulate comprehensive energy solutions that leverage the expansive range of products and services the Hanwha Group can provide, including solar, battery energy storage, energy trading, and gas generation.

The successful candidate will bring an established network of corporate energy procurement relationships and a demonstrated track record of originating and closing transactions with C&I customers. The employee may be required to perform other job-related duties as requested by management. All duties will be assigned in accordance with applicable laws and company policies

RESPONSIBILITIES

Origination and Relationship Management

  • Identify, originate, and cultivate relationships with C&I energy buyers.
  • Leverage existing relationships with energy managers, procurement leads, sustainability teams, and senior management to introduce Hanwha Energy’s offerings.
  • Engage power-intensive corporate customers through bilateral approaches to understand their energy, environmental, and infrastructure needs both near and long-term.

Solution Design and Structuring

  • Develop and structure commercial frameworks that go beyond traditional PPA structures and address complex needs of customers including speed to power, resource diversity, decarbonization, and cost optimization.
  • Lead cross-functional teams through contract negotiations and execution, developing solutions to commercially and technically complex challenges.
  • Prepare investment memoranda and supporting material for senior management.

Market & Policy Development

  • Work in tandem with the Government Relations and Market Development teams to monitor and influence changes in interconnection, tariffs, market products and other relevant matters.
  • Engage in industry groups and monitor regulatory developments to identify new opportunities, risks, and market solutions.

REQUIRED QUALIFICATIONS

  • 7+ years of experience in power marketing, origination, or procuring energy on behalf of corporate energy buyers.
  • Deep and actionable network of relationships with C&I buyers and in at least one target region.
  • Direct transaction experience in ERCOT, PJM, or CAISO, across a variety of deal structures.
  • Expert-level knowledge of offtake structuring instruments including VPPAs, financial hedges, tolling agreements, and emerging structures.
  • Advanced understanding of U.S. utility-scale solar development, power markets, project finance, and customer segments.
  • Bachelor’s degree or higher in business, engineering, sustainability, finance, or related field.
  • Ability to quickly step into new tasks and adapt to new circumstances in a dynamic environment.
  • Experience successfully operating in a geographically dispersed organization is a plus.
  • Excellent interpersonal, time management, communication, and relationship building skills.
  • Willing to travel up to 40% of the time in North America.

COMPENSATION: $180,000 - $210,000 salary

Attention external recruitment firms, we will not accept any unsolicited resumes at this time. Please do not contact any internal member of our company to discuss the position or to solicit candidates.

Hanwha Energy USA provides equal employment opportunities (EEO) to all employees and applicants for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, national origin, age, disability or genetics.
